lines.en: Freedom! The bell rang. What are you doing after school today?
lines.zh: 解放了！铃响了。你今天放学后干嘛？

lines.en: The usual — homework, then dinner. Why, got something planned?
lines.zh: 老样子——写作业，然后吃饭。怎么，你有安排？

lines.en: There's a new game shop near the station. I was thinking of checking it out.
lines.zh: 车站旁边新开了家游戏店。我想去逛逛。

lines.en: That final bell. It's not just the end of class — it's the start of the best part of the day. Or the busiest. Sometimes both.
lines.zh: 放学铃。它不只是下课，而是一天里最棒部分的开始。也可能是最忙的。有时候两者兼有。

lines.en: Today, Jake wants to do something fun. Mia has a plan, too. Let's see which one wins.
lines.zh: 今天 Jake 想找点乐子。Mia 也有安排。看看谁赢了。

lines.en: The game shop? You have a math test on Friday, remember?
lines.zh: 游戏店？你周五有数学测验，记得吗？

lines.en: It's Tuesday! Friday is basically next year.
lines.zh: 今天才周二！周五基本上算明年的事了。

lines.en: That's exactly the kind of math that gets you a C on a test.
lines.zh: 你这种算法，正好能让你数学考个 C。

lines.en: Come on. One hour. Then I'll do homework. Promise.
lines.zh: 来嘛。就一小时。然后我写作业。保证。

lines.en: You said that last week. And then you stayed up till eleven.
lines.zh: 你上周也这么说。然后熬到十一点。

lines.en: That was one time. Well... two times. Three at most.
lines.zh: 那是就一次。好吧……两次。顶多三次。

lines.en: Here's a better idea. Come to the library with me. One hour, real homework.
lines.zh: 我有个更好的主意。跟我去图书馆。一小时，真写作业。

lines.en: The library? For fun? You do know what the word 'fun' means, right?
lines.zh: 图书馆？为了好玩？你知道'好玩'这词是什么意思吧？

lines.en: I know what a good grade means. That's rarer.
lines.zh: 我知道好成绩是什么意思。那东西更难得。

lines.en: Mia has a system for after school. Jake thinks it's boring. But there's a middle way, and here's how they found it.
lines.zh: Mia 对放学后有一套方法。Jake 觉得太无聊。但其实有折中办法，听听他们怎么找到的。

lines.en: Okay, deal. Forty minutes at the game shop. Then the library, one hour. You in?
lines.zh: 好，成交。游戏店四十分钟。然后图书馆一小时。干不干？

lines.en: Forty minutes? That's barely enough to say hello to the games.
lines.zh: 四十分钟？跟游戏打个招呼都不够。

lines.en: Take it or leave it.
lines.zh: 爱要不要。

lines.en: Fine, fine. But you're buying me a drink after.
lines.zh: 行行行。但你之后得请我喝饮料。

lines.en: Why am I buying you a drink for doing your own homework?
lines.zh: 你写自己的作业，凭什么我请你喝饮料？

lines.en: Because I'm your favorite person, obviously.
lines.zh: 因为我显然是你最喜欢的人。

lines.en: You're not even my favorite desk mate.
lines.zh: 你连我最喜欢的同桌都算不上。

lines.en: Harsh. Okay, forty minutes and a drink, final offer.
lines.zh: 太狠了。好吧，四十分钟加一杯饮料，最后报价。

lines.en: Deal. Let's go before the game shop closes and the library runs out of seats.
lines.zh: 成交。快走，不然游戏店关门、图书馆也没位子了。

lines.en: Time to slow down. Here are the best lines about planning your afternoon.
lines.zh: 现在放慢节奏。来听几句关于安排下午时间的实用表达。

lines.en: What are you doing after school?
lines.zh: 你放学后干什么？

lines.en: I was thinking of checking it out.
lines.zh: 我正想去看看。

lines.en: Take it or leave it.
lines.zh: 爱要不要（不容再讨价）。

lines.en: You in?
lines.zh: 你干不干？

lines.en: The usual.
lines.zh: 老样子。

lines.en: Got something planned?
lines.zh: 有安排吗？

lines.en: I was thinking of...
lines.zh: 我正想……

lines.en: Come on.
lines.zh: 来嘛。

lines.en: That's exactly the kind of...
lines.zh: 这正好是那种……

lines.en: Here's a better idea.
lines.zh: 我有个更好的主意。

lines.en: Take it or leave it.
lines.zh: 爱要不要。

lines.en: Deal.
lines.zh: 成交。

lines.en: Your turn: plan your afternoon in English. Tell someone (or yourself) two things you will do, and one thing you'll skip.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语规划你的下午。告诉别人（或自己）你要做的两件事，和一件你不做的事。

lines.en: Next time, we're staying at home — with a pile of dishes, a mop, and a family debate about who does what. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 下次，我们留在家里——面对一堆碗、一把拖把，还有一场关于谁该干什么的家庭争论。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 周末家务分工
episodes.desc: 谁来洗碗、谁来拖地，一个家庭的分工难题

lines.en: Saturday morning, and I'm holding a mop. Something is very wrong with this picture.
lines.zh: 周六早上，我手里拿着拖把。这画面很有问题。

lines.en: Chores, Jake. Every family has them. Even yours.
lines.zh: 家务活，Jake。每个家庭都有。你家也一样。

lines.en: But why does 'chores' always mean 'Jake'?
lines.zh: 但为什么'家务活'总等于'Jake'？

lines.en: The weekend. Two whole days. Unless, of course, your family has a chore chart. Then it's two days of tiny wars.
lines.zh: 周末。整整两天。除非你家有一张家务分工表。那这两天就是两场小规模战争。

lines.en: Today, Jake discovers that in his house, nobody ever seems to be free when there's a dish in the sink.
lines.zh: 今天，Jake 发现他家有个规律：只要水槽里有碗，就没人有空。

lines.en: So my mom made a chore chart. My name is on it five times. Five.
lines.zh: 我妈做了张家务表。我的名字出现了五次。五次。

lines.en: What do you have to do?
lines.zh: 你要干什么？

lines.en: Dishes, trash, my room, feeding the cat, and — get this — watering plants that aren't even real.
lines.zh: 洗碗、倒垃圾、收拾房间、喂猫，还有——听好了——给一盆假花浇水。

lines.en: Wait, fake plants? Why would she water fake plants?
lines.zh: 等等，假花？为什么要给假花浇水？

lines.en: Exactly! I asked her. She said, 'Because it's on your list, and the list doesn't water itself.'
lines.zh: 就是啊！我问她。她说：'因为它在你的清单上，而清单不会自己浇水。'

lines.en: Your mom is... very organized.
lines.zh: 你妈妈……非常有条理。

lines.en: Organized? She once made a schedule for our vacation. A vacation!
lines.zh: 有条理？她给我们假期排过时间表。假期！

lines.en: Okay, that's next level. But chores aren't all bad, right?
lines.zh: 好吧，那是天花板级别了。但家务也不全是坏事吧？

lines.en: Name one good thing about doing dishes.
lines.zh: 说说洗碗有哪一点好。

lines.en: Clean plate for your next meal?
lines.zh: 下一顿有干净的盘子？

lines.en: I could use the same plate twice.
lines.zh: 我可以一个盘子用两顿。

lines.en: That's disgusting, and you know it.
lines.zh: 这很恶心，而且你自己心里清楚。

lines.en: Here's how Jake's family finally settled the great chore debate.
lines.zh: 下面这段，是 Jake 家最终怎么解决这场家务大辩论的。

lines.en: So how do you decide who does what?
lines.zh: 那你们怎么决定谁干什么？

lines.en: We rotate. Every week, the names move one spot.
lines.zh: 我们轮流。每周名字往下移一格。

lines.en: So nobody's stuck with dishes forever?
lines.zh: 所以没人会一直洗碗？

lines.en: Right. Last week I had trash. This week dishes. Next week, my sister does it.
lines.zh: 对。上周我倒垃圾。这周洗碗。下周换我姐。

lines.en: That's actually fair. Smart mom.
lines.zh: 这样还挺公平。你妈妈挺聪明。

lines.en: Yeah... I kind of hate that she's right. But don't tell her I said that.
lines.zh: 是啊……我有点讨厌她居然是对的。但别告诉她我这么说过。

lines.en: Deal. Now go water your fake plants.
lines.zh: 成交。现在去给你那盆假花浇水吧。

lines.en: I regret telling you that.
lines.zh: 我后悔告诉你了。

lines.en: Slow it down. Here are the handiest lines about sharing the housework.
lines.zh: 放慢。来听几句关于分担家务最实用的表达。

lines.en: Every family has chores.
lines.zh: 每个家庭都有家务活。

lines.en: My name is on it five times.
lines.zh: 我的名字出现了五次。

lines.en: We rotate every week.
lines.zh: 我们每周轮流。

lines.en: Nobody's stuck with dishes forever.
lines.zh: 没人会一直洗碗。

lines.en: Something is very wrong with this picture.
lines.zh: 这画面很不对劲。

lines.en: Get this.
lines.zh: 听好了（引出重点）。

lines.en: That's next level.
lines.zh: 那是天花板级别了。

lines.en: Name one good thing about...
lines.zh: 说说……有哪一点好。

lines.en: We rotate.
lines.zh: 我们轮流。

lines.en: Nobody's stuck with...
lines.zh: 没人会一直……

lines.en: I kind of hate that she's right.
lines.zh: 我有点讨厌她居然是对的。

lines.en: Don't tell her I said that.
lines.zh: 别告诉她我这么说过。

lines.en: Your turn: in English, list two chores you do at home, and one chore you'd trade with a family member if you could.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语列出你在家做的两件家务，以及如果可以，你想跟家人交换的一件家务。

lines.en: Tomorrow, we open the door to the most dangerous room in the house — the one with clothes everywhere. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 明天，我们推开家里最危险的那扇门——那间到处是衣服的房间。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 我的房间
episodes.desc: 房间乱到找不着床，一场大扫除

lines.en: Mia, if you don't hear from me for a few days, send help. My room ate me.
lines.zh: Mia，如果接下来几天你联系不上我，快叫人来救我。我的房间把我吞了。

lines.en: Your room? You mean the place with the clothes mountain?
lines.zh: 你的房间？你是说那座衣服山？

lines.en: It's not a mountain anymore. It's a whole range.
lines.zh: 现在不是一座山了。是一整条山脉。

lines.en: Every home has one room where things go to disappear. For Jake, it's his bedroom. And today, it's finally time to face it.
lines.zh: 每个家都有一个东西进去就消失的房间。对 Jake 来说，是他的卧室。而今天，终于要面对它了。

lines.en: Mia has offered to help. She may regret it.
lines.zh: Mia 主动提出帮忙。她可能会后悔。

lines.en: Okay. First, we find the floor. It's under there somewhere, right?
lines.zh: 好。首先，我们找到地板。它应该就在下面某处，对吧？

lines.en: I think I remember seeing it once. It was a nice floor.
lines.zh: 我记得我见过它一次。是块不错的地板。

lines.en: Let's do three piles: keep, throw away, and 'what even is this'.
lines.zh: 我们分三堆：留着、扔掉，还有'这到底是个啥'。

lines.en: That third pile is going to be huge.
lines.zh: 第三堆会非常巨大。

lines.en: What is this? A sock, a battery, and... is that a half-eaten sandwich?
lines.zh: 这是什么？一只袜子、一节电池，还有……那是半个吃剩的三明治？

lines.en: Ah, I was wondering where that went.
lines.zh: 啊，我正纳闷它去哪了。

lines.en: You were 'wondering'? About a sandwich from last month?
lines.zh: 你居然还'纳闷'？上个月的三明治？

lines.en: In my defense, I was saving it. For science.
lines.zh: 替自己说句公道话，我是留着它。为了科学。

lines.en: What science? The science of growing new life forms under your bed?
lines.zh: 什么科学？在你床底下培育新生命形态的科学？

lines.en: That's... actually not far off.
lines.zh: 这个……其实还挺接近。

lines.en: I'm going to need gloves. And possibly a mask.
lines.zh: 我需要手套。可能还得要个口罩。

lines.en: Two hours later, the room looks different. Here's what Jake learned about the magic of a clean space.
lines.zh: 两小时后，房间变了个样。听听 Jake 从整洁空间里学到了什么。

lines.en: See? Look at it now. You can see the desk. You can open the window.
lines.zh: 看吧？现在看看。书桌能看见了。窗户能打开了。

lines.en: It's... weirdly nice. I keep wanting to sit in here.
lines.zh: 这……莫名地舒服。我老想待在这屋里。

lines.en: Told you. A clean room is a calm room.
lines.zh: 早跟你说了。干净的房间，心里也清净。

lines.en: Okay, fine. But the real test is tomorrow. Can it stay like this for one week?
lines.zh: 行吧，算你说得对。但真正的考验在明天。它能保持一周吗？

lines.en: It can, if you stop treating your floor like a second closet.
lines.zh: 能，只要你别再把地板当第二个衣柜。

lines.en: That's a lifestyle choice, Mia. Respect it.
lines.zh: 那是一种生活方式选择，Mia。请尊重。

lines.en: It's a fire hazard, Jake. Pick up the backpack.
lines.zh: 那是个消防隐患，Jake。把书包捡起来。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are the lines you'll actually use when you clean your own room.
lines.zh: 放慢。来听几句你收拾自己房间时真会用到的表达。

lines.en: We find the floor first.
lines.zh: 我们先找到地板。

lines.en: Three piles: keep, throw away, and 'what even is this'.
lines.zh: 分三堆：留着、扔掉、'这到底是个啥'。

lines.en: A clean room is a calm room.
lines.zh: 干净的房间，心里也清净。

lines.en: Stop treating your floor like a second closet.
lines.zh: 别再把地板当第二个衣柜。

lines.en: My room ate me.
lines.zh: 我的房间把我吞了（夸张）。

lines.en: I was wondering where that went.
lines.zh: 我正纳闷它去哪了。

lines.en: In my defense, I was saving it.
lines.zh: 替自己说句公道话，我是留着它。

lines.en: Not far off.
lines.zh: 还挺接近。

lines.en: It's weirdly nice.
lines.zh: 莫名地舒服。

lines.en: Told you.
lines.zh: 早跟你说了。

lines.en: The real test is tomorrow.
lines.zh: 真正的考验在明天。

lines.en: Pick up the backpack.
lines.zh: 把书包捡起来。

lines.en: Your turn: in English, describe one thing in your room you should throw away, and one thing you'd never get rid of.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语描述你房间里一件该扔掉的东西，和一件你永远不会丢的东西。

lines.en: Tomorrow, we gather around the table for the loudest meal of the week — family dinner. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 明天，我们围坐在餐桌旁，吃一周里最热闹的那顿饭——家庭聚餐。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 家庭聚餐
episodes.desc: 一桌菜、一大家子，饭桌上的热闹与规矩

lines.en: You will not believe what happened at dinner last night.
lines.zh: 你绝对猜不到昨晚吃饭时发生了什么。

lines.en: Let me guess. Your little brother spilled something again?
lines.zh: 我猜猜。你弟弟又打翻东西了？

lines.en: Worse. My grandma came to visit, and she brought... questions.
lines.zh: 更糟。我奶奶来了，她带来了……各种问题。

lines.en: Family dinner. The food is warm, the table is full, and somebody is always asking too many questions. Today, it's Jake's turn to survive one.
lines.zh: 家庭聚餐。饭菜是热的，桌子是满的，而且总有一个人问题太多。今天轮到 Jake 撑过这一顿了。

lines.en: If you've ever had a grandparent at the table, you already know what's coming.
lines.zh: 如果你饭桌上也有过祖辈，你早就知道接下来会发生什么。

lines.en: Okay, what did she ask?
lines.zh: 好吧，她问什么了？

lines.en: Everything. 'Why are you so thin? Are you eating? Why is your hair like that? Do you have a girlfriend yet?'
lines.zh: 所有问题。'你怎么这么瘦？你吃饭吗？你头发怎么弄成这样？有女朋友了吗？'

lines.en: Classic grandma. What did you say?
lines.zh: 典型的奶奶。你怎么答的？

lines.en: I said, 'Grandma, I'm fourteen.' She said, 'And? Your grandpa proposed at sixteen.'
lines.zh: 我说：'奶奶，我才十四。'她说：'那又怎样？你爷爷十六岁就求婚了。'

lines.en: No way. Sixteen?
lines.zh: 不会吧。十六岁？

lines.en: That's what she says. She also says the soup was better in her day.
lines.zh: 她是这么说的。她还说她那个年代的汤更好喝。

lines.en: Is the soup ever good enough for grandmas?
lines.zh: 奶奶们觉得汤有够好喝过吗？

lines.en: Never. It's a law of the universe.
lines.zh: 从来没有。这是宇宙定律。

lines.en: Well, at least you got fed. Grandmas never let you leave the table hungry.
lines.zh: 不过至少你吃饱了。奶奶们从不让你饿着离开饭桌。

lines.en: True. She piled my plate so high I couldn't see my dad across the table.
lines.zh: 确实。她给我盛的菜堆得老高，隔着桌子都看不见我爸。

lines.en: But dinner wasn't just questions. The best part came at the end, when grandma told stories.
lines.zh: 不过晚餐不只有问题。最好的部分在最后，奶奶讲起了故事。

lines.en: Did she tell any good stories?
lines.zh: 她讲什么好故事了吗？

lines.en: The best. About my dad as a kid — he once got stuck in a tree chasing a kite.
lines.zh: 太精彩了。讲我爸小时候——有次追风筝，结果卡在树上下不来。

lines.en: Your dad? Stuck in a tree? I need details.
lines.zh: 你爸？卡在树上？我需要细节。

lines.en: He was up there for two hours. The whole neighborhood came to watch.
lines.zh: 他在上面待了两小时。整个街坊都来看热闹。

lines.en: Now I see where you get it from.
lines.zh: 现在我算知道你遗传谁了。

lines.en: Hey, I've never been stuck in a tree. I've been stuck in other places.
lines.zh: 喂，我可从没卡在树上过。我卡的是别的地方。

lines.en: Like your own room, last week.
lines.zh: 比如上周，你自己的房间。

lines.en: We agreed to never speak of that again.
lines.zh: 我们说好再也不提那事的。

lines.en: We agreed to no such thing.
lines.zh: 我可没跟你这么约定过。

lines.en: Slow it down. Here are the phrases that come up at every family table.
lines.zh: 放慢。来听几句每个家庭饭桌上都会出现的表达。

lines.en: What did she ask?
lines.zh: 她问什么了？

lines.en: You will not believe what happened.
lines.zh: 你绝对猜不到发生了什么。

lines.en: At least you got fed.
lines.zh: 至少你吃饱了。

lines.en: Now I see where you get it from.
lines.zh: 现在我算知道你遗传谁了。

lines.en: She brought... questions.
lines.zh: 她带来了……各种问题。

lines.en: Classic grandma.
lines.zh: 典型的奶奶。

lines.en: And?
lines.zh: 那又怎样？

lines.en: It's a law of the universe.
lines.zh: 这是宇宙定律。

lines.en: She never lets you leave hungry.
lines.zh: 她从不让你饿着离开。

lines.en: I need details.
lines.zh: 我需要细节。

lines.en: The whole neighborhood came to watch.
lines.zh: 整个街坊都来看热闹。

lines.en: We agreed to never speak of that again.
lines.zh: 我们说好再也不提那事了。

lines.en: Your turn: in English, describe your favorite dish at a family dinner, and who usually makes it.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语描述家庭聚餐里你最喜欢的一道菜，以及通常是谁做的。

lines.en: Tomorrow, we talk about the people who share your bedroom and borrow your things without asking — brothers and sisters. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 明天，我们聊聊跟你住一个房间、还不打招呼就借你东西的人——兄弟姐妹。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 兄弟姐妹
episodes.desc: 有兄弟姐妹的烦恼与甜蜜

lines.en: Mia, do you have a sibling?
lines.zh: Mia，你有兄弟姐妹吗？

lines.en: One older sister. Why? Yours driving you crazy again?
lines.zh: 一个姐姐。怎么了？你家的又把你逼疯了？

lines.en: She borrowed my favorite hoodie. Three weeks ago. It's gone, Mia. Gone.
lines.zh: 她借走了我最爱的卫衣。三周前。它没了，Mia。没了。

lines.en: Brothers and sisters. They know your passwords, your weak spots, and exactly where you hide your snacks. Today, Jake has reached his limit.
lines.zh: 兄弟姐妹。他们知道你的密码、你的软肋，还有你藏零食的确切位置。今天，Jake 忍到极限了。

lines.en: But as usual, there are two sides to every story.
lines.zh: 但和往常一样，每件事都有两面。

lines.en: Gone as in... she lost it? Or gone as in she loves it so much she 'forgot' to give it back?
lines.zh: '没了'是指……她弄丢了？还是她太喜欢，所以'忘了'还？

lines.en: Both. First the second one, then the first one.
lines.zh: 都是。先是第二种，后来变成第一种。

lines.en: Classic older sibling move. My sister does the same with my headphones.
lines.zh: 经典的姐姐操作。我姐对我耳机也这样。

lines.en: The worst part? When I ask for it back, I'm the bad guy.
lines.zh: 最气人的是？当我开口要回来的时候，反倒成了我的不是。

lines.en: Right? 'You never share!' Like I'm the problem.
lines.zh: 可不是嘛？'你从不分享！'搞得像我才是问题。

lines.en: I share! I shared the hoodie, didn't I? Look where that got me.
lines.zh: 我分享了啊！卫衣不就分享了吗？看看我落得什么下场。

lines.en: Okay, but here's the thing. Would you trade her for anything?
lines.zh: 好，但问题是。你愿意用任何东西换掉她吗？

lines.en: What? No. Obviously not.
lines.zh: 什么？不。当然不会。

lines.en: See? That's siblings. They drive you crazy, but they're yours.
lines.zh: 看吧？这就是兄弟姐妹。他们让你抓狂，但他们是你的。

lines.en: Don't go getting deep on me while I'm still angry.
lines.zh: 我还在气头上，你别突然跟我走心。

lines.en: I'm just saying. Now about the hoodie — have you checked her chair? She always drapes it there.
lines.zh: 我只是说说。至于卫衣——你翻过她椅子吗？她总爱搭在那上面。

lines.en: Her chair. You might be onto something.
lines.zh: 她的椅子。你这话可能有道理。

lines.en: The hoodie was, in fact, on the chair. Here's how Jake handled the 'getting it back' part.
lines.zh: 卫衣确实在椅子上。听听 Jake 是怎么处理'要回来'这个环节的。

lines.en: So? Did you get it back?
lines.zh: 所以呢？要回来了吗？

lines.en: I did. But first I had to listen to a ten-minute speech about how sharing is caring.
lines.zh: 要回来了。但先听了十分钟'分享就是关爱'的演讲。

lines.en: And how did you respond?
lines.zh: 那你怎么回应的？

lines.en: I said, 'Sharing is caring, so care about giving it back.'
lines.zh: 我说：'分享就是关爱，那你就关爱关爱，把东西还我。'

lines.en: That's actually pretty good. Did she laugh?
lines.zh: 这话其实挺妙。她笑了吗？

lines.en: She laughed, threw the hoodie at my face, and said I'm 'so dramatic'.
lines.zh: 她笑了，把卫衣甩我脸上，说我'真够夸张的'。

lines.en: Sounds about right. Siblings, man.
lines.zh: 差不多就这味儿。兄弟姐妹嘛。

lines.en: Siblings.
lines.zh: 兄弟姐妹。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are the phrases that every sibling knows by heart.
lines.zh: 放慢。来听几句每个有兄弟姐妹的人都烂熟于心的表达。

lines.en: Do you have a sibling?
lines.zh: 你有兄弟姐妹吗？

lines.en: She borrowed my favorite hoodie.
lines.zh: 她借走了我最爱的卫衣。

lines.en: They drive you crazy, but they're yours.
lines.zh: 他们让你抓狂，但他们是你的。

lines.en: Sharing is caring.
lines.zh: 分享就是关爱。

lines.en: Yours driving you crazy again?
lines.zh: 你家的又把你逼疯了？

lines.en: She 'forgot' to give it back.
lines.zh: 她'忘了'还。

lines.en: Classic older sibling move.
lines.zh: 经典的姐姐操作。

lines.en: When I ask, I'm the bad guy.
lines.zh: 我一开口要，就成了我的不是。

lines.en: Would you trade her for anything?
lines.zh: 你愿意用任何东西换掉她吗？

lines.en: Don't get deep on me.
lines.zh: 别突然跟我走心。

lines.en: You might be onto something.
lines.zh: 你这话可能有道理。

lines.en: So dramatic.
lines.zh: 真够夸张的。

lines.en: Your turn: in English, describe one annoying thing and one great thing about a sibling (or a close friend if you're an only child).
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语描述兄弟姐妹（或独生子女的密友）身上一件烦人的事，和一件很棒的事。

lines.en: Tomorrow, we head to the supermarket with a very specific mission — and a very long shopping list. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 明天，我们带着一项明确任务，和一张很长的购物清单，去逛超市。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 帮妈妈买菜
episodes.desc: 第一次独自去超市，清单上都是谜语

lines.en: My mom just gave me the shopping list. I think it's written in code.
lines.zh: 我妈刚把购物清单给我。我觉得那是用密码写的。

lines.en: Let me see. 'Tomatoes, not too soft. Green onions, a bunch. Soy sauce, the one with the red cap.' That's not code, that's a mom list.
lines.zh: 我看看。'西红柿，别太软。小葱，一把。酱油，红盖的那种。'这不是密码，这是妈妈式清单。

lines.en: But there's twenty more lines just like that!
lines.zh: 但后面还有二十行都是这种！

lines.en: The grocery run. Your mom hands you a list, a few bills, and a lot of instructions. And somehow, you're supposed to get it all right.
lines.zh: 买菜任务。妈妈递给你一张清单、几张钞票，还有一大堆嘱咐。而你居然要全都买对。

lines.en: Today, Jake is sent to the supermarket alone for the first time. Mia tags along for moral support — and snacks.
lines.zh: 今天，Jake 第一次被派去超市独自采购。Mia 陪他去打气——顺便买零食。

lines.en: Okay, first rule of grocery shopping: never go hungry. Here, grab a basket.
lines.zh: 好，买菜第一定律：绝不能饿着肚子逛。来，拿个篮子。

lines.en: Why not a cart? The list is huge.
lines.zh: 为什么不用推车？清单很长啊。

lines.en: Basket keeps you honest. You only buy what you can carry.
lines.zh: 篮子让你保持清醒。你只能买你拎得动的东西。

lines.en: That's... weirdly smart.
lines.zh: 这……莫名地聪明。

lines.en: Now, the tomatoes. Feel them, but don't squish them. My mom says squeezing ruins them.
lines.zh: 现在，西红柿。摸一摸，但别捏。我妈说捏了会坏。

lines.en: Got it. Soft but not squishy. What's next?
lines.zh: 明白。软但不烂。下一个？

lines.en: Soy sauce, red cap. Not the green one — that's the expensive one.
lines.zh: 酱油，红盖。别拿绿盖的——那个贵。

lines.en: How do you know all this?
lines.zh: 你怎么什么都知道？

lines.en: Years of being sent to the store. It's a rite of passage, Jake. Welcome.
lines.zh: 因为被派去买了好几年。这是一种成长仪式，Jake。欢迎加入。

lines.en: The mission hit one small snag at the checkout. Here's what happened.
lines.zh: 结账时出了点小岔子。听听发生了什么。

lines.en: We're at the checkout and... I'm short. Like, short on money.
lines.zh: 我们在收银台，然后……我钱不够了。就差一点。

lines.en: How short?
lines.zh: 差多少？

lines.en: Five yuan. I must have dropped it, or my mom can't count. Probably me.
lines.zh: 五块钱。我可能弄丢了，也可能是我妈算错。多半是我。

lines.en: Here, I'll cover it. You can pay me back in snacks later.
lines.zh: 给，我先垫上。回头你用零食还我。

lines.en: You're a lifesaver. Remind me to never doubt your grocery wisdom again.
lines.zh: 你真是救命恩人。以后我再也不怀疑你的买菜智慧了。

lines.en: Oh, you will. Everyone does. It's the circle of grocery life.
lines.zh: 哦，你会的。大家都这样。这是买菜的循环人生。

lines.en: Okay, but the real question — did I get everything on the list?
lines.zh: 好吧，但真正的问题是——清单上的东西我买齐了吗？

lines.en: Let's check. Tomatoes, onions, soy sauce... eggs. Jake. Where are the eggs?
lines.zh: 我们对对。西红柿、洋葱、酱油……鸡蛋。Jake。鸡蛋呢？

lines.en: ...The eggs.
lines.zh: ……鸡蛋。

lines.en: The eggs, Jake.
lines.zh: 鸡蛋，Jake。

lines.en: I'll go back. Don't tell my mom about the five yuan.
lines.zh: 我回去拿。那五块钱的事别告诉我妈。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are the phrases you'll need on your own grocery run.
lines.zh: 放慢。来听几句你自己去买菜时会用到的表达。

lines.en: She gave me the shopping list.
lines.zh: 她把购物清单给我了。

lines.en: Grab a basket.
lines.zh: 拿个篮子。

lines.en: I'm short on money.
lines.zh: 我钱不够了。

lines.en: Did I get everything on the list?
lines.zh: 清单上的东西我买齐了吗？

lines.en: It's written in code.
lines.zh: 那是用密码写的。

lines.en: A mom list.
lines.zh: 妈妈式清单。

lines.en: First rule of grocery shopping.
lines.zh: 买菜第一定律。

lines.en: It's a rite of passage.
lines.zh: 这是一种成长仪式。

lines.en: I'm short.
lines.zh: 我钱不够了。

lines.en: I'll cover it.
lines.zh: 我先垫上。

lines.en: You're a lifesaver.
lines.zh: 你真是救命恩人。

lines.en: Don't tell my mom.
lines.zh: 别告诉我妈。

lines.en: Your turn: in English, list three things you'd buy at the supermarket, and describe one of them so someone could pick it out for you.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语列出你要在超市买的三样东西，并描述其中一样，让另一个人能照着帮你挑出来。

lines.en: Tomorrow, we race against the clock — the bell is about to ring, and Jake is still three blocks away. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 明天，我们跟时间赛跑——上课铃快响了，Jake 还在三条街外。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 迟到风波
episodes.desc: 一路狂奔，还是差一步进教室

lines.en: Mia. The bell rings in four minutes. I'm still at the corner store. Tell me it's not over.
lines.zh: Mia。四分钟后上课铃响。我还在街角便利店。告诉我还有救。

lines.en: Corner store? Jake, what are you even doing there?
lines.zh: 便利店？Jake，你去那儿干嘛？

lines.en: I forgot my lunch. And my homework. And, apparently, my sense of time.
lines.zh: 我忘了带午饭。忘了带作业。看来也忘了带时间观念。

lines.en: Being late. It happens to everyone, but some of us turn it into an art form. Today, Jake attempts the four-minute dash.
lines.zh: 迟到。谁都经历过，但有人把它玩成了艺术。今天，Jake 挑战四分钟冲刺。

lines.en: Spoiler: it does not go as planned.
lines.zh: 剧透：事情没按计划走。

lines.en: Forget the corner store. Just run. What's your plan?
lines.zh: 别管便利店了。快跑。你打算怎么办？

lines.en: Run to the crossing, hope the light is green, then sprint the last block.
lines.zh: 跑到路口，盼着是绿灯，然后最后一段冲刺。

lines.en: That's not a plan, that's a wish.
lines.zh: 那不是计划，那叫许愿。

lines.en: I'll take a wish. It's all I have!
lines.zh: 有愿可许就不错了。我只有这个了！

lines.en: Okay, update me at the gate. If you make it, you owe me a story.
lines.zh: 好，到校门口再跟我说。要是赶上了，你欠我一个故事。

lines.en: Deal. Oh no — the crossing guard is holding everyone. The light is red. Of course it's red.
lines.zh: 成交。哦不——护导员把大家拦住了。是红灯。果然是红灯。

lines.en: Deep breaths. Once it turns green, you've got maybe thirty seconds.
lines.zh: 深呼吸。一变绿，你大概有三十秒。

lines.en: It's green! I'm running. I can see the gate. This might actually work!
lines.zh: 绿了！我在跑。能看见校门了。这次可能真行！

lines.en: Go, go, go!
lines.zh: 冲，冲，冲！

lines.en: I'm here! I'm... at the gate. And the bell just rang. I missed it by five seconds.
lines.zh: 我到了！我……到校门口了。而铃刚刚响。就差五秒。

lines.en: Five seconds. So close. Here's what happened at the classroom door.
lines.zh: 五秒。就差一点。听听教室门口发生了什么。

lines.en: Five seconds? That's brutal. What did the teacher say?
lines.zh: 五秒？太惨了。老师怎么说？

lines.en: She looked at me, at her watch, and said, 'Nice of you to join us, Jake.'
lines.zh: 她看看我，又看看表，说：'Jake，您肯来上课，我们不胜荣幸。'

lines.en: Ouch. The watch look. That's the worst.
lines.zh: 哎哟。看一眼手表。那最扎心。

lines.en: I said, 'I'm sorry, I was helping a lost dog.' It wasn't even true, and she knew it.
lines.zh: 我说：'对不起，我在帮一条走丢的狗。'这根本不是真的，她也知道。

lines.en: You used the lost dog excuse? That's like, the oldest one in the book.
lines.zh: 你居然用'帮走丢的狗'当借口？那都是最老套的了。

lines.en: In my panic, my brain served me a classic. I'm not proud.
lines.zh: 我一慌，脑子给我上了个老古董。我不以此为荣。

lines.en: Well, lesson learned: pack your bag the night before. Or, you know, just be honest.
lines.zh: 总之，教训就是：前一晚把书包收拾好。或者，干脆老实交代。

lines.en: Honesty. Right. I'll try that next time — in about two weeks, when I'm late again.
lines.zh: 老实交代。行。下次我试试——大概两周后，我再次迟到的时候。

lines.en: Slow it down. Here are the phrases you'll want when the clock is against you.
lines.zh: 放慢。来听几句当时间跟你作对时你会用到的表达。

lines.en: The bell rings in four minutes.
lines.zh: 四分钟后上课铃响。

lines.en: What's your plan?
lines.zh: 你打算怎么办？

lines.en: I missed it by five seconds.
lines.zh: 就差五秒。

lines.en: Nice of you to join us.
lines.zh: 您肯来，我们不胜荣幸（反讽）。

lines.en: Tell me it's not over.
lines.zh: 告诉我还有救。

lines.en: What are you even doing there?
lines.zh: 你去那儿干嘛？

lines.en: That's not a plan, that's a wish.
lines.zh: 那不是计划，那叫许愿。

lines.en: You owe me a story.
lines.zh: 你欠我一个故事。

lines.en: This might actually work.
lines.zh: 这次可能真行。

lines.en: The watch look.
lines.zh: 看一眼手表（的那一下）。

lines.en: The oldest one in the book.
lines.zh: 最老套的那种。

lines.en: Lesson learned.
lines.zh: 教训记住了。

lines.en: Your turn: in English, explain to someone why you were late — but this time, tell the truth, in three sentences.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语向别人解释你为什么迟到——但这次，说真话，用三句话。

lines.en: Tomorrow, the classroom gets rearranged, and suddenly everyone has an opinion about where to sit. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 明天，教室要重新排座位，突然之间人人都对坐哪儿有自己的看法。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 换座位
episodes.desc: 老师宣布换座位，有人欢喜有人愁

lines.en: Big news, Mia. Mr. Lee announced a seat change. My whole world is about to end.
lines.zh: 大新闻，Mia。李老师宣布要换座位。我的整个世界都要塌了。

lines.en: A seat change? That's not world-ending. That's... Tuesday.
lines.zh: 换座位？那不至于世界末日。那只是……一个普通周二。

lines.en: You don't understand. I've had the corner seat by the window for two months. Two months!
lines.zh: 你不懂。靠窗的角落座位我坐两个月了。两个月！

lines.en: Seat changes. The teacher calls it 'a fresh start'. The students call it 'the end of civilization'. Today, Jake's precious window seat is on the line.
lines.zh: 换座位。老师管这叫'重新开始'。同学们管这叫'文明终结'。今天，Jake 心爱的靠窗座位岌岌可危。

lines.en: But as it turns out, the new arrangement has a surprise in store.
lines.zh: 不过事实证明，新座位安排藏着个惊喜。

lines.en: Why are you so attached to that seat anyway?
lines.zh: 你怎么那么舍不得那个座位？

lines.en: The light is perfect for napping — I mean, studying. And I can see the sports field.
lines.zh: 那里的光线特别适合打盹——我是说学习。而且能看见操场。

lines.en: You can see the sports field from a window seat in the back corner? During class?
lines.zh: 上课时，你从后排靠窗的座位能看见操场？

lines.en: I said I can see it. I didn't say I look at it. Much.
lines.zh: 我说的是能看见。没说我老看。没怎么看。

lines.en: Right. Well, maybe the new seat will be good for you.
lines.zh: 行。也许新座位对你有好处。

lines.en: Unless it's front row center. Then it's over for me and my quiet napping career.
lines.zh: 除非是正中间第一排。那我的安静打盹生涯就彻底完了。

lines.en: Front row is actually great for grades. You can't zone out when the teacher is two feet away.
lines.zh: 第一排其实对成绩特别好。老师就在两尺外，你想走神都难。

lines.en: Exactly my point. That's the problem.
lines.zh: 这正是问题所在。

lines.en: The new seating chart went up. Here's where everyone landed.
lines.zh: 新座位表贴出来了。看看大家都坐哪儿。

lines.en: So? Where did they put you?
lines.zh: 所以呢？把你分到哪儿了？

lines.en: Window seat. Still. Different window, but still a window.
lines.zh: 靠窗。还是靠窗。换了扇窗，但还是窗。

lines.en: See? Not world-ending. Now, who's next to you?
lines.zh: 看吧？不是世界末日。那你旁边是谁？

lines.en: That's the surprise. It's you. They put us together.
lines.zh: 惊喜就在这。是你。咱俩被分到一起了。

lines.en: Me? We're desk mates now?
lines.zh: 我？咱俩现在是同桌了？

lines.en: Desk mates. Front of the class is safe, my napping days are not over, and my desk mate is my best friend.
lines.zh: 同桌。讲台前安全了，我的打盹生涯保住了，同桌还是我最好的朋友。

lines.en: That's suspiciously lucky. Did you bribe someone?
lines.zh: 这也太走运了。你是不是贿赂谁了？

lines.en: I'd never. Though I did help Mr. Lee carry some books yesterday, completely by coincidence.
lines.zh: 我才不会。虽然昨天我'碰巧'帮李老师搬了几本书，纯属巧合。

lines.en: Jake. What did you do?
lines.zh: Jake。你干了什么？

lines.en: Nothing! I just... mentioned how well we study together. As friends. For science.
lines.zh: 没什么！我只是……提了提咱俩一起学习效率多高。作为朋友。为了学习。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are the lines that come with every new seating chart.
lines.zh: 放慢。来听几句每次换座位都会出现的表达。

lines.en: Mr. Lee announced a seat change.
lines.zh: 李老师宣布要换座位。

lines.en: Why are you so attached to that seat?
lines.zh: 你怎么那么舍不得那个座位？

lines.en: Where did they put you?
lines.zh: 把你分到哪儿了？

lines.en: We're desk mates now.
lines.zh: 咱俩现在是同桌了。

lines.en: My whole world is about to end.
lines.zh: 我的整个世界都要塌了（夸张）。

lines.en: That's just Tuesday.
lines.zh: 那只是个普通周二。

lines.en: The light is perfect for napping.
lines.zh: 那光线特别适合打盹。

lines.en: Unless it's front row center.
lines.zh: 除非是正中间第一排。

lines.en: You can't zone out when...
lines.zh: 当……的时候你想走神都难。

lines.en: That's suspiciously lucky.
lines.zh: 这也太走运了。

lines.en: Completely by coincidence.
lines.zh: 纯属巧合。

lines.en: For science.
lines.zh: 为了学习（开玩笑）。

lines.en: Your turn: in English, describe your ideal seat in a classroom, and give one reason why it's the best spot.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语描述你在教室里理想的位置，并给出一个它是最好的理由。

lines.en: Tomorrow, we go to the quietest place in school — and try very hard not to get kicked out of it. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 明天，我们走进学校最安静的地方——然后拼命不让自己被赶出来。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 图书馆借书
episodes.desc: 在图书馆找书、借书，还差点闹笑话

lines.en: Okay, Mia. The library. I'm here. What am I supposed to be looking for again?
lines.zh: 好，Mia。图书馆。我到了。我到底要找什么来着？

lines.en: A book. For the English report. You said you'd start today, remember?
lines.zh: 一本书。为了英语报告。你说今天开始，记得吗？

lines.en: I remember saying it. I didn't remember it being today.
lines.zh: 我记得我说过。我不记得是今天。

lines.en: The school library. Rows of books, soft whispers, and that one librarian who can hear a candy wrapper from across the room. Today, Jake has a report to write.
lines.zh: 学校图书馆。一排排书，轻声细语，还有一位隔着半个房间都能听见糖纸声的图书管理员。今天，Jake 有份报告要写。

lines.en: Mia is here to make sure he actually finds a book instead of just finding the comfy chair.
lines.zh: Mia 在这儿，是为了确保他真的找到一本书，而不是只找到那张舒服的椅子。

lines.en: First, what's your report about?
lines.zh: 首先，你的报告写什么？

lines.en: Any book. The teacher said 'something you've actually read' — which is where it gets tricky.
lines.zh: 随便什么书。老师说'得是你真读过的'——问题就出在这儿。

lines.en: So we need something short, interesting, and finishable in one week.
lines.zh: 所以我们要找一本短的、有趣的、一周能读完的。

lines.en: Short, interesting, and doesn't make me fall asleep. That's the dream.
lines.zh: 短、有趣、还不会让我睡着。这就是理想。

lines.en: Try the adventure section. Those books grab you fast.
lines.zh: 去冒险类书架看看。那类书一开始就抓人。

lines.en: Adventure. Okay. Wait — is this one about a kid who finds a map? I think I've heard of it.
lines.zh: 冒险类。好。等等——这本是讲一个孩子找到张地图的吗？我好像听说过。

lines.en: That sounds perfect. Read the back cover. It usually sells the whole book in two lines.
lines.zh: 那太合适了。读读封底。封底两句话就能把整本书推销给你。

lines.en: 'One ordinary boy. One impossible map. One summer to save a lost world.' Okay, I'm in.
lines.zh: '一个普通男孩。一张不可能的地图。一个夏天，拯救一个失落的世界。'好，我决定看这本。

lines.en: Told you. Back cover magic.
lines.zh: 早跟你说了。封底的魔力。

lines.en: The hard part was next: actually checking the book out. Here's what happened at the desk.
lines.zh: 接下来才是难点：真正把书借出去。听听在借阅台发生了什么。

lines.en: I'm at the desk. The librarian asked for my card, and I panicked. I think I gave her my bus card.
lines.zh: 我到借阅台了。管理员问我要借书证，我一慌，好像把公交卡递过去了。

lines.en: Your bus card? To check out a library book?
lines.zh: 公交卡？拿去借图书馆的书？

lines.en: In my defense, they're both blue. And rectangular. And I was nervous.
lines.zh: 替自己说句公道话，两张都是蓝色的。都是长方形。而且我紧张。

lines.en: What did she say?
lines.zh: 她说什么了？

lines.en: She didn't even blink. Just said, 'That won't get you on the number seven bus, dear. Library card, please.'
lines.zh: 她眼睛都没眨一下。就说：'亲爱的，这个可上不了七路公交。请拿借书证。'

lines.en: She sounds great, honestly.
lines.zh: 听起来这位管理员挺有意思。

lines.en: She's seen it all. Anyway, I got the book. Two weeks, she said. 'Bring it back or the fine finds you.'
lines.zh: 她什么没见过。总之我借到了。两周，她说。'按时还，不然罚金会自己找上门。'

lines.en: I like her already. Now let's find a quiet corner and start chapter one.
lines.zh: 我已经喜欢上她了。现在找个安静的角落，从第一章开始。

lines.en: Slow it down. Here are the phrases you'll need at your own library.
lines.zh: 放慢。来听几句你在图书馆会需要的表达。

lines.en: What am I supposed to be looking for?
lines.zh: 我到底要找什么？

lines.en: Try the adventure section.
lines.zh: 去冒险类书架看看。

lines.en: Read the back cover.
lines.zh: 读读封底。

lines.en: Checking out a book.
lines.zh: 借一本书。

lines.en: What am I supposed to be looking for?
lines.zh: 我到底要找什么？

lines.en: Where it gets tricky.
lines.zh: 问题就出在这儿。

lines.en: Those books grab you fast.
lines.zh: 那类书一开始就抓人。

lines.en: I'm in.
lines.zh: 我决定看这个 / 我参加。

lines.en: Back cover magic.
lines.zh: 封底的魔力。

lines.en: In my defense.
lines.zh: 替自己说句公道话。

lines.en: She didn't even blink.
lines.zh: 她眼睛都没眨一下。

lines.en: Bring it back or the fine finds you.
lines.zh: 按时还，不然罚金找上门。

lines.en: Your turn: in English, describe a book you'd recommend, in two sentences, like you're reading its back cover.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语推荐一本书，用两句话，就像在念它的封底介绍。

lines.en: Tomorrow, it's your day to hold the chalk — and the whole class is watching. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 明天，轮到你去擦黑板——全班都看着呢。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 值日生
episodes.desc: 轮到值日，擦黑板、扫地、倒垃圾的日常

lines.en: Mia, remind me — whose turn is it to be on duty today?
lines.zh: Mia，提醒我一下——今天轮到谁值日？

lines.en: Yours, Jake. It's literally written on the board. In your handwriting.
lines.zh: 你的，Jake。黑板上明明白白写着呢。还是你本人的笔迹。

lines.en: I wrote that last week. It felt like a future-me problem. Future-me is now current-me, and I regret everything.
lines.zh: 那是我上周写的。当时觉得是'未来的我'的事。现在'未来的我'成了'现在的我'，我后悔极了。

lines.en: Being on duty. Someone has to wipe the board, sweep the floor, and take out the trash. Today, that someone is Jake — and he has a plan to make it painless.
lines.zh: 值日。总得有人擦黑板、扫地、倒垃圾。今天，那个人是 Jake——而他有个让这事变轻松的计划。

lines.en: Spoiler: the plan involves a lot of complaining, and one very small epiphany.
lines.zh: 剧透：这个计划包含大量抱怨，以及一个非常微小的顿悟。

lines.en: So what's the duty list today?
lines.zh: 今天值日要干什么？

lines.en: Wipe the board, sweep, and empty the bins. The unholy trinity.
lines.zh: 擦黑板、扫地、倒垃圾桶。噩梦三件套。

lines.en: That's like fifteen minutes of work. You're acting like it's a marathon.
lines.zh: 那也就十五分钟的活儿。你搞得跟跑马拉松似的。

lines.en: Fifteen minutes? Have you ever swept this classroom? The dust here has its own zip code.
lines.zh: 十五分钟？你扫过这间教室吗？这里的灰尘都有自己的邮编了。

lines.en: Okay, here's a trick. Do the board first, while everyone's packing up. By the time they leave, that's done.
lines.zh: 行，教你一招。先擦黑板，趁大家收拾东西的时候。等他们走了，黑板也擦完了。

lines.en: That's... actually smart. Then the floor is empty and I can sweep in peace.
lines.zh: 这……确实聪明。然后地上没人了，我可以安心扫地。

lines.en: Exactly. And the bins last, on your way out. No backtracking.
lines.zh: 没错。垃圾桶最后倒，正好顺路出去。不用来回跑。

lines.en: You've clearly done this a thousand times.
lines.zh: 你显然干过一千回了。

lines.en: I used to be on duty with my old desk mate, who vanished every single time. I learned to do it fast and alone.
lines.zh: 我以前跟旧同桌一起值日，那人每次都溜号。我只好练出一手又快又独的活儿。

lines.en: Fifteen minutes later, the classroom is spotless, and Jake found his epiphany in a dustpan.
lines.zh: 十五分钟后，教室一尘不染，而 Jake 在簸箕里找到了他的顿悟。

lines.en: See? All done. And you still made it home for dinner.
lines.zh: 看吧？全干完了。你还赶得上回家吃晚饭。

lines.en: I hate to admit it, but doing it in the right order made it feel... easy.
lines.zh: 我不想承认，但按正确顺序干，确实……挺轻松。

lines.en: Everything's easier with a plan. Even sweeping.
lines.zh: 凡事有计划就轻松。连扫地都是。

lines.en: Okay, wise one. Next time it's my duty day, I'm using your system.
lines.zh: 行，智者大人。下次我值日，就用你那套方法。

lines.en: Next time, just don't write your own name on the board in advance. That's how they get you.
lines.zh: 下次，别提前把自己的名字写上黑板。他们就是这么逮住你的。

lines.en: Lesson learned. Future-me can take care of future-me.
lines.zh: 教训记住了。'未来的我'就交给'未来的我'去操心吧。

lines.en: That's the spirit. Now help me push these chairs in.
lines.zh: 就是这个劲儿。现在帮我把椅子推进去。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are the lines you'll use when it's your turn to be on duty.
lines.zh: 放慢。来听几句轮到你值日时会用到的表达。

lines.en: Whose turn is it to be on duty?
lines.zh: 今天轮到谁值日？

lines.en: Wipe the board first.
lines.zh: 先擦黑板。

lines.en: Do the bins last, on your way out.
lines.zh: 垃圾桶最后倒，顺路出去。

lines.en: Everything's easier with a plan.
lines.zh: 凡事有计划就轻松。

lines.en: Whose turn is it?
lines.zh: 轮到谁了？

lines.en: It's written on the board.
lines.zh: 黑板上写着呢。

lines.en: A future-me problem.
lines.zh: 一个'未来的我'的问题。

lines.en: The unholy trinity.
lines.zh: 噩梦三件套（夸张）。

lines.en: You're acting like it's a marathon.
lines.zh: 你搞得跟跑马拉松似的。

lines.en: No backtracking.
lines.zh: 不用来回跑。

lines.en: That's how they get you.
lines.zh: 他们就是这么逮住你的。

lines.en: That's the spirit.
lines.zh: 就是这个劲儿。

lines.en: Your turn: in English, explain your plan for finishing a chore quickly, in three steps.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语分三步说明你快速完成一件杂务的计划。

lines.en: Tomorrow, we raise our hand, clear our throat, and actually say something in class. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 明天，我们举起手、清清嗓子，在课堂上真的开口说点什么。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 课堂发言
episodes.desc: 想发言又不敢，最终鼓起勇气举手

lines.en: Mia, I have to answer a question in class today. In front of everyone. I'd rather fight a bear.
lines.zh: Mia，我今天上课得回答问题。当着所有人的面。我宁可去跟熊打架。

lines.en: A bear? That's your comparison? You'll survive one question, Jake.
lines.zh: 熊？你就这么比喻？回答一个问题而已，你死不了的，Jake。

lines.en: You don't get it. When I know the answer and raise my hand, my brain goes completely blank.
lines.zh: 你不懂。每当我知道答案、举起手，我的大脑就一片空白。

lines.en: Speaking up in class. For some students, it's the easiest thing in the world. For the rest of us, it feels like jumping off a high board. Today, Jake is about to jump.
lines.zh: 课堂发言。对有些同学来说，这是世界上最简单的事。对我们其他人来说，像从高台跳水。今天，Jake 就要跳了。

lines.en: And he has a very specific reason to do it.
lines.zh: 而且他有一个非常具体的理由。

lines.en: Okay, first question — why today? What changed?
lines.zh: 好，先问一句——为什么是今天？什么变了？

lines.en: My English grade. It's... let's say it needs CPR. Participating in class is part of the score.
lines.zh: 我的英语成绩。它……这么说吧，需要做心肺复苏了。课堂参与是评分的一部分。

lines.en: So you need the participation points.
lines.zh: 所以你需要课堂参与分。

lines.en: Exactly. But every time I try, my hand feels like it weighs a hundred kilos.
lines.zh: 没错。可每次我想举手，手就像有一百公斤重。

lines.en: Here's a trick. Don't aim for a perfect answer. Just aim to say one thing. Even a simple one.
lines.zh: 教你一招。别追求完美答案。就想着说一句话。哪怕很简单的一句。

lines.en: One thing. Not the whole brilliant answer. Just... something.
lines.zh: 一句话。不是整套精彩答案。就……说点什么。

lines.en: Right. The first time, you just open your mouth. That's the win.
lines.zh: 对。第一次，你只需要开口。开口就是胜利。

lines.en: That actually helps. Lower the bar, and suddenly it's not so scary.
lines.zh: 这还真有用。把目标放低，突然就没那么吓人了。

lines.en: Class started. The question came. And here's what Jake actually said.
lines.zh: 上课了。问题来了。听听 Jake 到底说了什么。

lines.en: So? How did it go? Tell me everything.
lines.zh: 所以呢？怎么样？快全告诉我。

lines.en: The teacher asked what the main idea of the story was. I knew it. My hand went up. My heart was pounding.
lines.zh: 老师问这个故事的主旨是什么。我知道答案。我举起了手。心跳得厉害。

lines.en: And then?
lines.zh: 然后呢？

lines.en: I said, 'It's about never giving up.' Not fancy. Just one sentence.
lines.zh: 我说：'它是关于永不放弃。'不花哨。就一句话。

lines.en: Jake, that's a good answer! Simple and right.
lines.zh: Jake，这是个好答案！简单又正确。

lines.en: The teacher said, 'Exactly right, Jake.' And the world didn't end. My legs were shaking, but the world didn't end.
lines.zh: 老师说：'完全正确，Jake。'而世界没有末日。我腿在抖，但世界没有末日。

lines.en: I told you. One thing. That's all it takes.
lines.zh: 早跟你说了。一句话。就这么简单。

lines.en: Next class, I'm raising my hand again. Maybe even saying two sentences. Don't get too excited.
lines.zh: 下节课，我还要举手。也许说两句话。别太激动。

lines.en: Slow it down. Here are the phrases that help when your hand is shaking.
lines.zh: 放慢。来听几句当你手发抖时能帮上忙的表达。

lines.en: I have to answer a question in class.
lines.zh: 我上课得回答问题。

lines.en: My brain goes completely blank.
lines.zh: 我的大脑一片空白。

lines.en: Just aim to say one thing.
lines.zh: 就想着说一句话。

lines.en: The world didn't end.
lines.zh: 世界没有末日。

lines.en: I'd rather fight a bear.
lines.zh: 我宁可去跟熊打架（夸张）。

lines.en: My brain goes blank.
lines.zh: 我的大脑一片空白。

lines.en: It needs CPR.
lines.zh: 它需要做心肺复苏了（夸张说成绩差）。

lines.en: Lower the bar.
lines.zh: 把目标放低。

lines.en: That's the win.
lines.zh: 那就是胜利。

lines.en: Tell me everything.
lines.zh: 快全告诉我。

lines.en: Exactly right.
lines.zh: 完全正确。

lines.en: Don't get too excited.
lines.zh: 别太激动。

lines.en: Your turn: in English, say one sentence out loud that you'd feel proud to say in class. Then say it again, a little louder.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语大声说一句你在课堂上说出来会感到自豪的话。然后再大点声说一遍。

lines.en: Tomorrow, a brand-new face walks through the classroom door — and everyone wants to know their story. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 明天，一张全新的面孔走进教室门——人人都想知道他们的故事。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 新来的转学生
episodes.desc: 班里来了转学生，怎么帮他融入

lines.en: Did you see the new student? He was sitting in the back, looking at his desk like it was a map.
lines.zh: 你看见那个新同学了吗？他坐在后排，盯着自己的课桌，像在看一张地图。

lines.en: Yeah, his name's David. Moved here last week from another city.
lines.zh: 看见了，他叫 David。上周从另一个城市搬来的。

lines.en: I remember being that kid. You were the one who talked to me first.
lines.zh: 我记得自己当年也是那样。你是第一个跟我说话的人。

lines.en: The new student. They walk in, everyone stares, and suddenly the classroom feels like a stage. Today, Jake remembers exactly how that felt — because he was that kid not long ago.
lines.zh: 转学生。他们走进来，人人盯着看，教室突然变成了舞台。今天，Jake 清楚记得那是什么感受——因为不久前他自己就是那个孩子。

lines.en: And now, it's his turn to be the friendly face.
lines.zh: 而现在，轮到他来做那张友善的面孔了。

lines.en: So what are you going to do about it?
lines.zh: 那你打算怎么办？

lines.en: I'm going to talk to him at lunch. You know, like you did with me.
lines.zh: 我打算午饭时去跟他聊聊。就像你当年对我那样。

lines.en: That's sweet, Jake. But don't just say hi and leave. Ask him something real.
lines.zh: 挺暖的，Jake。但别打个招呼就走。问他点实在的。

lines.en: Like what? 'How do you like it here?' That's what everyone asks.
lines.zh: 比如什么？'你觉得这儿怎么样？'人人都这么问。

lines.en: Then ask about him. What he likes. What he used to do. People love talking about themselves.
lines.zh: 那就问他本人。他喜欢什么。他以前做什么。人都爱聊自己。

lines.en: What he likes. Okay. And maybe invite him to sit with us?
lines.zh: 他喜欢什么。好。也许再邀请他跟我们一起坐？

lines.en: Exactly. A lunch invite is worth more than ten 'hi's in the hallway.
lines.zh: 没错。一次午饭邀请，比走廊里十声'嗨'都值。

lines.en: I'll do it. Wish me luck — I'm about to be the friendly face I once needed.
lines.zh: 我去做。祝我好运——我要成为当年我自己需要的那张友善面孔了。

lines.en: Lunchtime came. Here's how the conversation with David actually went.
lines.zh: 午饭时间到了。听听跟 David 的对话实际是怎么进行的。

lines.en: So I sat down next to him and said, 'Hey, David. I'm Jake. This seat's free, and so is the spot next to me at lunch.'
lines.zh: 于是我坐到他旁边说：'嘿，David，我是 Jake。这个位子是空的，我午饭旁边的位子也空着。'

lines.en: Bold opening. How did he react?
lines.zh: 开场挺大胆。他什么反应？

lines.en: He looked surprised, then smiled. Said his old school had a football team he really missed.
lines.zh: 他先是一愣，然后笑了。说他很想念以前学校的足球队。

lines.en: See? Now you know something about him. That's a start.
lines.zh: 看吧？现在你了解他一点了。这就是个开始。

lines.en: Turns out he plays football. Guess what I do after school on Fridays?
lines.zh: 原来他踢足球。猜我周五放学后干嘛？

lines.en: Basketball. But I bet you're about to change that.
lines.zh: 打篮球。但我猜你要改主意了。

lines.en: I invited him to the field. He said yes. New kid's already got a Friday plan.
lines.zh: 我约他去球场。他答应了。新同学周五已经有安排了。

lines.en: Look at you, being the welcoming committee.
lines.zh: 瞧瞧你，当起迎新大使了。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are the phrases that turn a stranger into a friend.
lines.zh: 放慢。来听几句能把陌生人变成朋友的表达。

lines.en: He's the new student.
lines.zh: 他是新来的转学生。

lines.en: I was that kid.
lines.zh: 我当年就是那个孩子。

lines.en: Ask him something real.
lines.zh: 问他点实在的。

lines.en: This seat's free.
lines.zh: 这个位子是空的。

lines.en: Looking at his desk like it was a map.
lines.zh: 盯着课桌像在看地图。

lines.en: I remember being that kid.
lines.zh: 我记得自己当年就是那样。

lines.en: Don't just say hi and leave.
lines.zh: 别打个招呼就走。

lines.en: People love talking about themselves.
lines.zh: 人都爱聊自己。

lines.en: A lunch invite is worth ten 'hi's.
lines.zh: 一次午饭邀请胜过十声'嗨'。

lines.en: Wish me luck.
lines.zh: 祝我好运。

lines.en: That's a start.
lines.zh: 这就是个开始。

lines.en: Look at you.
lines.zh: 瞧瞧你（夸奖）。

lines.en: Your turn: in English, plan what you'd say to a new student — a greeting, one question, and one invitation.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语准备你对新同学说的话——一句问候、一个问题、一个邀请。

lines.en: Tomorrow, the school clubs throw open their doors, and everyone's trying to recruit you. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 明天，学校社团敞开大门，人人都想拉你入伙。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 社团招新
episodes.desc: 五花八门的社团，选哪个才好

lines.en: Mia, the club fair is today. There are forty clubs. Forty. How am I supposed to pick one?
lines.zh: Mia，今天社团招新。有四十个社团。四十个。我该怎么选？

lines.en: You don't pick forty. You pick one. Maybe two. What do you actually like doing?
lines.zh: 你不用选四十个。选一个。最多两个。你到底喜欢做什么？

lines.en: That's the problem. I like doing a little of everything, and a lot of nothing.
lines.zh: 问题就在这。我什么都喜欢一点点，又什么都没特别喜欢。

lines.en: The club fair. Every table has a poster, a smile, and a pitch that makes their club sound like the greatest thing since sliced bread. Today, Jake is drowning in choices.
lines.zh: 社团招新。每张桌子都有海报、笑脸，还有一套话术，把他们的社团说得天上有地下无。今天，Jake 淹没在选择里。

lines.en: Mia has a simple rule to cut through the noise.
lines.zh: Mia 有一条简单的规则，帮你拨开噪音。

lines.en: Okay, my rule is this: ignore the posters. Talk to the people.
lines.zh: 好，我的规则是：别看海报。跟人聊。

lines.en: Talk to the people? They're all standing there smiling like salespeople.
lines.zh: 跟人聊？他们一个个站在那儿笑得跟销售似的。

lines.en: Exactly why it works. Ask them one thing: what do you actually do at meetings?
lines.zh: 正因为这样才管用。问他们一个问题：你们活动时到底都干什么？

lines.en: That's... a good filter. The robot club guy was just showing me a video of a robot falling over.
lines.zh: 这……是个好筛子。机器人社那哥们刚才给我看机器人摔倒的视频。

lines.en: Did he seem excited about it, or bored?
lines.zh: 他看起来是兴奋还是无聊？

lines.en: Excited, actually. He kept laughing and said 'we're still fixing it'.
lines.zh: 其实挺兴奋。他一直笑，说'我们还在修呢'。

lines.en: That's a real club. People who laugh at their own robot are people who love it.
lines.zh: 这才是真社团。会笑话自己机器人的人，是真的热爱它。

lines.en: So by your logic, I should join the robot club because the guy laughed at a falling robot?
lines.zh: 按你的逻辑，我该加入机器人社，就因为那哥们笑一个摔倒的机器人？

lines.en: I didn't say that. I said talk to the people. Now go talk to the basketball table — I know you're curious.
lines.zh: 我可没这么说。我说的是跟人聊聊。现在去篮球社那桌——我知道你心里痒。

lines.en: After an hour, Jake made his choice. Here's how he decided.
lines.zh: 一小时后，Jake 做出了选择。听听他是怎么决定的。

lines.en: So, final answer? Which club?
lines.zh: 所以呢，最终答案？哪个社团？

lines.en: Basketball. But not because of the poster. Because the captain asked if I wanted to shoot around, not just sign up.
lines.zh: 篮球社。但不是因为海报。是因为队长问我想不想先投会儿球，而不是只让我报名。

lines.en: A club that lets you try before you buy. Smart captain.
lines.zh: 先让你试玩再决定。聪明的队长。

lines.en: And the robot club? I'll keep them on my list. That falling robot deserved better.
lines.zh: 那机器人社呢？我先把他们放待选名单里。那个摔倒的机器人值得更好。

lines.en: See? You didn't pick forty. You picked one, with a maybe in your pocket.
lines.zh: 看吧？你没选四十个。你选了一个，兜里还揣着个'待定'。

lines.en: That's the most decisive I've been all month.
lines.zh: 这是我这个月最果断的一次了。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are the phrases to survive your own club fair.
lines.zh: 放慢。来听几句帮你挺过自己那场社团招新的表达。

lines.en: How am I supposed to pick one?
lines.zh: 我该怎么选？

lines.en: Ignore the posters, talk to the people.
lines.zh: 别看海报，跟人聊。

lines.en: What do you actually do at meetings?
lines.zh: 你们活动时到底都干什么？

lines.en: Let me try before I buy.
lines.zh: 让我先试试再决定。

lines.en: A little of everything, a lot of nothing.
lines.zh: 什么都喜欢一点点，又什么都没特别喜欢。

lines.en: The greatest thing since sliced bread.
lines.zh: 天上有地下无（夸张）。

lines.en: Cut through the noise.
lines.zh: 拨开噪音。

lines.en: That's a good filter.
lines.zh: 这是个好筛子。

lines.en: Try before you buy.
lines.zh: 先试再决定。

lines.en: Keep them on my list.
lines.zh: 把他们放待选名单里。

lines.en: That's the most decisive I've been.
lines.zh: 这是我最有主见的一次。

lines.en: A maybe in your pocket.
lines.zh: 兜里揣着个'待定'。

lines.en: Your turn: in English, describe a club you'd join, and the one question you'd ask before signing up.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语描述你想加入的社团，以及报名前你会问的那个问题。

lines.en: Tomorrow, we take on the pile of homework that never seems to get smaller. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 明天，我们对付那堆似乎永远不见少的作业。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 作业太多
episodes.desc: 作业堆成山，怎么安排时间

lines.en: Mia, I've been doing homework for two hours, and the pile has not moved. I think it's growing.
lines.zh: Mia，我写作业写了两小时了，那堆东西纹丝不动。我觉得它还在长。

lines.en: That's called 'Tuesday'. How many subjects do you have left?
lines.zh: 那叫'周二'。你还有几科？

lines.en: Math, English, and a science report that's due tomorrow, which I have not started.
lines.zh: 数学、英语，还有一份明天要交、我还没动笔的科学报告。

lines.en: Homework. It piles up, it never ends, and it has a special talent for being due at the same time. Today, Jake is buried under it.
lines.zh: 作业。它越堆越多，永无止境，还特别擅长所有科目同时要交。今天，Jake 被它埋住了。

lines.en: Mia has a system that turns a mountain into a molehill.
lines.zh: Mia 有套方法，能把大山变成小土包。

lines.en: Okay, stop. What's due tomorrow?
lines.zh: 好，停一下。明天要交什么？

lines.en: The science report. And it's the hardest one.
lines.zh: 科学报告。而且是最难的那个。

lines.en: Then do the science report first. Not last.
lines.zh: 那就先写科学报告。别放最后。

lines.en: First? But it's the worst. I'd rather start with the easy stuff to warm up.
lines.zh: 先写？可它最难。我宁可先写简单的热热身。

lines.en: That's the trap. You warm up on the easy stuff, then you're tired for the hard stuff. Do the hard thing while your brain is fresh.
lines.zh: 这就是陷阱。你先拿简单的热身，然后累得不行了才碰难的。趁脑子清醒时先啃硬的。

lines.en: Hardest first. That feels backwards, but it kind of makes sense.
lines.zh: 先难后易。感觉反着来，但好像有道理。

lines.en: And break it into pieces. Report first: research, then write, then check. Three small wins instead of one giant wall.
lines.zh: 再把任务切块。报告分三步：先查资料，再写，再检查。三个小胜利，而不是一堵大墙。

lines.en: Three small wins. Okay, I can do a small win.
lines.zh: 三个小胜利。好，小胜利我做得到。

lines.en: Two hours later, the mountain was much smaller. Here's the payoff.
lines.zh: 两小时后，那座山小多了。听听成果。

lines.en: Status report?
lines.zh: 汇报一下进度？

lines.en: Science report: done. Math: done. English: half done, and I actually understood it this time.
lines.zh: 科学报告：完成。数学：完成。英语：做了一半，而且这次我真看懂了。

lines.en: See? Hardest first, and suddenly the rest feels light.
lines.zh: 看吧？先啃硬的，剩下的突然就轻了。

lines.en: I even have time to, like, breathe now. And maybe watch something before bed.
lines.zh: 我甚至有时间喘口气了。睡前也许还能看点什么。

lines.en: Don't get carried away. But yeah — a finished pile beats a perfect plan that never starts.
lines.zh: 别得意忘形。不过确实——写完的一堆，胜过一份永不开始的完美计划。

lines.en: That should be on a poster.
lines.zh: 这话该印成海报。

lines.en: It probably is. Somewhere in the school hallway, next to the one about mornings.
lines.zh: 大概真有。就在学校走廊，挨着讲早晨的那张。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are the phrases to tame your own homework pile.
lines.zh: 放慢。来听几句帮你驯服自己作业堆的表达。

lines.en: How many subjects do you have left?
lines.zh: 你还有几科？

lines.en: What's due tomorrow?
lines.zh: 明天要交什么？

lines.en: Do the hard thing while your brain is fresh.
lines.zh: 趁脑子清醒时先啃硬的。

lines.en: Break it into pieces.
lines.zh: 把任务切成小块。

lines.en: The pile has not moved.
lines.zh: 那堆东西纹丝不动。

lines.en: That's called 'Tuesday'.
lines.zh: 那叫'周二'。

lines.en: Due tomorrow.
lines.zh: 明天要交。

lines.en: That's the trap.
lines.zh: 这就是陷阱。

lines.en: That feels backwards.
lines.zh: 感觉反着来。

lines.en: Three small wins.
lines.zh: 三个小胜利。

lines.en: Status report?
lines.zh: 汇报一下进度？

lines.en: Don't get carried away.
lines.zh: 别得意忘形。

lines.en: Your turn: in English, list your homework by difficulty, and say which one you'll do first and why.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语按难度列出你的作业，并说你打算先做哪一项、为什么。

lines.en: Tomorrow, we talk about the thing that steals our sleep — staying up too late, and the scroll that never ends. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 明天，我们聊聊偷走睡眠的那件事——熬夜，和那刷不完的手机。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 晚睡习惯
episodes.desc: 晚上舍不得睡，早上起不来

lines.en: Mia, what time did you sleep last night? I need to feel better about my own choices.
lines.zh: Mia，你昨晚几点睡的？我需要用你来安慰一下自己的选择。

lines.en: Ten thirty. Like a normal human being. Why, what did you do?
lines.zh: 十点半。像个正常人一样。怎么，你干了啥？

lines.en: I said 'one more video' at eleven. The video was forty minutes long. Then there was a sequel.
lines.zh: 我十一点说'再看一个视频'。结果那视频四十分钟。然后还有续集。

lines.en: Staying up late. You tell yourself 'just one more', and suddenly it's midnight, then one, then your alarm is laughing at you. Today, Jake pays the price.
lines.zh: 熬夜。你告诉自己'就再看一个'，突然就半夜了，一点了，然后闹钟开始嘲笑你。今天，Jake 尝到了苦果。

lines.en: Mia has heard this story before. Many, many times.
lines.zh: Mia 早就听过这个故事。很多很多次了。

lines.en: So what time did you actually go to sleep?
lines.zh: 所以你到底是几点睡的？

lines.en: About one. Maybe one thirty. My phone says my screen time was six hours yesterday.
lines.zh: 大概一点。也许一点半。手机说我昨天屏幕使用时间六小时。

lines.en: Six hours? Jake, that's a part-time job.
lines.zh: 六小时？Jake，那都赶上兼职了。

lines.en: I know, I know. But at night, my brain says 'you finally have free time, don't waste it on sleep'.
lines.zh: 我知道，我知道。可一到晚上，我的大脑就说：'你终于有空了，别把时间浪费在睡觉上。'

lines.en: That's the trap. Your brain is lying. Sleep is not wasted time — it's the thing that makes tomorrow work.
lines.zh: 这就是陷阱。你的大脑在撒谎。睡觉不是浪费时间——它是让明天运转起来的东西。

lines.en: Logically, I agree. At eleven at night, logic leaves the building.
lines.zh: 理性上，我同意。可到了晚上十一点，理性就下班走人了。

lines.en: So don't trust your night brain. Make the decision in the morning, when you're smart.
lines.zh: 所以别信你'夜里的脑子'。趁早上清醒时就把决定做好。

lines.en: A morning me deciding for a night me? That might actually work.
lines.zh: 让'早上的我'替'晚上的我'做决定？这招可能真管用。

lines.en: The plan was simple: a bedtime alarm, and one small rule. Here's how the first night went.
lines.zh: 计划很简单：设一个'该睡觉'的闹钟，加上一条小规则。听听第一晚怎么样。

lines.en: So what's the new system?
lines.zh: 新方案是什么？

lines.en: A bedtime alarm at ten forty-five. When it rings, the phone goes on the charger across the room. No more scrolling in bed.
lines.zh: 十点四十五设个'该睡觉'闹钟。铃一响，手机就放到房间那头的充电器上。不再躺床上刷手机。

lines.en: Phone out of reach. Bold move. Did you survive?
lines.zh: 手机放到够不着的地方。够狠。你熬过来了吗？

lines.en: It was hard for about ten minutes. Then... I just fell asleep. Like it was nothing.
lines.zh: 前十分钟很难熬。然后……我就睡着了。跟没事一样。

lines.en: Ten forty-five beat your night brain. I'm honestly impressed.
lines.zh: 十点四十五战胜了你的'夜里的脑子'。我真心佩服。

lines.en: Me too. I woke up today and I didn't hate the world. That's new for me.
lines.zh: 我也佩服。今天醒来，我居然没恨这个世界。这对我可是头一回。

lines.en: That's called a good night's sleep, Jake. Welcome to the club.
lines.zh: 那叫睡了个好觉，Jake。欢迎加入。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are the phrases for taming your own night brain.
lines.zh: 放慢。来听几句帮你驯服自己'夜里脑子'的表达。

lines.en: What time did you sleep?
lines.zh: 你几点睡的？

lines.en: One more video.
lines.zh: 再看一个视频。

lines.en: Don't trust your night brain.
lines.zh: 别信你'夜里的脑子'。

lines.en: Phone out of reach.
lines.zh: 手机放到够不着的地方。

lines.en: I need to feel better about my choices.
lines.zh: 我需要用你来安慰一下自己的选择。

lines.en: Like a normal human being.
lines.zh: 像个正常人一样。

lines.en: That's a part-time job.
lines.zh: 那都赶上兼职了。

lines.en: Logic leaves the building.
lines.zh: 理性就下班走人了。

lines.en: Don't waste it on sleep.
lines.zh: 别把时间浪费在睡觉上。

lines.en: Make the decision when you're smart.
lines.zh: 趁清醒时把决定做好。

lines.en: Phone out of reach.
lines.zh: 手机放到够不着的地方。

lines.en: Welcome to the club.
lines.zh: 欢迎加入。

lines.en: Your turn: in English, describe one habit you'd change about your nights, and what you'd do instead.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语描述一个你想改变的夜间习惯，以及你会改成什么。

lines.en: That's batch one complete — sixteen more walks in the books. Next batch, we move to the kitchen, the shops, and the seasons. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 第一批到此完成——又多了十六次散步。下一批，我们走进厨房、商店和四季。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 早餐吃什么
episodes.desc: 中式早餐还是西式早餐？一顿好早餐怎么搭配

lines.en: Welcome back to Walk and Talk. I'm Jenny. Today, let's talk about the first meal of the day — breakfast.
lines.zh: 欢迎回到 Walk and Talk。我是 Jenny。今天我们聊聊一天的第一顿饭——早餐。

lines.en: Mia, quick question. What did you have for breakfast this morning?
lines.zh: Mia，快问一下。你今天早上早餐吃了什么？

lines.en: A bowl of porridge, a boiled egg, and a glass of milk. You?
lines.zh: 一碗粥，一个煮鸡蛋，一杯牛奶。你呢？

lines.en: Toast with jam. And I was still hungry by nine o'clock.
lines.zh: 涂果酱的吐司。结果九点我就又饿了。

lines.en: See, that's your problem. Jam toast has no staying power.
lines.zh: 看吧，这就是你的问题。果酱吐司撑不住。

lines.en: Staying power? Is that even a word?
lines.zh: 撑不住？这是词吗？

lines.en: It is now. You need protein, not just sugar.
lines.zh: 现在算。你需要蛋白质，不能光吃糖。

lines.en: Mia is right. A good breakfast keeps you full and focused. Let's hear how she explains it.
lines.zh: Mia 说得对。一顿好早餐能让你不饿又有精神。听听她怎么解释。

lines.en: Okay, so what should I eat then? Teach me, breakfast master.
lines.zh: 好吧，那我该吃啥？教教我，早餐大师。

lines.en: Easy. Eggs, milk, or soy milk for protein. Bread, noodles, or rice for energy. And fruit or vegetables.
lines.zh: 简单。鸡蛋、牛奶或豆浆补蛋白质。面包、面条或米饭给能量。再来点水果或蔬菜。

lines.en: That's a lot of work for seven in the morning.
lines.zh: 早上七点搞这些，太费劲了。

lines.en: Ten minutes, Jake. An egg takes six minutes to boil. Milk, you just pour it.
lines.zh: 十分钟，Jake。鸡蛋煮六分钟。牛奶倒一下就完事。

lines.en: What about you, Christopher? Are you a breakfast person?
lines.zh: 你呢，Christopher？你是吃早餐的人吗？

lines.en: I like a big bowl of noodles with an egg and some greens. Keeps me going till lunch.
lines.zh: 我喜欢一大碗面条，加个蛋和一点青菜。能撑到中午。

lines.en: That sounds way better than my sad toast.
lines.zh: 听起来比我那可怜的吐司强多了。

lines.en: Come over tomorrow, my dad makes the best noodles in town.
lines.zh: 明天来我家，我爸做的面条是镇上最棒的。

lines.en: Now you've done it. Jake will never leave your house.
lines.zh: 这下好了。Jake 再也不会离开你家了。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some phrases to help you talk about breakfast.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个帮你聊早餐的表达。

lines.en: What did you have for breakfast?
lines.zh: 你早餐吃了什么？

lines.en: I was still hungry by nine o'clock.
lines.zh: 结果九点我就又饿了。

lines.en: You need protein, not just sugar.
lines.zh: 你需要蛋白质，不能光吃糖。

lines.en: Keeps me going till lunch.
lines.zh: 能撑到中午。

lines.en: What did you have for breakfast?
lines.zh: 你早餐吃了什么？

lines.en: A bowl of porridge.
lines.zh: 一碗粥。

lines.en: staying power
lines.zh: 持久的饱腹感

lines.en: Keeps me going.
lines.zh: 让我撑得住。

lines.en: That's a lot of work.
lines.zh: 那太费劲了。

lines.en: Your turn: in English, tell someone what you had for breakfast today and one thing you'd change.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语说说你今天早餐吃了什么，以及你想改掉的一点。

lines.en: That's it for today. Next, we talk about drinks — bubble tea or juice? See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次我们聊聊饮品——奶茶还是果汁？下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 奶茶还是果汁
episodes.desc: 含糖饮料和健康饮品，怎么选更聪明

lines.en: Welcome back. Today's question is a sweet one — bubble tea or juice?
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天的问题很甜——奶茶还是果汁？

lines.en: Guys, I need your help. After school, do we get bubble tea or fruit juice?
lines.zh: 各位，帮个忙。放学后我们是买奶茶还是果汁？

lines.en: Depends. How much sugar do you want today?
lines.zh: 看情况。你今天想吃多少糖？

lines.en: All of it. It's been a long week.
lines.zh: 全部。这周太累了。

lines.en: Then bubble tea. But maybe get it half sweet.
lines.zh: 那选奶茶。不过最好点半糖。

lines.en: Half sweet? That's like half a hug.
lines.zh: 半糖？那跟半个拥抱一样没意思。

lines.en: Ha! Fine, but here's the thing — one bubble tea has more sugar than you think.
lines.zh: 哈！行，但问题是——一杯奶茶的糖比你想象的多。

lines.en: Here's the trick most people forget: it's not just the tea, it's the bubbles, too.
lines.zh: 这里有个大多数人会忘的点：不只是茶，珍珠也是糖。

lines.en: Wait, the bubbles are sweet too?
lines.zh: 等等，珍珠也是甜的？

lines.en: Yep. They're cooked in sugar. So the pearls plus the syrup is a lot.
lines.zh: 对。珍珠是用糖煮的。所以珍珠加上糖浆，量很大。

lines.en: So juice is better?
lines.zh: 那果汁更好？

lines.en: Not always. A bottle of sweet juice can be just as bad.
lines.zh: 不一定。一瓶甜果汁可能一样糟。

lines.en: So what am I supposed to drink, plain water?
lines.zh: 那我该喝啥，白开水？

lines.en: Water is great. But if you want a treat, get fresh fruit juice, no sugar added, or a smaller cup.
lines.zh: 水就很好。但你想解馋的话，就点鲜榨果汁、不加糖，或者小杯。

lines.en: Or just enjoy the bubble tea and don't do it every day.
lines.zh: 或者就好好享受奶茶，别天天喝就行。

lines.en: Now that's advice I can get behind.
lines.zh: 这才是我听得进去的建议。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some useful phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个有用的表达。

lines.en: Do we get bubble tea or fruit juice?
lines.zh: 我们买奶茶还是果汁？

lines.en: Maybe get it half sweet.
lines.zh: 最好点半糖。

lines.en: One bubble tea has more sugar than you think.
lines.zh: 一杯奶茶的糖比你想象的多。

lines.en: Don't do it every day.
lines.zh: 别天天喝。

lines.en: get it half sweet
lines.zh: 点半糖

lines.en: The pearls are cooked in sugar.
lines.zh: 珍珠是用糖煮的。

lines.en: just as bad
lines.zh: 一样糟

lines.en: no sugar added
lines.zh: 不加糖

lines.en: a treat
lines.zh: 解馋的东西

lines.en: Your turn: in English, say which you'd choose — bubble tea or juice — and why.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语说说你会选奶茶还是果汁，以及为什么。

lines.en: That's it for today. Next, we roll up our sleeves and cook something together. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次我们挽起袖子，一起做点吃的。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 一起做饭
episodes.desc: 学做一道简单的家常菜，用英语说步骤

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we cook. Grab your apron — this one's hands-on.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们做饭。系上围裙——这集是实操课。

lines.en: Mia, I told my mom I'd cook dinner tonight. I'm scared.
lines.zh: Mia，我跟我妈说我今晚做饭。我有点慌。

lines.en: First time cooking?
lines.zh: 第一次做饭？

lines.en: I once burned water. I don't want to talk about it.
lines.zh: 我有一次把水烧糊了。我不想聊这事。

lines.en: How do you burn water?
lines.zh: 水怎么能烧糊？

lines.en: I said I don't want to talk about it.
lines.zh: 我说了不想聊。

lines.en: Okay, okay. What are we making?
lines.zh: 好好好。那我们做什么？

lines.en: Something simple. Fried rice with egg? My grandma's recipe.
lines.zh: 简单点的。蛋炒饭？我奶奶的拿手菜。

lines.en: Perfect. Egg fried rice is easy and hard to mess up.
lines.zh: 完美。蛋炒饭简单，又不容易翻车。

lines.en: Egg fried rice is a great first dish. Let's hear the steps.
lines.zh: 蛋炒饭是很棒的第一道菜。来听听步骤。

lines.en: First, get your rice ready. Cold leftover rice is best — it doesn't stick.
lines.zh: 首先，把米饭准备好。隔夜的冷饭最好——不粘锅。

lines.en: Got it. Then?
lines.zh: 明白。然后呢？

lines.en: Beat two eggs in a bowl. Chop some green onion and any veggies you like.
lines.zh: 碗里打两个鸡蛋。切点葱和你喜欢的蔬菜。

lines.en: I can chop. I have not chopped off a finger in weeks.
lines.zh: 我会切菜。我这几周都没切到过手指。

lines.en: That's the spirit. Heat the pan, add oil, scramble the eggs. Take them out.
lines.zh: 就是这个劲头。热锅，倒油，把鸡蛋炒散。盛出来。

lines.en: Wait, take the eggs out? Why?
lines.zh: 等等，鸡蛋要盛出来？为什么？

lines.en: So they stay soft. Then fry the rice, add the eggs back, toss in the onion, and season with salt and a little soy sauce.
lines.zh: 这样鸡蛋才嫩。然后炒饭，把鸡蛋倒回去，加葱，放盐和一点点酱油调味。

lines.en: That's it? No magic wok skills?
lines.zh: 就这？不需要什么颠锅神功？

lines.en: That's it. Two minutes on high heat, and you're a chef.
lines.zh: 就这。大火两分钟，你就是大厨。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are the cooking words you'll need.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个做饭要用到的词。

lines.en: Cold leftover rice is best.
lines.zh: 隔夜的冷饭最好。

lines.en: Beat two eggs in a bowl.
lines.zh: 碗里打两个鸡蛋。

lines.en: Heat the pan and add oil.
lines.zh: 热锅，倒油。

lines.en: Season with salt and a little soy sauce.
lines.zh: 放盐和一点酱油调味。

lines.en: leftover rice
lines.zh: 剩饭

lines.en: scramble the eggs
lines.zh: 把鸡蛋炒散

lines.en: toss in the onion
lines.zh: 把葱放进去

lines.en: season with
lines.zh: 用……调味

lines.en: hard to mess up
lines.zh: 不容易搞砸

lines.en: Your turn: in English, describe how to make your favorite simple dish in three steps.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语分三步说说你最爱的一道简单菜怎么做。

lines.en: That's it for today. Next, we order in — takeout and snacks. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次我们点外卖——外卖和零食。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 外卖与零食
episodes.desc: 点外卖、聊零食，怎么说最地道

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we talk about takeout and snacks — the food that comes to you.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们聊外卖和零食——那些送到你面前的食物。

lines.en: I'm starving. Do you want to order takeout tonight?
lines.zh: 我快饿死了。今晚要不要点外卖？

lines.en: Sure. What are you in the mood for?
lines.zh: 行啊。你想吃啥？

lines.en: Noodles? Burgers? I can't decide.
lines.zh: 面？汉堡？我决定不了。

lines.en: There's a new noodle place near school. My sister says it's amazing.
lines.zh: 学校附近新开了家面馆。我姐说超棒。

lines.en: Ooh, let's try it. Do they deliver?
lines.zh: 哦，试试看。他们送外卖吗？

lines.en: Yeah, on the app. Delivery is free if we spend over thirty yuan.
lines.zh: 送，在 App 上。满三十块免配送费。

lines.en: Perfect, we're three people. We'll definitely hit thirty.
lines.zh: 完美，我们三个人。肯定能凑到三十。

lines.en: Ordering food online is easy, but there are a few good habits. Let's listen.
lines.zh: 网上点餐很简单，但有几个好习惯。来听听。

lines.en: Okay, I'm adding beef noodles. Anyone want to share some snacks?
lines.zh: 好，我加一份牛肉面。谁想一起拼点零食？

lines.en: You and your snacks. You just said you were starving.
lines.zh: 你呀，就知道零食。你刚还说快饿死了。

lines.en: Snacks are a food group, Mia. Look it up.
lines.zh: 零食是一个食物类别，Mia。不信你查。

lines.en: Maybe get some fruit or nuts instead of chips?
lines.zh: 要不要买点水果或坚果，别买薯片了？

lines.en: But chips are the whole point of a movie night.
lines.zh: 可薯片才是电影之夜的精髓啊。

lines.en: Compromise. One snack, and you pick something with protein.
lines.zh: 折中一下。只买一样零食，而且得是含蛋白质的。

lines.en: Fine. Roasted nuts it is. You guys are no fun.
lines.zh: 行。那就烤坚果。你们真没意思。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some phrases for ordering and snacking.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个点外卖和吃零食的表达。

lines.zh: 要不要点外卖？

lines.zh: 你想吃啥？

lines.en: Delivery is free if we spend over thirty yuan.
lines.zh: 满三十块免配送费。

lines.zh: 我快饿死了。

lines.zh: 想吃……

lines.zh: 他们送外卖吗？

lines.en: hit thirty
lines.zh: 凑到三十

lines.zh: 一个食物类别

lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语点你最爱吃的外卖，再说一样更健康的零食。

lines.en: That's it for today. Next, we head to the supermarket. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次我们去超市。下次散步见！

lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 逛超市
episodes.desc: 列清单、比价格，超市购物小技巧

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we go shopping at the supermarket.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们去超市购物。

lines.en: Mom gave me a list and fifty yuan. She says if I do well, I can keep the change.
lines.zh: 我妈给我一张清单和五十块。她说我表现好，剩下的钱归我。

lines.en: Now you're motivated. What's on the list?
lines.zh: 这下你有动力了。清单上有啥？

lines.en: Milk, eggs, bread, and some vegetables. Easy.
lines.zh: 牛奶、鸡蛋、面包，还有点蔬菜。简单。

lines.en: Careful. The trick is not to walk past the snacks aisle.
lines.zh: 小心点。诀窍是别路过零食区。

lines.en: I have a plan. I'll go in, grab, pay, and get out.
lines.zh: 我有计划。进去，拿东西，付钱，走人。

lines.en: That's what everyone says. Then the cookies start calling your name.
lines.zh: 每个人都这么说。然后饼干就开始喊你的名字了。

lines.en: Supermarkets are designed to make you buy more. Here's how to shop smart.
lines.zh: 超市就是设计来让你多买的。来听听怎么聪明购物。

lines.en: Okay, I'm here. First stop, the milk. But there are five brands and three sizes.
lines.zh: 好，我到了。第一站，牛奶。但有五个牌子、三种规格。

lines.en: Check the price per liter, not just the price. The big bottle is usually cheaper.
lines.zh: 看每升的单价，别只看价格。大瓶通常更划算。

lines.en: Smart. How do I know which is fresher?
lines.zh: 聪明。怎么知道哪个更新鲜？

lines.en: Check the date. Pick the one with the latest sell-by date.
lines.zh: 看日期。选保质期最靠后的。

lines.en: Got it. Eggs next. Some boxes are half the price of others.
lines.zh: 明白。接下来鸡蛋。有些盒子价格只有别的一半。

lines.en: Cheaper eggs are fine if they're not broken. Open the box and check.
lines.zh: 便宜的鸡蛋只要没破就行。打开盒子检查一下。

lines.en: This is like a video game, but I win real money.
lines.zh: 这跟打游戏一样，但我赢的是真钱。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some shopping phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个购物表达。

lines.zh: 清单上有啥？

lines.zh: 看每升的单价。

lines.en: Pick the one with the latest sell-by date.
lines.zh: 选保质期最靠后的。

lines.zh: 打开盒子检查一下。

lines.zh: 剩下零钱归我

lines.en: That's it for today. Next, we buy school supplies. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次我们买文具。下次散步见！

lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 买文具
episodes.desc: 新学期买文具，如何不花冤枉钱

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, a small but fun topic — buying stationery.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天是个小但有趣的话题——买文具。

lines.en: New semester, new pens. I love stationery season.
lines.zh: 新学期，新笔。我超爱文具季。

lines.en: You and half the school. The stationery shop was packed yesterday.
lines.zh: 你和半个学校的人都一样。昨天文具店挤爆了。

lines.en: I know, I saw the line. Some kids had three baskets.
lines.zh: 我知道，我看到排队了。有的同学拿了三个篮子。

lines.en: You only have two hands. Why do people buy so much?
lines.zh: 你只有两只手。大家干嘛买那么多？

lines.en: Cute erasers, fancy notebooks... they're like a trap.
lines.zh: 可爱的橡皮、漂亮的笔记本……跟陷阱似的。

lines.en: I will not be trapped. I have a list this year.
lines.zh: 我今年不会被套路。我有清单。

lines.en: A list helps, but there's more to smart stationery shopping. Let's listen.
lines.zh: 清单有用，但聪明买文具还有更多门道。来听听。

lines.en: First on my list: three pens, two pencils, and a notebook.
lines.zh: 清单第一项：三支笔，两支铅笔，一个笔记本。

lines.en: Buy pens you can refill. They cost more at first but last forever.
lines.zh: 买能换笔芯的笔。一开始贵点，但能用很久。

lines.en: Good point. What about notebooks? Some are so pretty.
lines.zh: 有道理。笔记本呢？有些太好看了。

lines.en: Check the paper. If the paper is thin, ink goes through to the other side.
lines.zh: 看纸张。如果纸太薄，墨水会渗到背面。

lines.en: I never thought about that.
lines.zh: 我从来没想过这个。

lines.en: And skip the ten-piece eraser set. One good eraser is enough.
lines.zh: 还有别买十件套橡皮。一块好橡皮就够了。

lines.en: But they smell like fruit...
lines.zh: 可它们有水果味啊……

lines.en: And that's how they get you.
lines.zh: 看吧，这就是他们套路你的方式。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some phrases for the stationery shop.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个文具店的表达。

lines.en: The stationery shop was packed.
lines.zh: 文具店挤爆了。

lines.en: Buy pens you can refill.
lines.zh: 买能换笔芯的笔。

lines.en: Check the paper.
lines.zh: 看纸张。

lines.en: Ink goes through to the other side.
lines.zh: 墨水会渗到背面。

lines.zh: 文具季

lines.zh: 能换笔芯的

lines.zh: 能用很久

lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语说出三样文具，再说说哪一样你愿意多花点钱。

lines.en: That's it for today. Next, we learn to bargain. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次我们学砍价。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 讨价还价
episodes.desc: 在市场里砍价，几句就能省下钱

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we head to the market and learn to bargain.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们去市场学砍价。

lines.en: My aunt took me to the market today. She bargained for everything.
lines.zh: 今天我姑妈带我去市场。她买什么都砍价。

lines.en: She's a pro. How much did she save?
lines.zh: 她是高手。她省了多少？

lines.en: On a bag of apples, she saved ten yuan. The seller even laughed.
lines.zh: 一袋苹果她省了十块。卖家都笑了。

lines.en: Bargaining is normal in markets. Sellers expect it.
lines.zh: 在市场里砍价很正常。卖家都预料到了。

lines.en: I'm too shy. I just pay whatever they say.
lines.zh: 我太害羞了。他们报多少我付多少。

lines.en: That's why you're always out of pocket money by Friday.
lines.zh: 所以你的零花钱到周五就没了。

lines.en: Bargaining isn't rude — it's part of the game. Here's how to do it politely.
lines.zh: 砍价不是没礼貌——它是市场里的一部分。来听听怎么礼貌地砍。

lines.en: Okay, teach me. How do I start?
lines.zh: 好，教我。怎么开头？

lines.en: First, ask the price. Then say it's a bit high and make a lower offer.
lines.zh: 先问价格。然后说有点贵，报个低一点的价格。

lines.en: Like, 'How much is this scarf?'
lines.zh: 比如，'这条围巾多少钱？'

lines.en: Right. Seller says fifty. You say, 'That's a bit much. How about thirty-five?'
lines.zh: 对。卖家说五十。你说，'有点贵。三十五怎么样？'

lines.en: And then?
lines.zh: 然后呢？

lines.en: They'll meet you in the middle, maybe forty. You can say forty is okay, or walk away.
lines.zh: 他们会取个中间价，比如四十。你觉得四十行就说行，或者假装走开。

lines.en: Walking away works every time. They call you back.
lines.zh: 转身走人每次都管用。他们会把你喊回来。

lines.en: Really? Even with my aunt, they call her back and she already left the market.
lines.zh: 真的？我姑妈也是，她都离开市场了他们还喊她。

lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听砍价的表达。

lines.zh: 三十五怎么样？

lines.en: Will you meet me in the middle?
lines.zh: 能取个中间价吗？

lines.zh: 什么都砍价

lines.zh: 报个低一点的价格

lines.zh: 假装走开

lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语把一件五十块的东西砍到三十五。

lines.en: That's it for today. Next, we shop online. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次我们网上购物。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 网上购物
episodes.desc: 网购的方便与陷阱，如何下单更安心

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we talk about online shopping.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们聊聊网购。

lines.en: I bought a phone case online last night. It was half the price of the shop.
lines.zh: 昨晚我在网上买了个手机壳。比店里便宜一半。

lines.en: Nice. When does it arrive?
lines.zh: 不错。什么时候到？

lines.en: Tomorrow. Free shipping, too.
lines.zh: 明天。还包邮。

lines.en: Let me guess — it has no reviews and the photo looks too good.
lines.zh: 我猜猜——没有评价，照片看着太好看。

lines.en: How did you know?
lines.zh: 你怎么知道的？

lines.en: Because we've all been there. Online shopping is great, until it isn't.
lines.zh: 因为我们都踩过坑。网购很棒，直到翻车为止。

lines.en: Online shopping saves time and money, but you need a few habits. Let's listen.
lines.zh: 网购省时省钱，但你需要几个好习惯。来听听。

lines.en: Okay, so how do I shop online without getting tricked?
lines.zh: 好，那怎么网购才不被坑？

lines.en: First, check the reviews. Look at the photos from real buyers, not just the seller.
lines.zh: 首先，看评价。要看真实买家的晒图，别只看卖家的图。

lines.en: What if there are no reviews?
lines.zh: 要是没有评价呢？

lines.en: Then be careful. A brand-new seller with no reviews is a gamble.
lines.zh: 那就小心。新卖家没评价，就是赌。

lines.en: Also check the return policy. If they don't allow returns, think twice.
lines.zh: 还要看退货政策。如果不支持退货，就得三思。

lines.en: And never pay outside the app, right? My mom always says that.
lines.zh: 而且绝不在 App 外付款，对吧？我妈老这么说。

lines.en: Your mom is smart. Keep everything on the platform.
lines.zh: 你妈很聪明。所有交易都留在平台上。

lines.en: Got it. Reviews, returns, and stay on the app.
lines.zh: 明白。看评价、看退货、留在 App 里。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some online shopping phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个网购的表达。

lines.zh: 包邮。

lines.zh: 看评价。

lines.en: Check the return policy.
lines.zh: 看退货政策。

lines.zh: 便宜一半

lines.zh: 三思

lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语说说你想网购的东西，以及你会先检查什么。

lines.en: That's it for today. Next, we handle returns and refunds. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次我们处理退换货。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 退换货
episodes.desc: 买错了、坏了，怎么退怎么换

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we deal with returns and refunds.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们处理退换货。

lines.en: Remember that phone case I ordered? It arrived, and it doesn't fit.
lines.zh: 还记得我订的手机壳吗？到了，但是不合。

lines.en: Uh oh. Did the listing say it fits your phone?
lines.zh: 哎呀。商品页写适配你的手机了吗？

lines.en: It said it did. But it's loose on the sides.
lines.zh: 写了适配。但两边松垮垮的。

lines.en: Then you can return it. That's a wrong fit, not your fault.
lines.zh: 那你可以退。这是尺寸不符，不是你的错。

lines.en: Really? I thought once you buy it, it's yours forever.
lines.zh: 真的？我以为买了就是你的了，退不了。

lines.en: No way. Most apps give you seven days to return, no questions asked.
lines.zh: 才不是。大多数 App 支持七天无理由退货。

lines.en: Returning an item is easier than you think. Here's how.
lines.zh: 退货比你想的简单。来听听怎么做。

lines.en: Okay, so I open the app, find the order, and tap return?
lines.zh: 好，那我打开 App，找到订单，点退货？

lines.en: Right. Pick a reason — wrong size or item not as described.
lines.zh: 对。选个理由——尺寸不对，或商品与描述不符。

lines.en: Then they give me a refund or send a new one?
lines.zh: 然后他们退款，还是寄个新的？

lines.en: Usually you can choose. A refund goes back to your account in a few days.
lines.zh: 通常可以选。退款几天内回到你的账户。

lines.en: And keep the box and everything until it's done. Don't throw the package away.
lines.zh: 而且完成前别扔包装盒。别把包裹扔了。

lines.en: Good call. I almost recycled the box this morning.
lines.zh: 说得对。我今天早上差点把盒子回收了。

lines.en: One more thing — if the seller ignores you, complain to the platform.
lines.zh: 还有一点——如果卖家不理你，就向平台投诉。

lines.en: The platform has my back. Nice.
lines.zh: 平台会护着我。不错。

lines.zh: 你可以退。

lines.en: That's it for today. Next, the weather warms up — spring is here. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次天气转暖——春天来了。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
