episodes.title: 春天的风
episodes.desc: 万物复苏的春天，聊聊天气和出游

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, the season changes — spring is here.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天季节更替——春天来了。

lines.en: Can you feel that? The air is different today.
lines.zh: 你感觉到了吗？今天的空气不一样。

lines.en: Spring! My favorite. The trees are turning green again.
lines.zh: 春天！我的最爱。树又变绿了。

lines.en: I like the smell after the rain. It's like the whole world washed its face.
lines.zh: 我喜欢雨后的味道。就像整个世界洗了把脸。

lines.en: And the days are getting longer. We can stay out later.
lines.zh: 而且白天变长了。我们可以玩到更晚。

lines.en: I just want to fly a kite this weekend.
lines.zh: 我这周末只想放风筝。

lines.en: Kite flying? You and your grandma again?
lines.zh: 放风筝？又跟你奶奶？

lines.en: She's the kite champion. Last year we got one stuck in a tree.
lines.zh: 她是风筝冠军。去年我们有一个卡树上了。

lines.en: Spring means warmer days, more sunshine, and a chance to go outside. Let's hear what they plan.
lines.zh: 春天意味着更暖的天、更多的阳光，还有出门的机会。听听他们计划什么。

lines.en: So what's the perfect spring day for you?
lines.zh: 那你觉得完美的一天春天是什么样？

lines.en: A picnic in the park. A blanket, some fruit, and my dog.
lines.zh: 公园野餐。一块毯子，一点水果，还有我的狗。

lines.en: I'd go for a bike ride by the river. Watch the flowers open.
lines.zh: 我会去河边骑车。看花儿开。

lines.en: You two sound like a TV ad for spring.
lines.zh: 你俩听着像春天的电视广告。

lines.en: And what would the great Jake do?
lines.zh: 那伟大的 Jake 会干嘛？

lines.en: Honestly? Sleep in. Spring makes me want to nap in the sun like a cat.
lines.zh: 说实话？睡懒觉。春天让我想跟猫一样在太阳下打盹。

lines.en: That also counts as enjoying spring.
lines.zh: 那也算享受春天。

lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个春天的表达。

lines.zh: 我想放风筝。

lines.zh: 我们去公园野餐吧。

lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语三句话描述你完美的一天春天。

lines.en: That's it for today. Next, the heat arrives — hot summer. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次热浪来了——炎炎夏日。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 炎热的夏天
episodes.desc: 酷暑里怎么防暑降温，聊聊夏天

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, it's hot — really hot. Let's talk summer.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天很热——特别热。我们聊聊夏天。

lines.en: It's thirty-eight degrees. I'm melting.
lines.zh: 三十八度。我要化了。

lines.en: And it's only June. August will be worse.
lines.zh: 这才六月。八月更糟。

lines.en: Anyone want ice cream? My treat.
lines.zh: 谁想吃冰淇淋？我请客。

lines.en: You're my favorite person right now.
lines.zh: 你现在是我最喜欢的人。

lines.en: Don't just eat sugar. Drink water, too.
lines.zh: 别光吃糖。也要喝水。

lines.en: You sound like the health teacher, Mia.
lines.zh: 你听着像健康课老师，Mia。

lines.en: Hot weather can be fun, but you have to stay safe. Here's how.
lines.zh: 热天可以很好玩，但要注意安全。来听听怎么做。

lines.en: First rule of summer: drink water before you feel thirsty.
lines.zh: 夏天第一法则：渴之前就喝水。

lines.en: Why before?
lines.zh: 为什么是渴之前？

lines.en: If you feel thirsty, you're already a bit dry. It's like a late warning.
lines.zh: 等你觉得渴，身体已经有点缺水了。那是迟到的警报。

lines.en: And wear light, loose clothes. Dark colors soak up the heat.
lines.zh: 还有穿浅色、宽松的衣服。深色吸热。

lines.en: So my all-black outfit was a mistake?
lines.zh: 所以我这一身全黑是错的？

lines.en: In thirty-eight degrees? Yes, Jake. A big one.
lines.zh: 在三十八度里？是的，Jake。大错特错。

lines.en: Fine. What about swimming? That's the best part of summer.
lines.zh: 行。那游泳呢？那是夏天最棒的部分。

lines.en: Swimming is great, but never alone, and use sunscreen.
lines.zh: 游泳很棒，但千万别一个人，还要涂防晒。

lines.en: I burn like toast without sunscreen.
lines.zh: 不涂防晒我晒得跟吐司一样。

episodes.title: 秋天的收获
episodes.desc: 秋高气爽，聊聊丰收和秋游

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, the air turns cool and the leaves turn gold — autumn.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天天气转凉，树叶变成金色——秋天。

lines.en: I love autumn. Not too hot, not too cold.
lines.zh: 我喜欢秋天。不冷不热。

lines.en: And the food! Chestnuts, persimmons, sweet potatoes...
lines.zh: 还有吃的！栗子、柿子、红薯……

lines.en: You think about food in every season, don't you?
lines.zh: 你每个季节都在想吃的，对吧？

lines.en: Autumn is harvest season. It's the rule.
lines.zh: 秋天是收获季。这是规矩。

lines.en: My grandparents live on a farm. Every autumn we help bring in the rice.
lines.zh: 我爷爷奶奶住在农场。每年秋天我们都帮忙收稻子。

lines.en: Really? What's that like?
lines.zh: 真的吗？那是什么感觉？

lines.en: Hard work, but the view is amazing. Golden fields everywhere.
lines.zh: 很累，但景色超美。到处都是金黄的田野。

lines.en: Autumn is a season of change and harvest. Let's hear more about it.
lines.zh: 秋天是变化和收获的季节。来多听听。

lines.en: The leaves are so pretty right now. They go red, orange, yellow...
lines.zh: 现在的树叶真好看。变红、变橙、变黄……

lines.en: Let's go hiking in the hills before it gets too cold.
lines.zh: 趁还没太冷，我们去山里徒步吧。

lines.en: Good idea. But bring a jacket. The morning is chilly.
lines.zh: 好主意。但要带件外套。早上很凉。

lines.en: I hate the 'bring a jacket' part. It's never cold when I leave.
lines.zh: 我讨厌'带外套'这句。我出门时从来都不冷。

lines.en: And it's always cold when you come back. Layers, Jake.
lines.zh: 但你回来时总是冷。多穿几层，Jake。

lines.en: Fine. What else do we do in autumn?
lines.zh: 行。秋天我们还干嘛？

lines.en: My school has a leaf art contest. We make pictures out of fallen leaves.
lines.zh: 我们学校有树叶贴画比赛。用落叶拼成画。

lines.en: That sounds way more fun than homework.
lines.zh: 那可比作业好玩多了。

lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个秋天的表达。

lines.en: bring in the rice
lines.zh: 收稻子

lines.en: go hiking
lines.zh: 徒步

lines.en: it's chilly
lines.zh: 很凉

lines.en: layers
lines.zh: 多穿几层

lines.en: Your turn: in English, say one thing you love about autumn and one activity you'd do.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语说一件你喜欢秋天的地方，和你想做的一项活动。

lines.en: That's it for today. Next, the first snow falls — a snow day. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次初雪落下——下雪天。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 下雪天
episodes.desc: 打雪仗、堆雪人，雪天的快乐与安全

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, look outside — it's snowing!
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天看看窗外——下雪了！

lines.en: Snow! Real snow! School might even close!
lines.zh: 雪！真雪！学校说不定都停课！

lines.en: Don't get your hopes up. Last time it snowed, we still had class.
lines.zh: 别抱太大希望。上次下雪我们照样上课。

lines.en: But this is more snow. Look, it's already covering the ground.
lines.zh: 可这次雪更大。看，都盖住地面了。

lines.en: Even if we have class, we can play in the snow after school.
lines.zh: 就算上课，放学后也能玩雪。

lines.en: Snowball fight at four o'clock. Be there.
lines.zh: 四点打雪仗。不见不散。

lines.en: You're on. I've been training all year.
lines.zh: 来啊。我练了一整年。

lines.en: Snow is magical, but it's also cold and slippery. Here's how to enjoy it safely.
lines.zh: 雪很神奇，但也很冷很滑。来听听怎么安全地玩。

lines.en: First thing — gloves. My hands always freeze.
lines.zh: 第一件事——手套。我的手总是冻僵。

lines.en: And a hat. You lose a lot of heat from your head.
lines.zh: 还有帽子。热量很多从头上跑掉。

lines.en: Wear shoes with grip. The path gets icy and you don't want to slip.
lines.zh: 穿防滑的鞋。路面结冰，你不想摔跤。

lines.en: I fell last winter, in front of everyone. Never again.
lines.zh: 我去年冬天摔了，还当着大家的面。绝不再来。

lines.en: We remember. It's still on video.
lines.zh: 我们记得。视频还在呢。

lines.en: Why do you keep that video?
lines.zh: 你们干嘛留着那个视频？

lines.en: For snowy days like today.
lines.zh: 就为今天这样的雪天。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some snow-day phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个雪天的表达。

lines.zh: 雪盖住了地面。

lines.en: Let's have a snowball fight.
lines.zh: 我们来打雪仗吧。

lines.en: Wear gloves and a hat.
lines.zh: 戴手套和帽子。

lines.en: The path is icy.
lines.zh: 路面结冰了。

lines.en: get your hopes up
lines.zh: 抱太大希望

lines.zh: 打雪仗

lines.zh: 热量从头上跑掉

lines.en: shoes with grip
lines.zh: 防滑鞋

lines.en: slip
lines.zh: 滑倒

lines.en: Your turn: in English, describe what you'd do on a perfect snow day.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语描述一个完美雪天你会做什么。

lines.en: That's it for today. Next, the wind howls — a typhoon day off. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次狂风呼啸——台风停课。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 台风停课
episodes.desc: 台风天停课在家，怎么安全度过

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, the wind is howling outside — a typhoon is coming.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天外面狂风呼啸——台风要来了。

lines.en: Did you see the news? Typhoon alert! School is closed tomorrow!
lines.zh: 你看新闻了吗？台风警报！明天停课！

lines.en: I saw. My mom is taping the windows.
lines.zh: 我看到了。我妈在给窗户贴胶带。

lines.en: Taping windows? Is that a real thing?
lines.zh: 贴窗户？这是真的吗？

lines.en: Yeah, it stops the glass from flying if it breaks.
lines.zh: 对，玻璃碎了就不会乱飞。

lines.en: Okay, that's scary. So what do we do all day?
lines.zh: 好吧，听着有点吓人。那我们一整天干嘛？

lines.en: Stay inside, charge your phone, and have water and food ready.
lines.zh: 待在家里，给手机充电，备好水和食物。

lines.en: A typhoon day off sounds fun, but safety comes first. Let's listen.
lines.zh: 台风停课听着好玩，但安全第一。来听听。

lines.en: Can we at least go out and feel the wind?
lines.zh: 我们至少能出去感受下风吧？

lines.en: No! That's how people get hit by flying things.
lines.zh: 不行！那样会被飞来的东西砸到。

lines.en: Trees and signs can fall. Stay away from windows, too.
lines.zh: 树和广告牌会倒。也要离窗户远点。

lines.en: Fine, fine. So we watch movies and eat instant noodles?
lines.zh: 好好好。那我们看电影吃泡面？

lines.en: That's the plan. Unless the power goes out.
lines.zh: 就这么办。除非停电。

lines.en: If the power goes out, I'll just nap. I'm a survivor.
lines.zh: 要是停电，我就睡觉。我是生存达人。

lines.en: A survivor with a flashlight and a plan. Charge everything now.
lines.zh: 生存达人要备好手电筒和计划。现在就充电。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some typhoon-day phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个台风天的表达。

lines.en: A typhoon is coming.
lines.zh: 台风要来了。

lines.en: School is closed tomorrow.
lines.zh: 明天停课。

lines.en: Stay inside and charge your phone.
lines.zh: 待在家里，给手机充电。

lines.en: Stay away from windows.
lines.zh: 离窗户远点。

lines.en: typhoon alert
lines.zh: 台风警报

lines.en: taping the windows
lines.zh: 给窗户贴胶带

lines.en: the power goes out
lines.zh: 停电

lines.en: get hit by
lines.zh: 被砸到

lines.en: charge everything
lines.zh: 把所有东西都充电

lines.en: Your turn: in English, list three things to prepare before a typhoon.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语列出台风来临前要准备的三样东西。

lines.en: That's it for today. Next, we check the forecast. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次我们看天气预报。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 天气预报
episodes.desc: 看懂天气预报，学会用英语聊天气

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, let's learn to read the weather forecast.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们来学看天气预报。

lines.en: I never check the weather. I just look out the window.
lines.zh: 我从不看天气。我直接看窗外。

lines.en: And that's why you got soaked last Tuesday.
lines.zh: 所以上周二你被淋成落汤鸡。

lines.en: It was sunny when I left! The rain came out of nowhere.
lines.zh: 我出门时还是晴天！雨突然就来了。

lines.en: The forecast said rain at three. It was right on time.
lines.zh: 预报说三点下雨。准得很。

lines.en: Fine. So how do I read a forecast without getting confused?
lines.zh: 行。那我怎么才能看懂预报不迷糊？

lines.en: A forecast has a few key pieces. Here's what to look at.
lines.zh: 天气预报有几个关键点。来看看该看什么。

lines.en: First, the high and low temperature. Today's high is twenty-two, low is twelve.
lines.zh: 首先，最高和最低温。今天最高二十二度，最低十二度。

lines.en: So bring a jacket for the morning, but not for lunch?
lines.zh: 所以早上带外套，中午不用？

lines.en: Exactly. Big difference between day and night means layers.
lines.zh: 对。昼夜温差大就要多穿几层。

lines.en: Then check the rain chance. Forty percent means it might rain, not it will.
lines.zh: 然后看降雨概率。百分之四十是可能下雨，不是一定下。

lines.en: So thirty percent and I can skip the umbrella?
lines.zh: 那百分之三十就不用带伞？

lines.en: Your call. But an umbrella fits in a bag.
lines.zh: 你自己定。但一把伞放包里也不占地儿。

lines.en: And watch the wind. Strong wind plus rain is the worst.
lines.zh: 还要看风。大风加下雨最难受。

lines.en: Got it. Temperature, rain chance, and wind.
lines.zh: 明白。温度、降雨概率、风。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are the weather phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听聊天气的表达。

lines.en: Today's high is twenty-two, low is twelve.
lines.zh: 今天最高二十二度，最低十二度。

lines.en: The forecast says rain at three.
lines.zh: 预报说三点下雨。

lines.en: Forty percent chance of rain.
lines.zh: 降雨概率百分之四十。

lines.en: Strong wind plus rain.
lines.zh: 大风加下雨。

lines.en: the forecast
lines.zh: 天气预报

lines.en: the high and low
lines.zh: 最高和最低温

lines.en: chance of rain
lines.zh: 降雨概率

lines.en: right on time
lines.zh: 准得很

lines.en: out of nowhere
lines.zh: 突然

lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语描述今天的天气，带上温度和降雨概率。

lines.en: That's it for today. Next, we dress for the seasons. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次我们按季节穿衣。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 四季的衣橱
episodes.desc: 一年四季穿什么，学会用英语聊穿衣

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we dress for all four seasons.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们为四季穿衣。

lines.en: My closet is a mess. I have winter coats next to summer shorts.
lines.zh: 我的衣柜乱成一团。冬衣和夏短裤堆在一起。

lines.en: Time to sort it. What's your favorite season to dress for?
lines.zh: 该整理了。你最喜欢哪个季节的衣服？

lines.en: Autumn. A light jacket and jeans — comfortable and cool.
lines.zh: 秋天。一件薄外套加牛仔裤——舒服又帅。

lines.en: I like layering. You can add or remove pieces all day.
lines.zh: 我喜欢叠穿。一整天都能加一件或脱一件。

lines.en: Spring and autumn are the layering seasons. Winter is all about staying warm.
lines.zh: 春秋是叠穿的季节。冬天就是保暖。

lines.en: Each season has its own clothes. Here's a simple guide.
lines.zh: 每个季节都有自己的衣服。来听个简单指南。

lines.en: So what's the winter rule?
lines.zh: 那冬天的规矩是啥？

lines.en: Three layers: a base, a warm middle, and a windproof coat.
lines.zh: 三层：内层打底，中间保暖，外层防风。

lines.en: What about summer? As little as possible?
lines.zh: 夏天呢？能少穿就少穿？

lines.en: Light and loose, but cover your shoulders in strong sun.
lines.zh: 轻薄宽松，但大太阳下要护住肩膀。

lines.en: And the rain?
lines.zh: 那下雨呢？

lines.en: A waterproof jacket beats an umbrella when it's windy.
lines.zh: 有风的时候，防水外套比伞好用。

lines.en: I'll just carry everything in my bag, then.
lines.zh: 那我干脆把啥都塞包里。

lines.en: And look like you're moving house. Maybe not.
lines.zh: 然后看起来像搬家。还是算了吧。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some phrases for dressing.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个穿衣的表达。

lines.zh: 一件薄外套加牛仔裤。

lines.en: I like layering.
lines.zh: 我喜欢叠穿。

lines.en: Three layers in winter.
lines.zh: 冬天穿三层。

lines.en: A waterproof jacket beats an umbrella.
lines.zh: 防水外套比伞好用。

lines.zh: 整理一下

lines.zh: 叠穿

lines.zh: 防风外套

lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语描述你最爱的一套穿搭，以及它适合哪个季节。

lines.en: That's it for today — and that wraps up batch two! Next batch, we get moving: sports, travel, and hobbies. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 今天就到这里——第二批也完成啦！下一批，我们动起来：运动、旅行和兴趣爱好。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 我的收藏爱好
episodes.desc: 集邮、卡片、手办，聊聊收藏的乐趣

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we talk about a hobby many of you love — collecting.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们聊一个很多同学都爱的爱好——收藏。

lines.en: Look at this! I finally got the last card for my set.
lines.zh: 看这个！我终于集齐了这套卡的最后一张。

lines.en: No way! You've been hunting that one for months.
lines.zh: 不会吧！你找那张找了几个月了。

lines.en: I traded three of my doubles for it. Totally worth it.
lines.zh: 我用三张重复的换来的。太值了。

lines.en: What do you collect? Cards, stamps, figures?
lines.zh: 你收藏什么？卡片、邮票、手办？

lines.en: Sports cards. My dad collected the same ones when he was my age.
lines.zh: 运动卡。我爸在我这个年纪也收集同样的卡。

lines.en: That's cool — a hobby you share with your dad.
lines.zh: 真酷——一个你和你爸共享的爱好。

lines.en: Collecting teaches patience and lets you share something with others. Let's hear more.
lines.zh: 收藏能培养耐心，还能让你和别人分享。来多听听。

lines.en: How do you keep your collection safe?
lines.zh: 你怎么保存你的收藏？

lines.en: Plastic sleeves and a binder. Dust and folding are the enemy.
lines.zh: 塑料保护套和活页夹。灰尘和折痕是大敌。

lines.en: I collect stamps. My grandpa sends me one from every trip.
lines.zh: 我集邮。我爷爷每次旅行都给我寄一张。

lines.en: So your collection is also a map of his trips.
lines.zh: 那你的收藏也是他的旅行地图。

lines.en: Exactly! Each stamp has a story behind it.
lines.zh: 没错！每张邮票背后都有个故事。

lines.en: I don't collect anything. Maybe I should start.
lines.zh: 我啥也不收藏。也许我该开始了。

lines.en: Start small. Pick something you love, and enjoy the hunt.
lines.zh: 从小开始。挑一样你喜欢的，享受寻找的过程。

lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次我们学乐器。下次散步见！

lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 学乐器
episodes.desc: 练琴的苦与乐，坚持就是胜利

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we make music — or try to. Learning an instrument.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们搞音乐——或者说试着搞。学乐器。

lines.en: My mom signed me up for piano lessons. I have no idea what I'm doing.
lines.zh: 我妈给我报了钢琴课。我完全不知道自己在干嘛。

lines.en: That's how everyone starts. Which hand is for which keys?
lines.zh: 大家都是这么开始的。哪只手按哪些键？

lines.en: Both! At the same time! My brain refuses.
lines.zh: 两只都要！同时！我脑子不肯。

lines.en: It gets easier. The first month is the hardest.
lines.zh: 会越来越容易的。第一个月最难。

lines.en: Easy for you to say. You play guitar like a rock star.
lines.zh: 你说得轻松。你吉他弹得跟摇滚明星似的。

lines.en: Rock star? I played one chord wrong for a whole song last week.
lines.zh: 摇滚明星？上周我整首歌都弹错了一个和弦。

lines.en: Learning an instrument is hard, but the payoff is real. Here's how to stick with it.
lines.zh: 学乐器很难，但回报是真的。来听听怎么坚持。

lines.en: The secret is short daily practice, not one long session.
lines.zh: 秘诀是每天练一小会儿，不是一次练很久。

lines.en: How short?
lines.zh: 多短？

lines.en: Fifteen minutes a day beats two hours on Sunday.
lines.zh: 每天十五分钟，胜过周日练两小时。

lines.en: And record yourself. You'll hear your progress over time.
lines.zh: 还要录下来。你会听到自己慢慢进步。

lines.en: Record myself? I sound like a cat walking on the keys.
lines.zh: 录自己？我弹得像猫在琴键上散步。

lines.en: Now, maybe. In three months, you'll smile at that recording.
lines.zh: 现在是。三个月后，你会对着那段录音笑。

lines.en: Okay, I'll try. Fifteen minutes, every day.
lines.zh: 好，我试试。每天十五分钟。

lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次我们画画和拍照。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 画画与摄影
episodes.desc: 用画笔和镜头记录生活，发现身边的美

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we create with our hands and eyes — drawing and photography.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们用双手和双眼创作——画画和摄影。

lines.en: I took a photo of the sunset yesterday. Want to see?
lines.zh: 我昨天拍了张日落。想看吗？

lines.en: Whoa, the colors! Did you use a filter?
lines.zh: 哇，这色彩！你用了滤镜吗？

lines.en: No filter. The sky just did that.
lines.zh: 没用滤镜。天空本来就那样。

lines.en: That's the trick — be there at the right time. Golden hour.
lines.zh: 这就是诀窍——在对的时间出现在那里。黄金时刻。

lines.en: I prefer drawing. You can change anything you don't like.
lines.zh: 我更喜欢画画。不喜欢的地方都能改。

lines.en: Drawing and photos are two ways to keep a moment. Let's hear their tips.
lines.zh: 画画和摄影是留住瞬间的两种方式。来听听他们的小技巧。

lines.en: So what's the golden hour?
lines.zh: 那什么是黄金时刻？

lines.en: The hour after sunrise and before sunset. Soft, warm light.
lines.zh: 日出后和日落前的一小时。光线柔和温暖。

lines.en: And for drawing, Mia? How do you get better?
lines.zh: 那画画呢，Mia？怎么进步？

lines.en: Draw a little every day. Don't wait for inspiration.
lines.zh: 每天画一点。别等灵感。

lines.en: What if it looks bad?
lines.zh: 画得丑怎么办？

lines.en: Then it's practice. Every bad drawing is a step to a good one.
lines.zh: 那就算练习。每一张丑画都是通往好画的一步。

lines.en: Same with photos. Take a hundred, keep five.
lines.zh: 拍照也一样。拍一百张，留五张。

lines.en: I like that. The bad ones aren't failures, they're practice.
lines.zh: 我喜欢这个。丑的不是失败，是练习。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some phrases about art and photos.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个关于画画摄影的表达。

lines.en: I took a photo of the sunset.
lines.zh: 我拍了张日落。

lines.en: No filter, the sky just did that.
lines.zh: 没用滤镜，天空本来就那样。

lines.en: Draw a little every day.
lines.zh: 每天画一点。

lines.en: Take a hundred, keep five.
lines.zh: 拍一百张，留五张。

lines.zh: 柔和温暖的光

episodes.title: 运动会的接力赛
episodes.desc: 接力赛的紧张与团队合作

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, it's the big day — the school sports meet!
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天是大事——学校运动会！

lines.en: Guys, the relay race is in twenty minutes. I'm so nervous.
lines.zh: 各位，接力赛二十分钟后开始。我好紧张。

lines.en: You've trained for this. Just don't drop the baton.
lines.zh: 你练了这么久了。别掉棒就行。

lines.en: Don't drop the baton. Great. Now that's all I'll think about.
lines.zh: 别掉棒。真棒。现在我满脑子都是这个。

lines.en: Relax. Focus on the handoff, not the whole race.
lines.zh: 放松。专注交接棒，别想整场比赛。

lines.en: The handoff is the part I always mess up.
lines.zh: 交接棒正是我老出错的地方。

lines.en: So let's practice it right now. Ten times.
lines.zh: 那我们现在就练。十次。

lines.en: A relay race is about teamwork, not just speed. Here's the plan.
lines.zh: 接力赛靠的是团队合作，不只是速度。来听听计划。

lines.en: Here's the order. I start, then Leo, then you anchor, Jake.
lines.zh: 顺序是这样：我先跑，然后 Leo，你最后一棒，Jake。

lines.en: Anchor? That's a lot of pressure.
lines.zh: 最后一棒？压力好大。

lines.en: You're the fastest in the last stretch. It makes sense.
lines.zh: 你是冲刺最快的。这样安排合理。

lines.en: Okay. And the handoff?
lines.zh: 好。那交接棒呢？

lines.en: I pass with my right hand, you take with your left. Then switch.
lines.zh: 我右手递，你左手接。然后换手。

lines.en: And don't slow down before the exchange zone.
lines.zh: 还有别在交接区前减速。

lines.en: Got it. Right hand, left hand, full speed.
lines.zh: 明白。右手、左手、全速。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some sports-day phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个运动会的表达。

episodes.title: 游泳课
episodes.desc: 学游泳的步骤，克服对水的恐惧

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we get wet — swimming lessons.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们下水——游泳课。

lines.en: I started swimming lessons. I can float now, but I still panic.
lines.zh: 我开始学游泳了。现在能浮起来了，但还是会慌。

lines.en: Floating is a big first step! What scares you?
lines.zh: 能浮起来就是一大步了！你怕什么？

lines.en: Putting my face in the water. I hold my breath and freak out.
lines.zh: 把脸埋进水里。我屏住呼吸就慌了。

lines.en: Blow bubbles instead of holding your breath. It sounds weird, but it calms you.
lines.zh: 别憋气，要吐泡泡。听着怪，但能让你放松。

lines.en: Blow bubbles? Like a fish?
lines.zh: 吐泡泡？跟鱼一样？

lines.en: Exactly. Breathe out through your nose, and you won't panic.
lines.zh: 对。用鼻子呼气，你就不会慌。

lines.en: Swimming is a skill for life. Here's how to build it step by step.
lines.zh: 游泳是一生受用的技能。来听听怎么一步步学。

lines.en: What's the first thing your coach teaches?
lines.zh: 你教练先教什么？

lines.en: Floating on my back. Then kicking while holding the wall.
lines.zh: 仰面漂浮。然后扶着池壁踢腿。

lines.en: Kicking is all in the legs, straight but not stiff.
lines.zh: 踢腿全靠腿，要伸直但别僵。

lines.en: And when you add arms, breathe to the side, not up.
lines.zh: 加上手臂后，要侧头呼吸，不是抬头。

lines.en: Breathe to the side. Got it. Why does everything in swimming feel backwards?
lines.zh: 侧头呼吸。明白。为啥游泳里啥都感觉反着来？

lines.en: Because water is a new world. Give it time.
lines.zh: 因为水是个新世界。给它点时间。

lines.en: I'll keep at it. My goal is to swim a whole lap.
lines.zh: 我会坚持。我的目标是游完一整条泳道。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some swimming phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个游泳的表达。

episodes.title: 打羽毛球
episodes.desc: 羽毛球的基本规则和技巧

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, grab a racket — we play badminton.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天拿起球拍——我们打羽毛球。

lines.en: Anyone free after school? I need a badminton partner.
lines.zh: 放学后谁有空？我需要个羽毛球搭档。

lines.en: I'm in! But I haven't played in ages.
lines.zh: 我来！但我好久没打了。

lines.en: No worries. It's just for fun. Loser buys ice cream.
lines.zh: 没事。就是玩玩。输的人买冰淇淋。

lines.en: Now you're making it serious. Deal.
lines.zh: 这下你可认真了。成交。

lines.en: Can I come watch? I'll be the referee.
lines.zh: 我能来看吗？我当裁判。

lines.en: Perfect. We need someone to call the line honestly.
lines.zh: 完美。我们正需要个老实判界线的。

lines.en: Badminton is easy to start but takes skill to master. Here are the basics.
lines.zh: 羽毛球上手容易，精通却要技巧。来听基本规则。

lines.en: Quick refresher — how do you score?
lines.zh: 快速复习一下——怎么计分？

lines.en: Rally scoring. Win a rally, get a point, and the serve changes.
lines.zh: 每球得分制。赢一球得一分，发球权轮换。

lines.en: First to twenty-one, right? And you need to win by two.
lines.zh: 先到二十一，对吧？还要领先两分。

lines.en: Right. And the serve goes diagonally into the opposite box.
lines.zh: 对。发球要斜线发到对面的发球区。

lines.en: What's the best tip for a beginner?
lines.zh: 对新手最好的建议是啥？

lines.en: Hit the shuttle with the middle of the racket, and watch your opponent, not the birdie.
lines.zh: 用球拍中间击球，看对手别看球。

lines.en: Watch the player, not the shuttle? That feels wrong.
lines.zh: 看人别看球？感觉不对啊。

lines.en: Trust me, your eyes follow their racket and you'll react faster.
lines.zh: 信我，盯着对手的球拍，你反应会更快。

episodes.title: 骑车上学
episodes.desc: 骑车上学的好处与安全守则

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we bike to school.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们骑车上学。

lines.en: I started biking to school. It saves so much time!
lines.zh: 我开始骑车上学了。省了好多时间！

lines.en: And it's good for the planet. No traffic, no fumes.
lines.zh: 还对环境好。不堵车，没尾气。

lines.en: Plus, I feel free. Wind in my hair, whole road to myself.
lines.zh: 而且感觉很自由。风吹头发，整条路都是我的。

lines.en: Do you wear a helmet?
lines.zh: 你戴头盔吗？

lines.en: Uh... sometimes?
lines.zh: 呃……有时戴？

lines.en: Always, Jake. Your head is worth more than your hair.
lines.zh: 要一直戴，Jake。你的脑袋比发型值钱。

lines.en: Biking is great, but safety comes first. Here are the rules of the road.
lines.zh: 骑车很棒，但安全第一。来听交通规则。

lines.en: What do you check before every ride?
lines.zh: 每次骑车前你检查什么？

lines.en: Brakes and tire pressure. And my bell works.
lines.zh: 刹车和胎压。还有车铃响不响。

lines.en: Good. And on the road, ride with traffic, not against it.
lines.zh: 很好。还有在路上要顺着车流骑，别逆行。

lines.en: What about at night?
lines.zh: 晚上呢？

lines.en: Lights front and back, and something bright so drivers see you.
lines.zh: 前后灯都开，再穿点显眼的，让司机看到你。

lines.en: And never wear headphones. You need to hear what's coming.
lines.zh: 还有绝不戴耳机。你得听见周围的声音。

lines.en: No headphones. Got it. My music can wait.
lines.zh: 不戴耳机。明白。音乐可以等。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some biking phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个骑车的表达。

lines.zh: 我开始骑车上学了。

lines.en: Ride with traffic, not against it.
lines.zh: 顺着车流骑，别逆行。

lines.en: Never wear headphones.
lines.zh: 绝不戴耳机。

episodes.title: 挤公交
episodes.desc: 坐公交的礼仪和实用表达

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we take the bus.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们坐公交。

lines.en: The bus was packed this morning. I was squished like a pancake.
lines.zh: 今早公交挤爆了。我被挤得像块饼。

lines.en: Rush hour is the worst. Did you get a seat?
lines.zh: 高峰时段最难受。你抢到座了吗？

lines.en: No, but an old lady did. I gave her mine.
lines.zh: 没有，但有个老奶奶坐了。我把我的让给她了。

lines.en: That's kind of you. She probably needed it more.
lines.zh: 你真好。她应该更需要。

lines.en: Good bus manners. Offering your seat is the golden rule.
lines.zh: 这是公交礼仪。让座是黄金法则。

lines.en: Riding the bus has its own small rules. Here's how to be a good passenger.
lines.zh: 坐公交有它的小规矩。来听听怎么当个好乘客。

lines.en: So what are the unwritten bus rules?
lines.zh: 那公交的潜规则是啥？

lines.en: Offer seats to the old, the young, and anyone who needs it.
lines.zh: 给老人、小孩和有需要的人让座。

lines.en: Move to the back so people can get on. Don't block the door.
lines.zh: 往里走，让别人能上车。别堵门。

lines.en: And keep your voice down, right? Some kids shout the whole ride.
lines.zh: 还有小声点，对吧？有些同学一路都在喊。

lines.en: Exactly. And have your card ready before you get on.
lines.zh: 没错。而且上车前把卡准备好。

lines.en: Guilty. I always dig for my card at the reader.
lines.zh: 我认罪。我老是在刷卡机前翻卡。

lines.en: We've all seen it. Just keep it in your pocket.
lines.zh: 我们都见过。放口袋里就好。

lines.en: Move to the back, don't block the door.
lines.zh: 往里走，别堵门。

episodes.title: 地铁迷路
episodes.desc: 坐错方向怎么办，学会问路

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we take the subway — and get a little lost.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们坐地铁——然后有点迷路了。

lines.en: Guys, I think I took the wrong train.
lines.zh: 各位，我觉得我坐错车了。

lines.en: What? Where are you now?
lines.zh: 什么？你现在在哪儿？

lines.en: I don't know! The station names look familiar but wrong.
lines.zh: 我不知道！站名看着眼熟但又不对。

lines.en: Check the line map. Which line are you on, and which direction?
lines.zh: 看线路图。你在几号线，往哪个方向？

lines.en: Line three... heading to the airport? I need downtown.
lines.zh: 三号线……往机场方向？我要去市中心。

lines.en: Then get off at the next stop and switch to the other platform.
lines.zh: 那就在下一站下车，换到对面的站台。

lines.en: Getting lost on the subway is common, and easy to fix. Here's how to ask for help.
lines.zh: 地铁坐错很常见，也容易解决。来听听怎么求助。

lines.en: Okay, I'm off. Now what? I still don't know the way.
lines.zh: 好，我下车了。然后呢？我还是不知道路。

lines.en: Find a station worker in a uniform, or ask a friendly passenger.
lines.zh: 找穿制服的工作人员，或者问个和善的乘客。

lines.en: How do I ask without sounding silly?
lines.zh: 怎么问才不显得傻？

lines.en: Just say, 'Excuse me, how do I get to downtown?'
lines.zh: 就说，'打扰一下，请问去市中心怎么走？'

lines.en: Or use the map app on your phone. It shows every transfer.
lines.zh: 或者用手机地图 App。上面显示每次换乘。

lines.en: You mean I could have checked my phone this whole time?
lines.zh: 你是说我这一路都可以查手机？

lines.en: Yes, Jake. Yes, you could.
lines.zh: 是的，Jake。是的，你可以。

episodes.title: 打车去机场
episodes.desc: 赶飞机的紧张时刻，学会打车表达

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we're in a hurry — a taxi to the airport.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天很赶——打车去机场。

lines.en: Our flight leaves in three hours. We need a taxi now!
lines.zh: 飞机三小时后起飞。我们得马上打车！

lines.en: Relax, the airport is only forty minutes away.
lines.zh: 放松，机场只要四十分钟。

lines.en: That's if the road is clear. What if there's traffic?
lines.zh: 那得路况好。万一堵车呢？

lines.en: I'll book a taxi on the app. It shows the fare up front.
lines.zh: 我用 App 叫车。上面会显示预估车费。

lines.en: Make it fast. I can't miss this flight — it's my cousin's wedding.
lines.zh: 快点。我不能误机——是我表哥的婚礼。

lines.en: We won't miss it. The taxi is two minutes away.
lines.zh: 不会误的。车两分钟就到。

lines.en: Taking a taxi to the airport can be stressful. A little planning helps. Let's listen.
lines.zh: 打车去机场可能很紧张。提前规划有帮助。来听听。

lines.en: The car is here. Did everyone grab their bags?
lines.zh: 车到了。大家都拿好行李了吗？

lines.en: I have my backpack. Do I have my passport?
lines.zh: 我背着包。我护照带了吗？

lines.en: You just checked it two minutes ago. It's in your front pocket.
lines.zh: 你两分钟前刚检查过。在你前袋里。

lines.en: I know, I'm just nervous. What if we're late?
lines.zh: 我知道，我就是紧张。万一迟到呢？

lines.en: Then the driver knows the shortcuts. Leave it to him.
lines.zh: 那司机知道近路。交给他。

lines.en: Okay. Deep breaths. Wedding, not a test.
lines.zh: 好。深呼吸。是婚礼，不是考试。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some taxi and airport phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个打车和机场的表达。

episodes.title: 交通安全
episodes.desc: 过马路、看信号，安全出行小常识

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, an important topic — road safety.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天是个重要话题——交通安全。

lines.en: I almost got hit by a bike yesterday. I was looking at my phone.
lines.zh: 昨天我差点被自行车撞。我正看手机呢。

lines.en: That's exactly what not to do. Phones wait, the road doesn't.
lines.zh: 这正是最不该做的。手机可以等，路可不等。

lines.en: I know. I felt so dumb.
lines.zh: 我知道。我觉得自己好蠢。

lines.en: The good news is, you're fine. Now you'll look up.
lines.zh: 好消息是你没事。以后你就会抬头了。

lines.en: Trust me, I will. That bike came out of nowhere.
lines.zh: 相信我，会的。那自行车突然就冒出来了。

lines.en: Roads are shared by cars, bikes, and walkers. Here's how to stay safe.
lines.zh: 道路是车、自行车和行人共用的。来听听怎么保安全。

lines.en: First rule: cross at the crosswalk, and wait for the green light.
lines.zh: 第一条：走斑马线，等绿灯。

lines.en: Even if there are no cars?
lines.zh: 就算没车也等？

lines.en: Especially then. A car can appear fast, and you never know.
lines.zh: 尤其是没车的时候。车可能突然出现，你永远不知道。

lines.en: Look left, then right, then left again before you cross.
lines.zh: 过马路前左看、右看、再左看。

lines.en: And at night, wear something bright.
lines.zh: 晚上要穿亮色的。

lines.en: Right. Drivers can't stop for what they can't see.
lines.zh: 对。司机看不见的东西，就没法为它停下。

lines.en: No more phone-walking for me. I'll keep my eyes on the road.
lines.zh: 我再也不边走边看手机了。我会盯着路。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some road safety phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个交通安全的表达。

lines.en: Wait for the green light.

lines.en: Look left, then right, then left again.
lines.zh: 左看、右看、再左看。

lines.zh: 晚上穿亮色的。

lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语列出三条安全过马路的规则。

episodes.title: 周末郊游
episodes.desc: 周末去郊外走走，放松心情

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we escape the city — a day trip!
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们逃离城市——郊游！

lines.en: My family is going on a day trip this weekend. I'm so excited.
lines.zh: 这周末我们全家去郊游。我好兴奋。

lines.en: Nice! Where are you going?
lines.zh: 不错！你们去哪儿？

lines.en: A lake about an hour away. We're going to have a picnic and maybe boat.
lines.zh: 一小时车程外的一个湖。我们野餐，可能还划船。

lines.en: Sounds perfect. What should we pack for a day trip?
lines.zh: 听着完美。郊游该带点啥？

lines.en: Water, snacks, sunscreen, and a hat. Maybe a small blanket.
lines.zh: 水、零食、防晒、帽子。也许再带条小毯子。

lines.en: My mom packs everything. She's the trip boss.
lines.zh: 我妈啥都带。她是旅行总指挥。

lines.en: A day trip is a great way to recharge. Here's how to make it smooth.
lines.zh: 郊游是充电的好方式。来听听怎么让它更顺利。

lines.en: What time are you leaving?
lines.zh: 你们几点出发？

lines.en: Early, like eight. We want to beat the crowd.
lines.zh: 很早，八点。我们想赶在人群前。

lines.en: Smart. Early morning by the lake is the best part.
lines.zh: 聪明。清晨的湖边是最美的。

lines.en: I just hope the weather holds.
lines.zh: 我就盼着天气别变。

lines.en: Even if it's cloudy, a day out beats a day on the couch.
lines.zh: 就算多云，出门玩也比窝沙发强。

lines.en: True. And I can finally put my phone down for a day.
lines.zh: 对。而且我终于能放下手机一天了。

lines.en: Now that's a real vacation.
lines.zh: 那才是真正的度假。

lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个郊游的表达。

lines.zh: 我们要野餐。

lines.zh: 该带点啥？

lines.en: We want to beat the crowd.
lines.zh: 我们想赶在人群前。

lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语规划一次郊游——说去哪儿、带什么。

episodes.title: 露营初体验
episodes.desc: 搭帐篷、生火，第一次露营的乐趣

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we sleep outside — first camping trip!
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们睡在外面——第一次露营！

lines.en: I'm going camping for the first time this weekend. What do I need to know?
lines.zh: 这周末我第一次去露营。我要知道点啥？

lines.en: Bring a good sleeping bag. Nights get cold, even in summer.
lines.zh: 带个好睡袋。夜里会冷，夏天也是。

lines.en: And learn to set up the tent before you go. Practice at home.
lines.zh: 出发前先学会搭帐篷。在家练练。

lines.en: Practice in my living room? My cat will love that.
lines.zh: 在客厅练？我家猫会爱死的。

lines.en: Better than struggling in the dark with a flashlight in your mouth.
lines.zh: 总比在黑夜里嘴里叼着手电筒瞎折腾强。

lines.en: Fair point. What about food?
lines.zh: 有道理。吃的呢？

lines.en: Easy stuff — sandwiches, fruit, and noodles you can cook on a small stove.
lines.zh: 简单点——三明治、水果，还有能用小炉子煮的面。

lines.en: Camping is an adventure, but a little prep makes it fun instead of stressful.
lines.zh: 露营是冒险，但提前准备能让你玩得开心而不是手忙脚乱。来听听。

lines.en: Okay, tent, sleeping bag, food. What else?
lines.zh: 好，帐篷、睡袋、吃的。还有呢？

lines.en: A headlamp, not just a phone light. And bug spray. Trust me.
lines.zh: 头灯，不能只有手机灯。还有防虫喷雾。信我。

lines.en: Bug spray. Noted. What's the best part of camping?
lines.zh: 防虫喷雾。记下了。露营最棒的是啥？

lines.en: The stars. Away from city lights, the sky is full of them.
lines.zh: 星星。远离城市灯光，满天都是。

lines.en: And the quiet. You don't realize how loud the city is until you leave it.
lines.zh: 还有安静。不离开城市，你都不知道它有多吵。

lines.en: Okay, now I'm actually looking forward to it.
lines.zh: 好，我现在真的期待起来了。

episodes.title: 海边度假
episodes.desc: 阳光沙滩海浪，海边度假的正确打开方式

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we hit the beach.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们去海边。

lines.en: Summer plan: beach trip! Sand, sea, and zero homework.
lines.zh: 夏日计划：海边游！沙滩、大海、零作业。

lines.en: You'll come back sunburned. I guarantee it.
lines.zh: 你会晒伤回来的。我保证。

lines.en: Not this time. I bought sunscreen with the highest number.
lines.zh: 这次不会。我买了最高倍数的防晒霜。

lines.en: Sunscreen only works if you reapply it. Every two hours.
lines.zh: 防晒得补涂才管用。每两小时一次。

lines.en: Reapply? It's not makeup, Leo.
lines.zh: 补涂？这又不是化妆，Leo。

lines.en: Doesn't matter. Sweat and water wash it off.
lines.zh: 不管。汗和水会把它冲掉。

lines.en: A beach day is pure joy, if you're ready for the sun and water. Here's how.
lines.zh: 海边的一天是纯粹的快乐，只要你对阳光和水有准备。来听听。

lines.en: What's on your beach list?
lines.zh: 你的海边清单是啥？

lines.en: Swimsuit, towel, flip-flops, and a big hat.
lines.zh: 泳衣、毛巾、人字拖，还有大帽子。

lines.en: Add water and shade. An umbrella or a beach tent.
lines.zh: 加上水和遮阴。一把伞或沙滩帐篷。

lines.en: And don't swim alone or too far, right?
lines.zh: 还有别一个人游、别游太远，对吧？

lines.en: Exactly. Watch the flags, and swim where the lifeguard can see you.
lines.zh: 没错。看旗帜，在有救生员能看到的区域游。

lines.en: Got it. Sun, sea, and safety.
lines.zh: 明白。阳光、大海、安全。

lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个海边的表达。

lines.en: Reapply sunscreen every two hours.

lines.en: Bring a swimsuit and a towel.
lines.zh: 带泳衣和毛巾。

lines.en: Swim where the lifeguard can see you.
lines.zh: 在有救生员能看到的区域游。

episodes.title: 收拾行李
episodes.desc: 出门前怎么打包，不遗漏不多带

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we pack for a trip.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们收拾行李。

lines.en: I leave tomorrow and I haven't packed a single thing.
lines.zh: 我明天出发，一样东西都还没收拾。

lines.en: Classic Jake. What kind of trip is it?
lines.zh: 典型的 Jake。是什么旅行？

lines.en: Three days with my grandparents. Not too cold, not too hot.
lines.zh: 去爷爷奶奶家住三天。不冷不热。

lines.en: Then make a list first. Don't just throw things in.
lines.zh: 那先列清单。别一股脑乱塞。

lines.en: A list? That's so... organized.
lines.zh: 清单？这也太……有条理了。

lines.en: Which is why you never forget things, unlike some people.
lines.zh: 所以你从不忘东西，不像某些人。

lines.en: Packing well means less stress later. Here's a simple method.
lines.zh: 收拾好行李，之后少操心。来听个简单方法。

lines.en: The rule is: clothes for each day, plus one extra set.
lines.zh: 规则是：每天的衣服，再加一套备用。

lines.en: How many pairs of socks?
lines.zh: 几双袜子？

lines.en: Days plus one. Same for underwear.
lines.zh: 天数加一。内衣也一样。

lines.en: Roll your clothes instead of folding. Saves space and fewer wrinkles.
lines.zh: 衣服卷起来而不是叠。省空间还少皱。

lines.en: Rolling, really?
lines.zh: 卷起来，真的？

lines.en: Try it. You'll fit twice as much.
lines.zh: 试试看。能多装一倍。

lines.en: And what about the 'I might need this' pile?
lines.zh: 那'我可能用得上'那一堆呢？

lines.en: Leave it. If you really need it, you can usually buy it there.
lines.zh: 别带。真需要的话，到那儿一般也能买。

episodes.title: 旅行拍照
episodes.desc: 拍出好看的旅行照，留住美好回忆

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we capture the trip — travel photos.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们记录旅行——旅行照。

lines.en: I take a hundred photos on every trip, but they all look the same.
lines.zh: 我每次旅行拍一百张，但张张都一样。

lines.en: Are you always in the center, making a peace sign?
lines.zh: 你是不是总站在中间，比个剪刀手？

lines.en: ...Maybe.
lines.zh: ……可能吧。

lines.en: That's your problem. Try different angles, not just different places.
lines.zh: 这就是问题所在。试试不同的角度，而不是不同的地方。

lines.en: And use the light. Morning and evening light makes everything look better.
lines.zh: 还要用光。清晨和傍晚的光让一切都更好看。

lines.en: A good travel photo is more than just standing somewhere. Here are the tips.
lines.zh: 一张好的旅行照不只是站在某处。来听技巧。

lines.en: Okay, teach me. How do I stop making boring photos?
lines.zh: 好，教我。怎么才能不拍出无聊的照片？

lines.en: Get closer to your subject, or shoot from low or high.
lines.zh: 靠近你的主体，或者蹲低、举高拍。

lines.en: Look for a detail — a window, a shadow, a plate of food — not just the whole view.
lines.zh: 找细节——一扇窗、一道影子、一盘食物——而不是只拍全景。

lines.en: What about people? My mom always blinks.
lines.zh: 那人像呢？我妈拍照总眨眼。

lines.en: Take a few in a row, and catch people doing something, not just posing.
lines.zh: 连拍几张，抓拍人在做事的样子，而不是摆拍。

lines.en: So it's about moments, not poses.
lines.zh: 所以是拍瞬间，不是摆姿势。

lines.en: Exactly. Now you sound like a photographer.
lines.zh: 没错。这下你像个摄影师了。

episodes.title: 感冒了
episodes.desc: 感冒了怎么办，学会描述身体不适

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we're under the weather — catching a cold.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们不舒——感冒了。

lines.en: I feel awful. My head hurts and my nose won't stop running.
lines.zh: 我好难受。头疼，鼻涕止不住。

lines.en: You look pale. Did you sleep at all last night?
lines.zh: 你脸色发白。昨晚睡了吗？

lines.en: Barely. I kept sneezing every five minutes.
lines.zh: 几乎没睡。每五分钟打一个喷嚏。

lines.en: Sounds like a cold. You should go home and rest.
lines.zh: 听着像感冒。你应该回家休息。

lines.en: But we have a math test tomorrow.
lines.zh: 可明天有数学考试。

lines.en: You can't study when you're sick. Rest today, catch up tomorrow.
lines.zh: 生病时学不进去。今天休息，明天再补。

lines.en: A cold is common, but you can make it pass faster. Here's how.
lines.zh: 感冒很常见，但你能让它快点好。来听听怎么做。

lines.en: First, drink plenty of warm water. It soothes your throat.
lines.zh: 首先，多喝温水。能舒缓嗓子。

lines.en: What about medicine?
lines.zh: 那吃药呢？

lines.en: If it's bad, see a doctor. Don't just grab any pills.
lines.zh: 如果严重，去看医生。别乱吃药。

lines.en: And rest. Your body fights the cold while you sleep.
lines.zh: 还有休息。你睡觉时身体在跟感冒作战。

lines.en: So basically — water, rest, and maybe a doctor?
lines.zh: 所以就是——喝水、休息，可能再看医生？

lines.en: Exactly. And cover your mouth when you sneeze, so you don't share it.
lines.zh: 没错。打喷嚏要捂住嘴，别传染给别人。

lines.en: Got it. Sorry if I already shared it.
lines.zh: 明白。抱歉，我可能已经传染了。

lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个描述生病的表达。

lines.en: You should go home and rest.
lines.zh: 你应该回家休息。

lines.zh: 多喝温水。

lines.zh: 舒缓嗓子

lines.en: catch up
lines.zh: 补上

lines.en: Your turn: in English, describe how you feel when you have a cold.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语描述你感冒时的感受。

episodes.title: 牙疼看牙医
episodes.desc: 牙疼不是病，疼起来要命，别怕看牙医

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we sit in the dentist's chair.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们坐在牙医的椅子上。

lines.en: My tooth has been hurting for two days. I think I have to go to the dentist.
lines.zh: 我的牙疼了两天了。我觉得得去看牙医。

lines.en: Two days? You should've gone right away.
lines.zh: 两天了？你早该去了。

lines.en: I know, but... the drill. I'm scared of the drill.
lines.zh: 我知道，但是……那个钻头。我怕钻头。

lines.en: The longer you wait, the worse it gets. A tiny hole becomes a big one.
lines.zh: 越拖越糟。小洞会变成大洞。

lines.en: You sound like my mom.
lines.zh: 你说话跟我妈一样。

lines.en: Because she's right. Go today.
lines.zh: 因为她是对的。今天就去。

lines.en: Going to the dentist isn't fun, but it stops a small problem from growing. Here's what to expect.
lines.zh: 看牙医不好玩，但它能阻止小问题变大。来听听会经历什么。

lines.en: Okay, I'm going. What should I say when I get there?
lines.zh: 好，我去。到了该说啥？

lines.en: Tell them where it hurts and how long. 'My back tooth hurts, for two days.'
lines.zh: 告诉他们哪里疼、疼了多久。'我后边的牙疼，两天了。'

lines.en: And the drill... does it hurt?
lines.zh: 那钻头……疼吗？

lines.en: They numb it first. You'll feel pressure, not pain.
lines.zh: 他们会先打麻药。你会感觉有压力，不疼。

lines.en: Really? So my fear is for nothing?
lines.zh: 真的？所以我白怕了？

lines.en: Mostly. And brush twice a day so you don't come back.
lines.zh: 基本上是。还有每天刷两次牙，你就不用再来了。

lines.en: Deal. I'll brush like my life depends on it.
lines.zh: 成交。我以后好好刷牙，跟保命似的。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some dentist phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个看牙医的表达。

lines.zh: 我的牙一直在疼。

lines.zh: 越拖越糟。

lines.zh: 他们会先打麻药。

lines.en: Brush twice a day.
lines.zh: 每天刷两次牙。

episodes.title: 发烧请假
episodes.desc: 发烧了怎么请假，学会请假表达

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we wake up with a fever.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们发烧醒来。

lines.en: Mom, I can't go to school. I'm burning up.
lines.zh: 妈，我不能去上学了。我发烧了。

lines.en: Let me feel your forehead. Oh, you're really hot.
lines.zh: 让我摸摸你额头。哦，你真的很烫。

lines.en: I told you. Can I stay home?
lines.zh: 我就说吧。我能待在家吗？

lines.en: Yes, but first we take your temperature, and I'll call the teacher.
lines.zh: 可以，但先量体温，我再给老师打电话。

lines.en: You don't need to call. Just let me sleep.
lines.zh: 不用打了。让我睡就行。

lines.en: We have to tell the school. It's the rule.
lines.zh: 得通知学校。这是规定。

lines.en: Staying home when you're sick is the right call — for you and your classmates. Here's how to ask for sick leave.
lines.zh: 生病时待在家里，对你自己和同学都是对的。来听听怎么请假。

lines.en: When you have a fever, you should definitely stay home. You might be contagious.
lines.zh: 发烧时你绝对该待在家。你可能有传染性。

lines.en: How do I ask for a day off properly?
lines.zh: 怎么才能正式地请个假？

lines.en: Your parent calls, or you write a note. Say the reason and how long.
lines.zh: 你家长打电话，或者你写张假条。说明原因和天数。

lines.en: Like, 'I have a fever, so I can't come to school today'?
lines.zh: 比如，'我发烧了，今天不能来上学'？

lines.en: Exactly. And ask a classmate for the homework you miss.
lines.zh: 没错。再让同学帮你带落下的作业。

lines.en: Good idea. I'll ask Leo to save my notes.
lines.zh: 好主意。我让 Leo 帮我记笔记。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some phrases for sick leave.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个请假的表达。

lines.en: I'm burning up.
lines.zh: 我发烧了。

lines.en: Take your temperature.
lines.zh: 量体温。

lines.en: I can't come to school today.
lines.zh: 我今天不能来上学。

lines.en: Ask a classmate for the homework.
lines.zh: 让同学帮你带作业。

lines.zh: 发烧

lines.zh: 摸摸额头

lines.zh: 量体温

lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语写一段你会怎么向学校请假的话。

episodes.title: 近视配眼镜
episodes.desc: 看不清黑板，去配一副合适的眼镜

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we can finally see clearly — getting glasses.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们终于能看清了——配眼镜。

lines.en: I've been squinting at the blackboard all week. I think I need glasses.
lines.zh: 我这一周都眯着眼看黑板。我觉得我需要眼镜。

lines.en: That's a sign. Can you read that sign across the street?
lines.zh: 这是个信号。你能看清街对面那个牌子吗？

lines.en: There's a sign?
lines.zh: 有牌子吗？

lines.en: Yep. Time for an eye test.
lines.zh: 完了。该去测视力了。

lines.en: But glasses will change my whole look.
lines.zh: 可眼镜会改变我整个形象。

lines.en: Squinting changes your look more, trust me.
lines.zh: 相信我，眯眼更毁形象。

lines.en: Many students need glasses and don't know it. Here's what happens at the eye doctor.
lines.zh: 很多学生近视了自己还不知道。来听听看眼科医生时会经历什么。

lines.en: The eye test is easy. You read letters on a chart, big to small.
lines.zh: 测视力很简单。你看表上的字母，从大到小。

lines.en: And then they give me glasses right there?
lines.zh: 然后当场就给我配眼镜？

lines.en: Not exactly. They check your eyes, then you pick a frame you like.
lines.zh: 不完全是。他们检查眼睛，然后你挑个喜欢的镜框。

lines.en: Frames! Okay, that part I'm excited about.
lines.zh: 镜框！好，这部分我期待。

lines.en: Just pick something comfortable and light. You'll wear it all day.
lines.zh: 挑个舒服又轻的。你得戴一整天。

lines.en: Got it. And take care of my eyes — less phone, more breaks.
lines.zh: 明白。还要爱护眼睛——少看手机，多休息。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some phrases about glasses.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个关于眼镜的表达。

lines.zh: 看表上的字母。

lines.zh: 挑个喜欢的镜框。

episodes.title: 锻炼身体
episodes.desc: 简单有效的锻炼，养成运动习惯

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we get moving — staying fit.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们动起来——锻炼身体。

lines.en: I feel tired all the time. My mom says I need exercise.
lines.zh: 我总觉得累。我妈说我需要锻炼。

lines.en: She's right. Moving your body gives you more energy, not less.
lines.zh: 她说得对。活动身体让你更有精力，不是更累。

lines.en: That sounds backwards.
lines.zh: 听着反了。

lines.en: It's true. Even a short walk after school helps.
lines.zh: 是真的。放学后散个步都有用。

lines.en: I just don't like gyms. Too many machines.
lines.zh: 我就是不喜欢健身房。机器太多。

lines.en: You don't need a gym. Jump rope, ride a bike, play basketball.
lines.zh: 不需要健身房。跳绳、骑车、打篮球都行。

lines.en: Fitness isn't about being perfect. It's about moving a little every day.
lines.zh: 健身不是追求完美。就是每天动一动。

lines.en: So what's a good start for a lazy person like me?
lines.zh: 那像我这么懒的人该怎么开始？

lines.en: Start tiny. Ten minutes a day. Walking counts.
lines.zh: 从极小开始。每天十分钟。走路也算。

lines.en: Ten minutes? I can do that.
lines.zh: 十分钟？我能做到。

lines.en: Then add a little each week. The key is doing it every day, not doing a lot once.
lines.zh: 然后每周加一点。关键是每天做，不是一次做很多。

lines.en: And what about sitting? I sit all day in class.
lines.zh: 那坐着呢？我上课坐一整天。

lines.en: Stand up and stretch between classes. Move your shoulders, your neck.
lines.zh: 课间起来伸展一下。动动肩膀、脖子。

lines.en: Okay. Ten minutes of walking, plus stretches. I can do this.
lines.zh: 好。十分钟走路，加上伸展。我能做到。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some fitness phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个锻炼的表达。

lines.zh: 活动身体让你更有精力。

episodes.title: 睡眠与健康
episodes.desc: 睡够觉，身体和大脑才能好好工作

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we talk about the thing we all love — sleep.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们聊聊大家都爱的事——睡眠。

lines.en: I stayed up till midnight again. I feel like a zombie.
lines.zh: 我又熬夜到半夜了。我感觉自己像僵尸。

lines.en: How many hours do you usually get?
lines.zh: 你通常睡几个小时？

lines.en: Six, maybe. On weekends I sleep ten.
lines.zh: 六小时，可能吧。周末睡十小时。

lines.en: Teenagers need about eight to ten hours. You're running on empty.
lines.zh: 青少年需要八到十小时。你是在透支。

lines.en: I know, but there's always one more video...
lines.zh: 我知道，可总还有'最后一个视频'……

lines.en: Sleep isn't lazy — it's when your body and brain recover. Here's why it matters.
lines.zh: 睡觉不是懒——它是身体和大脑恢复的时候。来听听为什么重要。

lines.en: When you sleep, your brain sorts what you learned that day.
lines.zh: 你睡觉时，大脑会整理你当天学的东西。

lines.en: So sleeping helps my grades?
lines.zh: 所以睡觉能帮我提成绩？

lines.en: More than one more hour of studying does, sometimes.
lines.zh: 有时候比多学一小时还管用。

lines.en: And a regular bedtime matters. Same time every night.
lines.zh: 规律的作息很重要。每天同一时间睡。

lines.en: Even weekends?
lines.zh: 周末也是？

lines.en: Even weekends. Big changes confuse your body clock.
lines.zh: 周末也是。作息大起大落会打乱生物钟。

lines.en: Okay. Phone away, lights off, same time every night. I'll try.
lines.zh: 好。手机拿开，关灯，每天同一时间睡。我试试。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some sleep phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个关于睡眠的表达。

lines.zh: 我熬夜到半夜。

lines.zh: 我感觉像僵尸。

lines.en: Teenagers need eight to ten hours.
lines.zh: 青少年需要八到十小时。

lines.en: Keep a regular bedtime.
lines.zh: 保持规律作息。

lines.zh: 熬夜

episodes.title: 垃圾分类
episodes.desc: 垃圾怎么分类，为环保出一份力

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we do something good for the planet — sorting trash.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们为地球做点好事——垃圾分类。

lines.en: My community just started sorting trash. I never know which bin to use.
lines.zh: 我们小区刚开始垃圾分类。我总不知道该扔哪个桶。

lines.en: It takes practice. What do you have?
lines.zh: 慢慢就习惯了。你手上是什么？

lines.en: A plastic bottle and some paper.
lines.zh: 一个塑料瓶和一点纸。

lines.en: Both recyclable. Rinse the bottle, flatten it, and put it in the recycling bin.
lines.zh: 两个都可回收。把瓶子冲一下、压扁，扔进可回收桶。

lines.en: What about food waste?
lines.zh: 那厨余垃圾呢？

lines.en: That goes in the food waste bin, never with recyclables.
lines.zh: 厨余扔进厨余桶，绝不和可回收的混在一起。

lines.en: Sorting trash is a small daily act that adds up. Here's a simple guide.
lines.zh: 垃圾分类是每天的小事，积少成多。来听个简单指南。

lines.en: The four main types: recyclables, food waste, other waste, and hazardous.
lines.zh: 四大类：可回收、厨余、其他垃圾、有害垃圾。

lines.en: Hazardous? Like what?
lines.zh: 有害垃圾？比如什么？

lines.en: Batteries, old medicine, light bulbs. They need special handling.
lines.zh: 电池、过期药、灯泡。要特殊处理。

lines.en: When in doubt, check the labels on the bins, or ask.
lines.zh: 不确定就看桶上的标识，或者问人。

lines.en: I used to just throw everything in one bag.
lines.zh: 我以前都是全装一个袋里扔。

lines.en: Most of us did. Small changes, big difference.
lines.zh: 大多数人都这样。小改变，大不同。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some recycling phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个垃圾分类的表达。

lines.en: Which bin do I use?
lines.zh: 我该用哪个桶？

lines.en: Rinse and flatten the bottle.
lines.zh: 把瓶子冲一下、压扁。

lines.en: Food waste goes in a separate bin.
lines.zh: 厨余扔进单独的桶。

lines.en: Small changes, big difference.
lines.zh: 小改变，大不同。

lines.en: sorting trash
lines.zh: 垃圾分类

lines.en: recyclable
lines.zh: 可回收的

lines.en: food waste
lines.zh: 厨余垃圾

lines.en: hazardous
lines.zh: 有害的

lines.en: when in doubt
lines.zh: 不确定时

lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语说出三种垃圾，以及各自该扔进哪个桶。

lines.en: That's it for today. Next, we save water. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次我们节约用水。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 节约用水
episodes.desc: 水是宝贵的资源，学会珍惜每一滴水

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we talk about something we can't live without — water.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们聊聊离不开的东西——水。

lines.en: My dad got angry because I left the tap running while brushing.
lines.zh: 我刷牙时没关水龙头，我爸生气了。

lines.en: He has a point. A running tap wastes liters every minute.
lines.zh: 他有道理。一直开着的水龙头每分钟都在浪费水。

lines.en: It's just water. It comes back, right?
lines.zh: 不就是水嘛。还会来的，对吧？

lines.en: Clean water isn't endless. Many places don't have enough.
lines.zh: 干净的水不是无限的。很多地方水都不够用。

lines.en: I never thought about that.
lines.zh: 我从没想过这个。

lines.en: Saving water is easier than you think. Here are a few habits.
lines.zh: 节约用水比你想的容易。来听几个习惯。

lines.en: Turn off the tap while you brush or wash your hands.
lines.zh: 刷牙、洗手时关掉水龙头。

lines.en: Got it. What else?
lines.zh: 明白。还有呢？

lines.en: Take shorter showers. Five minutes is plenty.
lines.zh: 洗澡短一点。五分钟够了。

lines.en: Five minutes? I need at least fifteen.
lines.zh: 五分钟？我至少要十五分钟。

lines.en: Then you're singing in there, not showering.
lines.zh: 那你是在里面唱歌，不是洗澡。

lines.en: And fix dripping taps. A drip all day adds up to buckets.
lines.zh: 还有修好滴水的水龙头。滴一天能攒好几桶。

lines.en: Okay. Shorter showers, no dripping, tap off. I can do that.
lines.zh: 好。洗澡短一点、别滴水、随手关水。我能做到。

lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个节水的表达。

lines.zh: 干净的水不是无限的。

lines.en: Take shorter showers.
lines.zh: 洗澡短一点。

lines.zh: 修好滴水的水龙头。

lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语列出两种在家节水的方法。

lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次我们种一棵树。下次散步见！

lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 种一棵树
episodes.desc: 亲手种一棵树，感受生命成长

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we get our hands dirty — planting a tree.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们弄得满手泥——种一棵树。

lines.en: Our school is planting trees this week. I signed up.
lines.zh: 这周学校组织种树。我报名了。

lines.en: Nice! Have you ever planted one before?
lines.zh: 不错！你以前种过吗？

lines.en: Never. I'm afraid I'll kill it.
lines.zh: 没有。我怕把它种死。

lines.en: Trees are tougher than you think. They just need a good start.
lines.zh: 树比你想象的顽强。它们只需要个好开头。

lines.en: Right hole, good soil, enough water — that's most of it.
lines.zh: 挖对坑、用好土、浇够水——差不多就成了。

lines.en: Planting a tree is simple, and it gives back for years. Here are the steps.
lines.zh: 种树很简单，而且能回报很多年。来听步骤。

lines.en: First, dig a hole twice as wide as the roots.
lines.zh: 首先，挖一个比根宽一倍的坑。

lines.en: How deep?
lines.zh: 多深？

lines.en: Deep enough that the roots are covered, but the trunk isn't buried.
lines.zh: 深到盖住根，但不埋住树干。

lines.en: Then put the tree in, fill with soil, and press it gently.
lines.zh: 然后把树放进去，填土，轻轻压实。

lines.en: And water it?
lines.zh: 然后浇水？

lines.en: A lot, the first few weeks. It helps the roots settle.
lines.zh: 头几周要浇很多。帮根扎稳。

lines.en: Got it. I'll take care of mine like a pet.
lines.zh: 明白。我会像养宠物一样照顾它。

lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个种树的表达。

lines.zh: 头几周要浇很多水。

lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次我们爱护小动物。下次散步见！

lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 爱护小动物
episodes.desc: 小动物是我们的朋友，学会善待它们

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we talk about our furry friends — caring for animals.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们聊聊毛茸茸的朋友——爱护小动物。

lines.en: There's a stray cat near our building. I want to help it.
lines.zh: 我们楼附近有只流浪猫。我想帮帮它。

lines.en: That's sweet. But be careful — strays can be scared.
lines.zh: 真暖心。但要小心——流浪猫可能很害怕。

lines.en: It runs away every time I get close.
lines.zh: 我每次靠近它就跑。

lines.en: Don't chase it. Put food and water out, and let it come to you.
lines.zh: 别追它。把食物和水放那儿，让它自己过来。

lines.en: That's slow, but I guess it's the right way.
lines.zh: 有点慢，但我想这是对的方式。

lines.en: Caring for animals means understanding them. Here's how to help safely.
lines.zh: 爱护动物就是要理解它们。来听听怎么安全地帮它们。

lines.en: Never grab a strange animal. Let it sniff your hand first.
lines.zh: 绝不要抓陌生的动物。让它先闻闻你的手。

lines.en: Why?
lines.zh: 为什么？

lines.en: Because a scared animal might bite to protect itself.
lines.zh: 因为受惊的动物可能咬人自保。

lines.en: If you find a hurt animal, call an adult or an animal shelter.
lines.zh: 如果发现受伤的动物，找大人或动物救助站。

lines.en: And what about pets? We have a dog.
lines.zh: 那宠物呢？我们家有只狗。

lines.en: Pets need fresh water, good food, and time with you every day.
lines.zh: 宠物需要干净的水、好的食物，还有每天陪它的时间。

lines.en: My dog gets all three, plus belly rubs.
lines.zh: 我家狗三样都有，外加肚皮按摩。

lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个关于动物的表达。

lines.zh: 让它先闻闻你的手。

lines.zh: 联系动物救助站。

episodes.title: 感恩节
episodes.desc: 感恩节的由来与传统，学会说感谢

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we give thanks — it's Thanksgiving.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们表达感谢——感恩节。

lines.en: Our English class is learning about Thanksgiving. What's it really about?
lines.zh: 我们英语课在学感恩节。它到底是关于什么的？

lines.en: It's an American holiday where families gather and give thanks.
lines.zh: 这是美国家庭团聚、表达感谢的节日。

lines.en: And there's a big dinner — turkey, potatoes, pumpkin pie.
lines.zh: 还有顿大餐——火鸡、土豆、南瓜派。

lines.en: Turkey? Why turkey?
lines.zh: 火鸡？为什么是火鸡？

lines.en: It's tradition. And everyone says what they're thankful for.
lines.zh: 这是传统。大家还会说自己在感谢什么。

lines.en: Thanksgiving is a good reminder to say thank you. Let's hear more.
lines.zh: 感恩节是个提醒我们说谢谢的好时机。来多听听。

lines.en: So people take turns saying thanks?
lines.zh: 所以大家轮流说感谢？

lines.en: Right. Even the smallest things — a warm meal, a good friend.
lines.zh: 对。再小的事也行——一顿热饭、一个好朋友。

lines.en: I like that. What would you be thankful for?
lines.zh: 我喜欢。你会感谢什么？

lines.en: My family, and that I get to go to school.
lines.zh: 感谢我的家人，还有我能上学。

lines.en: I'm thankful for my health and my friends like you two.
lines.zh: 感谢我的健康，还有像你俩这样的朋友。

lines.en: Now I feel bad for complaining about homework.
lines.zh: 现在我都不好意思抱怨作业了。

lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个感恩节的表达。

lines.zh: 说你在感谢什么。

lines.zh: 我感谢我的家人。

lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次来点吓人的——万圣节。下次散步见！

episodes.title: 万圣节
episodes.desc: 不给糖就捣蛋，万圣节的习俗

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, it's spooky season — Halloween!
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天到了吓人的季节——万圣节！

lines.en: What are you dressing up as for Halloween?
lines.zh: 你万圣节要扮成什么？

lines.en: A witch. I have the hat and everything.
lines.zh: 女巫。帽子和全套都有了。

lines.en: I'm going as a robot. Cardboard boxes and silver paint.
lines.zh: 我扮机器人。纸箱和银色颜料。

lines.en: I can't decide. Vampire or ghost?
lines.zh: 我决定不了。吸血鬼还是鬼？

lines.en: Ghost is easier. Just a sheet with eye holes.
lines.zh: 鬼更简单。一条床单剪两个洞就行。

lines.en: Halloween is all about costumes and candy. But there's a friendly rule. Let's hear it.
lines.zh: 万圣节就是服装和糖果。但有个友好的规矩。来听听。

lines.en: We're going trick-or-treating. What's the magic words again?
lines.zh: 我们要去'不给糖就捣蛋'。那句魔法台词是啥来着？

lines.en: 'Trick or treat!' And you only visit houses with lights on.
lines.zh: '不给糖就捣蛋！'而且只去亮着灯的人家。

lines.en: What if someone gives me fruit instead of candy?
lines.zh: 要是有人给水果不给糖呢？

lines.en: Then you say thank you anyway. Don't be greedy.
lines.zh: 那也照样说谢谢。别贪心。

lines.en: Fine. And stay with the group, right?
lines.zh: 行。还要跟大家一起，对吧？

lines.en: Always. Never go alone, and check your candy before you eat it.
lines.zh: 永远要结伴。千万别单独去，吃糖前要检查。

lines.en: Got it. Spooky, safe, and polite.
lines.zh: 明白。吓人、安全、有礼貌。

lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个万圣节的表达。

lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次我们装点节日——圣诞节。下次散步见！

episodes.title: 圣诞节
episodes.desc: 圣诞节的温暖与传统，聊聊礼物

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, it's the most wonderful time — Christmas.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天是美好的时刻——圣诞节。

lines.en: My family puts up a Christmas tree every year. Real or fake?
lines.zh: 我们家每年都摆圣诞树。真树还是假树？

lines.en: Fake. A real one drops needles everywhere.
lines.zh: 假的。真树掉针叶掉得到处都是。

lines.en: We have a small one, and we decorate it together.
lines.zh: 我们家有棵小的，大家一起装饰。

lines.en: Same. Lights first, then the star on top.
lines.zh: 一样。先挂灯，再把星星放顶上。

lines.en: And presents underneath. That's the best part.
lines.zh: 礼物放在树下。那是最棒的部分。

lines.en: Christmas is about giving, not just getting. Here's the warm side of it.
lines.zh: 圣诞节的精髓是给予，不只是得到。来听听它温暖的一面。

lines.en: What's the best present you've ever given?
lines.zh: 你送过最好的礼物是什么？

lines.en: I made my mom a photo album. She cried a little.
lines.zh: 我给我妈做了一本相册。她都哭了。

lines.en: That's sweet. A gift doesn't have to be expensive.
lines.zh: 真暖心。礼物不一定贵。

lines.en: So a handmade card counts?
lines.zh: 那手写的贺卡也算？

lines.en: Totally. It shows you thought about the person.
lines.zh: 当然算。说明你心里想着那个人。

lines.en: Good. I'm bad at picking presents, but I can write a nice card.
lines.zh: 好。我不擅长挑礼物，但我会写张好贺卡。

lines.zh: 大家一起装饰。

lines.zh: 礼物放在树下。

lines.zh: 礼物不一定贵。

lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次我们划龙舟。下次散步见！

episodes.title: 端午节
episodes.desc: 粽子与龙舟，端午节的传统

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we celebrate a Chinese festival — the Dragon Boat Festival.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们过一个中国节日——端午节。

lines.en: My grandma is making zongzi this week. Have you ever tried making them?
lines.zh: 这周我奶奶在包粽子。你包过吗？

lines.en: I've eaten plenty, but never made one. It looks hard.
lines.zh: 我吃过很多，但没包过。看着很难。

lines.en: The wrapping is the tricky part. The filling is easy.
lines.zh: 包是难的部分。馅简单。

lines.en: Ours have rice, pork, and a salted egg yolk.
lines.zh: 我们家的有糯米、猪肉和咸蛋黄。

lines.en: Mine has red beans and dates. Sweet ones.
lines.zh: 我们家的有红豆和枣。是甜的。

lines.en: The Dragon Boat Festival has food and races, and a story behind it. Let's hear.
lines.zh: 端午节有美食和比赛，背后还有个故事。来听听。

lines.en: Why is it called the Dragon Boat Festival?
lines.zh: 为什么叫端午节（龙舟节）？

lines.en: People race long boats that look like dragons on the river.
lines.zh: 人们在河上划像龙一样的长船比赛。

lines.en: And it remembers a famous poet from long ago, Qu Yuan.
lines.zh: 也是为了纪念古代的一位大诗人屈原。

lines.en: So we eat zongzi and watch the races?
lines.zh: 所以我们是吃粽子、看龙舟赛？

lines.en: Right. The boats have a drummer to keep everyone in time.
lines.zh: 对。船上有鼓手让大家保持节奏。

lines.en: I'd love to try drumming in one someday.
lines.zh: 我以后也想在船里试试打鼓。

lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语描述一种你在节日吃的传统食物。

lines.en: That's it for today. Next, we watch the full moon — Mid-Autumn Festival. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次我们赏月——中秋节。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 中秋节
episodes.desc: 月饼与团圆，中秋赏月

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, the moon is full and bright — Mid-Autumn Festival.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天月圆月明——中秋节。

lines.en: What kind of mooncake do you like?
lines.zh: 你喜欢什么口味的月饼？

lines.en: The one with red bean paste. You?
lines.zh: 豆沙的。你呢？

lines.en: The one with a salted egg yolk in the middle.
lines.zh: 中间有咸蛋黄的那种。

lines.en: I like the snowy skin ones, cold from the fridge.
lines.zh: 我喜欢冰皮月饼，冰镇的。

lines.en: We always share one big mooncake as a family.
lines.zh: 我们家总是一起分一个大月饼。

lines.en: The Mid-Autumn Festival is about family and the full moon. Here's the story.
lines.zh: 中秋节是关于家人和满月的节日。来听故事。

lines.en: Why do we celebrate the full moon?
lines.zh: 我们为什么要庆祝满月？

lines.en: The full moon stands for being together as a family, whole and round.
lines.zh: 满月代表一家人团圆、圆满。

lines.en: People eat mooncakes, watch the moon, and carry lanterns.
lines.zh: 大家吃月饼、赏月、提灯笼。

lines.en: And there's the story of the moon lady, right?
lines.zh: 还有嫦娥的故事，对吧？

lines.en: Right, Chang'e. She lives on the moon with a rabbit.
lines.zh: 对，嫦娥。她和一只兔子住在月亮上。

lines.en: I hope the sky is clear tonight so we can see it.
lines.zh: 希望今晚天晴，能看到月亮。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some Mid-Autumn phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个中秋节的表达。

lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次我们吹蜡烛——生日与礼物。下次散步见！

episodes.title: 生日与礼物
episodes.desc: 生日怎么过，选礼物的小心思

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we celebrate you — birthdays and gifts.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们庆祝你——生日与礼物。

lines.en: My birthday is next week! I have no idea what to ask for.
lines.zh: 我下礼拜过生日！我不知道该要什么礼物。

lines.en: You're hard to shop for. You have everything.
lines.zh: 你太难送了。你啥都有。

lines.en: Ask for an experience, not a thing. A movie, a meal out.
lines.zh: 要'体验'，别要'东西'。一场电影、一顿饭。

lines.en: An experience? That's interesting.
lines.zh: 体验？有意思。

lines.en: Or something that matches your hobby. You like drawing, right?
lines.zh: 或者送你爱好相关的东西。你喜欢画画，对吧？

lines.en: The best gifts show you know the person. Here's how to pick one.
lines.zh: 最好的礼物能显示你了解对方。来听听怎么选。

lines.en: How do I pick a gift for a friend who has everything?
lines.zh: 怎么给一个什么都不缺的朋友选礼物？

lines.en: Listen for hints. They'll mention what they like without knowing.
lines.zh: 留意暗示。他们会无意间提到喜欢什么。

lines.en: Or make something. A drawing, a playlist, a photo book.
lines.zh: 或者亲手做。一张画、一个歌单、一本相册。

lines.en: So it's the thought that counts?
lines.zh: 所以是心意最重要？

lines.en: Exactly. A small, thoughtful gift beats an expensive random one.
lines.zh: 没错。小而用心的礼物胜过昂贵却随意的。

lines.en: Got it. I'll pay attention and make it personal.
lines.zh: 明白。我会留心，做得有心意。

lines.en: Listen for hints.
lines.zh: 留意暗示。

lines.zh: 心意最重要。

episodes.title: 我的第一部手机
episodes.desc: 拥有第一部手机，怎么合理使用

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, a big moment — your first phone.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天是个大时刻——你的第一部手机。

lines.en: I finally got my first phone! It's secondhand, but it's mine.
lines.zh: 我终于有自己的第一部手机了！虽然是二手的，但它是我的。

lines.en: Congrats! What's the first thing you did?
lines.zh: 恭喜！你做的第一件事是啥？

lines.en: Took a hundred selfies. Then my mom took it away for the evening.
lines.zh: 拍了张自拍。然后我妈晚上就收走了。

lines.en: Typical. What rules did she give you?
lines.zh: 正常。她给你定了什么规矩？

lines.en: No phone at the dinner table, and not after nine.
lines.zh: 吃饭时不碰手机，九点后不玩。

lines.en: Those are actually good rules. It protects your eyes and your sleep.
lines.zh: 这些规矩其实挺好。保护眼睛和睡眠。

lines.en: A phone is a tool, not a boss. Here's how to use it well.
lines.zh: 手机是工具，不是主人。来听听怎么用好它。

lines.en: So how do I not become a phone zombie?
lines.zh: 那我怎么才能不变成手机僵尸？

lines.en: Set limits. Use the screen-time feature, and put it away for homework.
lines.zh: 设定时限。用屏幕时间功能，写作业时放一边。

lines.en: And don't sleep with it next to your pillow. Charge it across the room.
lines.zh: 还有别把它放枕头边睡。放到房间另一头充电。

lines.en: Across the room? That's so far.
lines.zh: 房间另一头？太远了。

lines.en: Exactly the point. You'll scroll less and sleep better.
lines.zh: 要的就是这个。你会少刷手机、睡得更好。

lines.en: Fine. Phone as a tool, not a boss. Got it.
lines.zh: 行。手机是工具，不是主人。明白。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some phrases about phones.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个关于手机的表达。

lines.zh: 我终于有自己的第一部手机了。

lines.zh: 吃饭时不碰手机。

lines.en: Put it away for homework.
lines.zh: 写作业时放一边。

lines.en: Charge it across the room.
lines.zh: 放到房间另一头充电。

lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语描述一条你会为使用手机设定的规则。

lines.en: That's it for today. Next, we talk social media. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次我们聊社交媒体。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 社交媒体
episodes.desc: 社交媒体的好与坏，学会理性上网

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we scroll, like, and share — social media.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们刷、赞、分享——社交媒体。

lines.en: I posted a photo and I keep checking for likes. It's driving me crazy.
lines.zh: 我发了张照片，一直忍不住看点赞。快把我逼疯了。

lines.en: That's the trap. The likes don't mean anything real.
lines.zh: 这就是陷阱。那些赞不代表什么真实的。

lines.en: People post their best moments, not their real life.
lines.zh: 大家发的是最精彩的瞬间，不是真实生活。

lines.en: So I shouldn't compare?
lines.zh: 所以我不该去比较？

lines.en: Right. Everyone's highlight reel makes you feel bad about your normal day.
lines.zh: 对。每个人的'高光集锦'都会让你对自己的平常日子不满。

lines.en: Social media connects us, but it can also trick us. Here's how to stay balanced.
lines.zh: 社交媒体让我们连接，但也可能骗我们。来听听怎么保持平衡。

lines.en: How do I use it without feeling bad?
lines.zh: 怎么用才不难受？

lines.en: Follow people who inspire you, not people who make you jealous.
lines.zh: 关注激励你的人，而不是让你嫉妒的人。

lines.en: And set a time limit. An hour of scrolling disappears like nothing.
lines.zh: 还要设时间上限。刷一小时眨眼就没了。

lines.en: What about strangers? Some people message me.
lines.zh: 那陌生人呢？有人私信我。

lines.en: Never share personal info, and tell an adult if someone is weird.
lines.zh: 绝不要泄露个人信息，有人奇怪就告诉大人。

lines.en: Got it. Inspiring people, time limits, stay safe.
lines.zh: 明白。关注正能量、限时、注意安全。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some social media phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个社交媒体的表达。

lines.zh: 我一直忍不住看点赞。

lines.en: People post their best moments.
lines.zh: 大家发的是最精彩的瞬间。

lines.en: Don't compare yourself.
lines.zh: 别拿自己比较。

lines.en: Never share personal info.
lines.zh: 绝不要泄露个人信息。

lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次我们聊打游戏时间。下次散步见！

lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 打游戏时间
episodes.desc: 游戏好玩，也要学会控制时间

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we talk about gaming — and knowing when to stop.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们聊打游戏——以及知道什么时候该停。

lines.en: Just one more round. That's what I said three hours ago.
lines.zh: '再打一局。'这是三小时前我说的话。

lines.en: We've all been there. Games are designed to keep you hooked.
lines.zh: 我们都经历过。游戏就是设计来让你上瘾的。

lines.en: The question is, who's in charge — you or the game?
lines.zh: 问题是，谁做主——你还是游戏？

lines.en: The game, clearly. It always wins.
lines.zh: 显然是游戏。它总是赢。

lines.en: Then it's time to set a timer before you start.
lines.zh: 那你该在开打前定个闹钟。

lines.en: Gaming is fun, and it can even be good for your brain. The key is balance.
lines.zh: 打游戏有趣，甚至对大脑有好处。关键是平衡。

lines.en: So games can be good for you?
lines.zh: 所以游戏还能有好处？

lines.en: Some improve your reaction and problem-solving. But only in moderation.
lines.zh: 有些能提升反应和解决问题的能力。但要适度。

lines.en: Set a time, like forty minutes. When the timer rings, save and stop.
lines.zh: 定个时间，比如四十分钟。闹钟响了就存档停手。

lines.en: But stopping in the middle is so hard.
lines.zh: 可打到一半停下来太难了。

lines.en: Finish the round, then stop. Don't start a new one.
lines.zh: 打完这局就停。别再开新局。

lines.en: And what if I keep playing anyway?
lines.zh: 要是我还是继续打呢？

lines.en: Then it's time to talk to your parents and make a plan together.
lines.zh: 那就要跟父母谈谈，一起定个计划。

lines.zh: 打完这局就停。

episodes.title: 网络学习
episodes.desc: 上网课、用学习 App，高效自学

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we study without a classroom — learning online.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们不用教室学习——在线学习。

lines.en: I found this app that teaches English with short videos. It's actually fun.
lines.zh: 我发现一个用短视频教英语的 App。还挺好玩。

lines.en: Nice! How do you stay focused? Apps can be distracting.
lines.zh: 不错！你怎么保持专注？App 容易分心。

lines.en: I set it to ten minutes a day. Short enough to finish, long enough to learn.
lines.zh: 我设成每天十分钟。短到能完成，长到能学到东西。

lines.en: That's smart. Little and often beats cramming.
lines.zh: 很聪明。少量多次胜过突击。

lines.en: Exactly. I actually remember the words now.
lines.zh: 没错。我现在真能记住单词了。

lines.en: Online learning puts a whole classroom in your pocket. Here's how to make it work.
lines.zh: 在线学习把整个课堂装进口袋。来听听怎么让它奏效。

lines.en: What kind of online courses do you use?
lines.zh: 你用什么样的网课？

lines.en: Mostly videos and quiz apps. I do them on the bus.
lines.zh: 主要是视频和答题 App。我在公交上做。

lines.en: Dead time turns into study time. Smart.
lines.zh: 碎片时间变成学习时间。聪明。

lines.en: Just pick good sources. Not everything online is correct.
lines.zh: 但要挑好资源。网上不是所有东西都对。

lines.en: I use ones our teacher recommends.
lines.zh: 我用老师推荐的那些。

lines.en: And take breaks. Staring at a screen too long hurts your eyes.
lines.zh: 还要休息。盯着屏幕太久伤眼睛。

lines.en: Got it. Learn, check sources, rest my eyes.
lines.zh: 明白。学习、核对来源、让眼睛休息。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some online learning phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个在线学习的表达。

lines.en: I found this app that teaches English.
lines.zh: 我发现一个教英语的 App。

lines.en: Little and often beats cramming.
lines.zh: 少量多次胜过突击。

lines.en: Pick good sources.
lines.zh: 挑好资源。

lines.en: Take breaks from the screen.
lines.zh: 别一直盯着屏幕，要休息。

lines.zh: 保持专注

episodes.title: 短视频
episodes.desc: 短视频让人上瘾，学会控制观看

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we talk about the thing that eats our time — short videos.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们聊聊那个吞噬时间的东西——短视频。

lines.en: I sat down to watch one video and suddenly it was midnight.
lines.zh: 我坐下来看一个视频，突然就半夜了。

lines.en: The algorithm knows exactly what to show you next.
lines.zh: 算法太懂下一步该给你看什么了。

lines.en: That's not an accident. Every swipe is designed to keep you watching.
lines.zh: 这不是巧合。每一次滑动都是设计好让你看下去的。

lines.en: It's scary how fast time goes.
lines.zh: 时间过得快得吓人。

lines.en: The trick is to decide your limit before you open the app.
lines.zh: 诀窍是打开 App 前先定好时长。

lines.en: Short videos can be fun and even useful. But without a limit, they eat your day.
lines.zh: 短视频可以有趣甚至有用。但不设限，它就会吃掉你的一天。

lines.en: So how do I control it?
lines.zh: 那我怎么控制？

lines.en: Set a timer before you start. When it rings, close the app.
lines.zh: 开始前定闹钟。一响就关掉 App。

lines.en: Or watch for a reason — learn a skill, not just pass time.
lines.zh: 或者带着目的看——学个技能，而不是打发时间。

lines.en: I do follow some cooking and drawing accounts. Those are useful.
lines.zh: 我确实关注了一些做菜和画画的账号。那些有用。

lines.en: Then keep the useful ones and cut the rest.
lines.zh: 那就留有用的，删掉其他的。

lines.en: Good plan. Watch less, learn more.
lines.zh: 好计划。少看点，多学点。

lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个关于短视频的表达。

lines.zh: 每次滑动都是设计好让你看下去的。

lines.en: Decide your limit before you open the app.
lines.zh: 打开 App 前先定好时长。

lines.en: Watch less, learn more.
lines.zh: 少看点，多学点。

episodes.title: 和好朋友吵架
episodes.desc: 吵架了怎么和好，学会道歉与沟通

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we fix a friendship — making up with a friend.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们修复友谊——和朋友和好。

lines.en: I had a fight with my best friend. We haven't talked in two days.
lines.zh: 我和最好的朋友吵架了。两天没说话了。

lines.en: That's a long time. What happened?
lines.zh: 那挺久了。怎么了？

lines.en: I said something mean, and now I don't know how to fix it.
lines.zh: 我说了句难听的话，现在不知道该怎么挽回。

lines.en: Start with a simple sorry. Not 'sorry, but...' — just sorry.
lines.zh: 先简单地道个歉。不是'对不起，但是……'——就只是对不起。

lines.en: What if he doesn't accept it?
lines.zh: 要是他不接受呢？

lines.en: Give him time. An apology is a door you open, not one you push through.
lines.zh: 给他时间。道歉是打开一扇门，不是硬闯进去。

lines.en: Every friendship has bumps. The strong ones know how to repair. Here's how.
lines.zh: 每段友谊都有磕碰。牢固的友谊懂得修复。来听听怎么做。

lines.en: How do I say sorry without sounding fake?
lines.zh: 怎么道歉才不显得假？

lines.en: Be specific. 'I'm sorry I said that about your drawing. It was wrong.'
lines.zh: 说具体点。'对不起，我那样说你画的事。是我错了。'

lines.en: And listen. Don't interrupt while he tells you how he feels.
lines.zh: 还要倾听。他说感受时别打断。

lines.en: Then we just move on like nothing happened?
lines.zh: 然后就像没事一样继续？

lines.en: Not exactly. You learn from it, so it doesn't happen again.
lines.zh: 不完全是。你从中吸取教训，让它不再发生。

lines.en: Okay. Sorry, listen, and learn. I can do that.
lines.zh: 好。道歉、倾听、吸取教训。我能做到。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some phrases for making up.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个和好的表达。

episodes.title: 考试焦虑
episodes.desc: 考试前的紧张，学会放松与复习

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we talk about the butterflies before a big test — exam stress.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们聊聊大考前的紧张——考试焦虑。

lines.en: The exam is tomorrow and my brain feels like scrambled eggs.
lines.zh: 明天考试，我脑子乱成一锅粥。

lines.en: That's normal. A little nerves actually help you focus.
lines.zh: 这很正常。一点点紧张其实能帮你集中注意力。

lines.en: A little? I can't even sleep.
lines.zh: 一点点？我都睡不着了。

lines.en: Then stop cramming. Your brain needs rest to remember things.
lines.zh: 那就别突击了。大脑需要休息才能记住东西。

lines.en: But there's so much left to review!
lines.zh: 可还有好多没复习呢！

lines.en: Review the main points, then stop. Trust what you know.
lines.zh: 复习重点，然后停。相信你已经会的东西。

lines.en: Exam stress is real, but you can manage it. Here's how.
lines.zh: 考试焦虑是真的，但你能应对。来听听怎么做。

lines.en: The night before, sleep early. A rested brain beats a tired one.
lines.zh: 考前一晚早点睡。休息好的大脑胜过疲惫的。

lines.en: What about during the exam, when I panic?
lines.zh: 那考试中慌了怎么办？

lines.en: Breathe slowly. Read the question twice. Start with the easy parts.
lines.zh: 慢慢呼吸。题目读两遍。先做简单的。

lines.en: And if I blank out?
lines.zh: 要是脑子一片空白呢？

lines.en: Move to the next question and come back. It'll come to you.
lines.zh: 先做下一题，回头再看。答案会想起来的。

lines.en: Okay. Sleep, breathe, and don't get stuck.
lines.zh: 好。睡觉、呼吸、别卡住。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some exam phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个关于考试的表达。

episodes.title: 上台演讲
episodes.desc: 克服紧张，自信地开口演讲

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we face the crowd — giving a speech.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们面对观众——上台演讲。

lines.en: I have to give a speech in front of the whole class. I'm terrified.
lines.zh: 我必须在全班面前演讲。我吓坏了。

lines.en: Everyone's nervous before a speech. Even teachers.
lines.zh: 每个人演讲前都会紧张。老师也是。

lines.en: The key is practice. Say it out loud, not just in your head.
lines.zh: 关键是练习。要大声念出来，不能只在心里过。

lines.en: I practiced in front of my mirror. My cat judged me.
lines.zh: 我对着镜子练了。我家猫还给我打分。

lines.en: Was the cat impressed?
lines.zh: 猫被打动了吗？

lines.en: She fell asleep. Not a great sign.
lines.zh: 她睡着了。不是好兆头。

lines.en: A good speech is less about being perfect and more about being clear. Here's how.
lines.zh: 好的演讲不在于完美，而在于清晰。来听听怎么做。

lines.en: Start with one strong opening line. Grab their attention.
lines.zh: 用一个有力的开头抓住注意力。

lines.en: Like a question?
lines.zh: 比如提个问题？

lines.en: Exactly. Or a surprising fact. Then your main points, then a clear ending.
lines.zh: 没错。或者一个惊人的事实。然后是要点，最后是清晰的结尾。

lines.en: And slow down. Nervous people rush. Pause between ideas.
lines.zh: 还要放慢。紧张的人会越说越快。要点之间停一停。

lines.en: What if I forget my lines?
lines.zh: 要是忘词了呢？

lines.en: Look at your notes, take a breath, and keep going. Nobody knows your script.
lines.zh: 看眼笔记，吸口气，继续说。没人知道你原本的稿子。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some speech phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个演讲的表达。

lines.en: I have to give a speech.
lines.zh: 我必须演讲。

lines.en: Say it out loud.
lines.zh: 大声念出来。

lines.en: Start with a strong opening line.
lines.zh: 用有力的开头。

lines.en: Slow down and pause.
lines.zh: 放慢，停顿。

lines.zh: 演讲

lines.zh: 在全班面前

lines.zh: 抓住注意力

episodes.title: 第一次独立
episodes.desc: 第一次独自在家，学会照顾自己

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, a milestone — your first time home alone.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天是个里程碑——你第一次独自在家。

lines.en: My parents are going away overnight. I'll be home alone for the first time!
lines.zh: 我爸妈要出去住一晚。我第一次一个人在家！

lines.en: Exciting and a little scary, right?
lines.zh: 又兴奋又有点怕，对吧？

lines.en: Mostly exciting. I can stay up and eat whatever I want.
lines.zh: 主要是兴奋。我可以熬夜，想吃什么吃什么。

lines.en: That's the fun part. But you still need to be responsible.
lines.zh: 那是好玩的部分。但你还是要负起责任。

lines.en: Responsible how? It's one night.
lines.zh: 负什么责任？就一晚。

lines.en: Lock the doors, don't open to strangers, and know who to call.
lines.zh: 锁好门，不给陌生人开门，知道该找谁求助。

lines.en: Being alone is a chance to show you can handle things. Here's a simple checklist.
lines.zh: 独处是证明你能行的机会。来听个简单清单。

lines.en: First, lock the door and keep your phone charged.
lines.zh: 首先，锁好门，手机充满电。

lines.en: Check. What about dinner?
lines.zh: 好。晚饭呢？

lines.en: Something simple. Don't leave the stove on, and clean up after.
lines.zh: 做点简单的。别忘关炉子，吃完收拾。

lines.en: I was just going to order noodles.
lines.zh: 我本来想点面条。

lines.en: That works too. Just don't open the door to strangers.
lines.zh: 那也行。只是别给陌生人开门。

lines.en: And have a plan for emergencies. Know your neighbors and the emergency number.
lines.zh: 还要有应急计划。知道邻居和紧急电话。

lines.en: Got it. Locked door, simple food, and a plan.
lines.zh: 明白。锁门、简单食物、有预案。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some phrases about being alone.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个关于独处的表达。

episodes.title: 被误解
episodes.desc: 被人误解了怎么办，学会冷静解释

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we talk about a frustrating feeling — being misunderstood.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们聊聊一种憋屈的感觉——被误解。

lines.en: Everyone thinks I broke the window, but I didn't!
lines.zh: 大家都以为是我打碎的窗户，可我没有！

lines.en: That's awful. Why do they think it was you?
lines.zh: 太糟了。他们为什么觉得是你？

lines.en: Because I was standing there when it happened.
lines.zh: 因为出事时我正好站在那儿。

lines.en: Being in the wrong place at the wrong time. It happens.
lines.zh: 在错误的时间出现在错误的地点。常有的事。

lines.en: I tried to explain, but no one listened.
lines.zh: 我想解释，但没人听。

lines.en: Then explain calmly, when people are ready to listen.
lines.zh: 那就在大家愿意听的时候，冷静地解释。

lines.en: When you're misunderstood, the instinct is to shout. But calm wins. Here's how.
lines.zh: 被误解时，本能是想喊。但冷静才管用。来听听怎么做。

lines.en: First, don't lose your temper. Shouting makes you look guilty.
lines.zh: 首先，别发火。大喊会让你显得心虚。

lines.en: But it's so unfair!
lines.zh: 可这太不公平了！

lines.en: I know. Say what you saw, clearly and simply. Stick to the facts.
lines.zh: 我懂。把你看到的清楚、简单地说出来。只说事实。

lines.en: Like, 'I was standing there, but I didn't touch the window'?
lines.zh: 比如，'我站在那儿，但我没碰窗户'？

lines.en: Exactly. And if they still don't believe you, let it rest. The truth comes out.
lines.zh: 没错。要是他们还不信，就先放一放。真相会大白的。

lines.en: So calm, facts, and patience.
lines.zh: 所以是冷静、讲事实、有耐心。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some phrases for being misunderstood.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个关于被误解的表达。

episodes.title: 帮助陌生人
episodes.desc: 小小的善意，温暖别人也温暖自己

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we do something kind — helping a stranger.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们做件善事——帮助陌生人。

lines.en: An old man dropped his bag of fruit at the market. I helped him pick it all up.
lines.zh: 在市场，一位老爷爷的水果袋掉了。我帮他把水果都捡起来了。

lines.en: That was kind of you. How did he react?
lines.zh: 你真善良。他什么反应？

lines.en: He smiled and said thank you. It made my whole day.
lines.zh: 他笑着说谢谢。那一整天我心情都很好。

lines.en: That's the thing about helping — you feel good too.
lines.zh: 帮助就是这样——你自己也会开心。

lines.en: Small kindnesses add up. They make a place feel friendly.
lines.zh: 小小的善意积少成多。它们让一个地方变得温暖。

lines.en: Helping a stranger doesn't need to be big. Here are some simple ways.
lines.zh: 帮助陌生人不必是大事。来听几个简单的方式。

lines.en: What else can you do for strangers?
lines.zh: 还能为陌生人做什么？

lines.en: Hold a door, give up your seat, help carry something heavy.
lines.zh: 扶一下门、让个座、帮人提重物。

lines.en: Or just smile and say good morning. It costs nothing.
lines.zh: 或者只是微笑说声早上好。不花一分钱。

lines.en: What if I help and they don't say thanks?
lines.zh: 要是我帮了人家不说谢谢呢？

lines.en: Then you still did the right thing. Kindness isn't a trade.
lines.zh: 那你还是做了对的事。善意不是交易。

lines.en: I like that. Help for the sake of helping.
lines.zh: 我喜欢这个。为了帮助而帮助。

lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个关于帮助的表达。

lines.zh: 帮人扶一下门。
