episodes.title: 我的榜样
episodes.desc: 榜样的力量，向优秀的人学习

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we talk about the people who inspire us — role models.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们聊聊激励我们的人——榜样。

lines.en: Who's your role model?
lines.zh: 你的榜样是谁？

lines.en: My mom. She works hard and never complains.
lines.zh: 我妈。她努力工作，从不抱怨。

lines.en: Mine is my uncle. He taught himself to code and now builds apps.
lines.zh: 我的是我叔叔。他自学编程，现在做 App。

lines.en: I never thought about it. Maybe my grandpa?
lines.zh: 我从没想过。也许我爷爷？

lines.en: Why him?
lines.zh: 为什么是他？

lines.en: He's patient, and he can fix anything.
lines.zh: 他很有耐心，而且什么都能修。

lines.en: A role model doesn't have to be famous. It's someone whose qualities you admire.
lines.zh: 榜样不一定是名人。是你欣赏其品质的人。

lines.en: The best thing about a role model is you can learn from them.
lines.zh: 榜样最好的一点是，你能向他们学习。

lines.en: How do I learn from someone who's just living their life?
lines.zh: 怎么向一个只是过自己生活的人学习？

lines.en: Notice what they do well, and try it yourself. Patience, kindness, hard work.
lines.zh: 观察他们做得好的一面，然后自己试试。耐心、善良、勤奋。

lines.en: So I don't copy them, I learn their good habits?
lines.zh: 所以我不是照搬，而是学他们的好习惯？

lines.en: Exactly. You become your own person with their best traits.
lines.zh: 没错。你吸收他们的优点，成为你自己。

lines.en: I like that. My grandpa's patience, my mom's kindness.
lines.zh: 我喜欢。爷爷的耐心，妈妈的善良。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some phrases about role models.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个关于榜样的表达。

lines.en: Learn from their good habits.
lines.zh: 学习他们的好习惯。

lines.en: Become your own person.
lines.zh: 成为你自己。

episodes.title: 职业体验日
episodes.desc: 体验不同的职业，发现自己的兴趣

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we try on different jobs — career day!
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们体验不同职业——职业体验日！

lines.en: Our school had a career day. We tried different jobs for a morning.
lines.zh: 我们学校办了个职业体验日。我们体验了一上午不同职业。

lines.en: Cool! What did you try?
lines.zh: 酷！你体验了什么？

lines.en: I was a news reporter. I interviewed people in the hall.
lines.zh: 我当了新闻记者。我在大厅采访大家。

lines.en: Did you like it?
lines.zh: 你喜欢吗？

lines.en: Loved it! Asking questions and telling stories is fun.
lines.zh: 超喜欢！提问和讲故事很好玩。

lines.en: I tried being a nurse. I learned to wrap a bandage.
lines.zh: 我体验了护士。学会了包扎。

lines.en: Career day is a chance to peek at jobs before choosing one. Here's what matters.
lines.zh: 职业体验日是选职业前窥探各种工作的机会。来听听什么最重要。

lines.en: How do I know which job fits me?
lines.zh: 怎么知道哪个职业适合我？

lines.en: Think about what you enjoy doing, not just what sounds cool.
lines.zh: 想想你喜欢做什么，而不只是听起来酷的。

lines.en: I like talking and writing. So reporter makes sense.
lines.zh: 我喜欢说话和写作。所以记者挺合适。

lines.en: And try many things. You don't have to decide now.
lines.zh: 还要多尝试。你不必现在就决定。

lines.en: Right. Today it's reporter, next month it might be something new.
lines.zh: 对。今天想当记者，下个月可能又发现新的。

lines.en: So career day is about exploring, not deciding.
lines.zh: 所以职业体验日是探索，不是决定。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some career phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个关于职业的表达。

lines.zh: 我们体验了不同职业。

lines.en: I interviewed people.
lines.zh: 我采访了大家。

lines.en: What job fits me?
lines.zh: 什么职业适合我？

lines.en: You don't have to decide now.
lines.zh: 你不必现在就决定。

lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语描述一个你想尝试的职业，以及为什么。

lines.en: That's it for today. Next, we imagine school in the future. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次我们畅想未来的学校。下次散步见！

episodes.title: 未来学校
episodes.desc: 畅想未来学校的样子，发挥想象力

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we time-travel — school of the future.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们穿越——未来的学校。

lines.en: Imagine school in fifty years. What would it be like?
lines.zh: 想象一下五十年后的学校。会是什么样？

lines.en: No heavy backpacks. Everything is on one thin screen.
lines.zh: 没有沉重的书包。所有东西都在一块薄薄的屏幕上。

lines.en: Or holograms! A teacher appears in your room as light.
lines.zh: 或者全息投影！老师以光的形态出现在你房间里。

lines.en: I'd want AI that helps me learn at my own speed.
lines.zh: 我想要能按我自己的节奏教我的人工智能。

lines.en: But I'd still want real friends, not just screens.
lines.zh: 但我还是想要真实的朋友，而不只是屏幕。

lines.en: Dreaming about the future is fun, and it shapes what we build. Let's imagine more.
lines.zh: 畅想未来很有趣，而且它会塑造我们的创造。来多想一点。

lines.en: Maybe classes won't be by age. You learn with people who share your level.
lines.zh: 也许不再按年龄分班。你和水平相近的人一起学。

lines.en: And tests? Can we get rid of tests?
lines.zh: 那考试呢？能取消考试吗？

lines.en: Maybe tests become projects. You show what you learned by building something.
lines.zh: 也许考试变成项目。你用做东西来展示所学。

lines.en: I love that idea. Learning by doing, not just memorizing.
lines.zh: 我喜欢这个想法。做中学，而不是死记硬背。

lines.en: Some of this is already happening. The future starts now.
lines.zh: 其中一些已经在发生了。未来始于现在。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some future-school phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个关于未来学校的表达。

lines.zh: 所有东西都在一块薄屏上。

lines.en: Learn at my own speed.
lines.zh: 按我自己的节奏学习。

lines.en: Learning by doing.
lines.zh: 做中学。

episodes.title: 攒钱计划
episodes.desc: 学会存钱，为想要的东西努力

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, we talk about a useful habit — saving money.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天我们聊聊一个有用的习惯——攒钱。

lines.en: I want a new skateboard, but it costs a lot. My pocket money disappears fast.
lines.zh: 我想要个新滑板，但很贵。我的零花钱花得太快。

lines.en: Where does your money go?
lines.zh: 你的钱都花哪儿去了？

lines.en: Snacks, mostly. And little things I forget about.
lines.zh: 主要买零食。还有我都记不住的小东西。

lines.en: Those little things add up. That's why you're always broke.
lines.zh: 那些小东西加起来很多。所以你总是没钱。

lines.en: I need a plan, don't I?
lines.zh: 我需要个计划，对吧？

lines.en: You need a savings goal and a budget.
lines.zh: 你需要一个存钱目标和预算。

lines.en: Saving money is simple if you make it a habit. Here's how.
lines.zh: 攒钱只要养成习惯就很简单。来听听怎么做。

lines.en: First, decide your goal. How much is the skateboard?
lines.zh: 首先，定目标。滑板多少钱？

lines.en: Three hundred yuan.
lines.zh: 三百块。

lines.en: And how much pocket money do you get a week?
lines.zh: 你一周多少零花钱？

lines.en: Fifty yuan. So if I save thirty a week...
lines.zh: 五十块。所以我一周存三十的话……

lines.en: Ten weeks. You'll have it in two and a half months.
lines.zh: 十周。两个半月就攒够了。

lines.en: That's actually doable!
lines.zh: 这真能做到！

lines.en: Put the money aside the moment you get it. Pay yourself first.
lines.zh: 拿到钱先存起来。先付给自己。

lines.en: Slow down. Here are some saving phrases.
lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个攒钱的表达。

lines.zh: 我想存钱买个新滑板。

lines.zh: 小东西加起来很多。

lines.en: Set a savings goal.
lines.zh: 定个存钱目标。

lines.en: Put money aside first.
lines.zh: 先存起来。

lines.zh: 零花钱

lines.zh: 加起来

lines.zh: 存钱目标

lines.en: That's it for today. Next, the big one — graduation. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下次是大事——毕业季。下次散步见！

episodes.title: 毕业季
episodes.desc: 告别与新的开始，感恩这段时光

lines.en: Welcome back. Today, the last episode — graduation.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来。今天是最后一集——毕业季。

lines.en: I can't believe middle school is almost over. Where did the time go?
lines.zh: 真不敢相信初中快结束了。时间都去哪儿了？

lines.en: It flew by. Remember our first day? You almost got lost twice.
lines.zh: 一晃就过去了。还记得开学第一天吗？你差点迷路两次。

lines.en: And now I know every hallway by heart.
lines.zh: 现在我闭着眼都能走每条走廊。

lines.en: We've come a long way. New people, new skills, new friends.
lines.zh: 我们成长了好多。新的人、新的技能、新的朋友。

lines.en: And a lot of homework we complained about together.
lines.zh: 还有我们一起抱怨的许多作业。

lines.en: Graduation is an ending, but also a beginning. Here's how to say goodbye well.
lines.zh: 毕业是一个结束，也是一个开始。来听听怎么好好告别。

lines.en: What should we do before we leave?
lines.zh: 离开前我们该做点什么？

lines.en: Thank the people who helped you. Teachers, friends, family.
lines.zh: 感谢帮助过你的人。老师、朋友、家人。

lines.en: And keep in touch. Graduation isn't the end of friendship.
lines.zh: 还要保持联系。毕业不是友谊的终点。

lines.en: I'm going to miss this. But I'm excited for high school, too.
lines.zh: 我会想念这里的。但我也期待高中。

lines.en: That's the spirit. Look back with thanks, look ahead with hope.
lines.zh: 就是这个劲儿。带着感恩回望，带着希望向前。

lines.zh: 放慢速度。来听几个毕业的表达。

lines.zh: 保持联系。

lines.en: Your turn: in English, say what you'd like to say to your school or classmates as you graduate.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：用英语说一段你想对学校或同学说的毕业告别话。

lines.en: And that's a wrap — one hundred walks, one hundred lessons. Thank you for walking and talking with me. Keep listening, keep speaking, and keep walking. Goodbye for now, and good luck out there!
lines.zh: 到此收官——一百次散步，一百堂课。感谢你一路陪我说说走走。继续听，继续说，继续走下去。暂时再见，祝你前路顺利！
